domains.name: product
domains.description: Single source of truth for all finished goods master data across the F&B portfolio — SKUs, GTINs, UPCs, BOMs, formulations, recipes, nutritional panels, allergen matrices, packaging specifications, shelf life, and product lifecycle management (PLM) from NPD through commercialization and discontinuation. Governs product hierarchy from brand down to individual pack size and variant.
domains.references: GS1 GTIN Standard, FDA 21 CFR Part 101 (Food Labeling), ISO 22000, Codex Alimentarius

products.name: sku
products.description: Master record for every Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) in the F&B portfolio — the single source of truth for finished-good identity. Captures SKU code, GTIN/UPC/EAN barcodes, brand, sub-brand, product line, flavor/variety, pack size, net weight/volume, unit of measure, form factor (RTD, RTE, concentrate, powder, frozen), ABV where applicable, Brix target, pH range, product status (active, discontinued, on-hold, seasonal), launch date, discontinuation date, PLM stage, and product hierarchy classification. Anchor entity for the entire product domain and primary join key for all downstream domains (sales, supply, manufacturing, quality).
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Master (MM)

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Stock Keeping Unit. Primary key for the SKU master data product.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand under which this SKU is marketed and sold.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.category. Business justification: Every SKU in the F&B portfolio belongs to a product category (e.g., Beverages, Snacks, Dairy, Packaged Foods). The category table is the canonical master reference for product categories. Adding categ

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Legal entity assignment per SKU needed for inter‑company profit/loss consolidation and tax reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue GL account mapping required for sales posting per SKU; essential for financial reporting of product sales.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_hierarchy. Business justification: Each SKU belongs to a node in the product hierarchy, enabling classification and reporting. Adding product_hierarchy_id FK eliminates redundant category fields.

attributes.name: primary_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Required for SKU‑level supplier assignment used in sourcing decisions, cost modeling, and supplier scorecard reporting.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Required for regulatory product registration tracking; each SKU must be linked to its product registration record for label compliance and market approval.

attributes.name: abv
attributes.description: Alcohol by volume percentage for alcoholic beverage products. Null for non-alcoholic products.
attributes.references: TTB Alcohol Labeling Requirements 27 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: allergen_matrix
attributes.description: Comprehensive list of major food allergens present in or potentially cross-contaminating the product (milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame).

attributes.name: brix_target
attributes.description: Target Brix measurement representing sugar content percentage for beverages and fruit products. Used for quality control and formulation.

attributes.name: calories_per_serving
attributes.description: Total caloric content per serving as declared on the nutritional panel.

attributes.name: clean_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets clean label criteria with minimal, recognizable ingredients and no artificial additives.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SKU master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU was or will be discontinued and removed from active production and distribution.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number barcode identifier used internationally for retail product identification.

attributes.name: flavor_variety
attributes.description: Specific flavor, variety, or variant of the product (e.g., Original, Chocolate, Strawberry, Spicy, Mild).

attributes.name: form_factor
attributes.description: Physical form and preparation state of the product (Ready to Eat, Ready to Drink, Concentrate, Powder, Frozen, Refrigerated, Shelf Stable, Fresh). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ready to eat|ready to drink|concentrate|powder|frozen|refrigerated|shelf stable|fresh — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gluten_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets gluten-free labeling requirements (less than 20 ppm gluten).

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number used for international product identification. Can be GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified halal by a recognized halal certification body.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified kosher by a recognized kosher certification agency.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU was first introduced to market and made available for sale.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SKU master record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_volume
attributes.description: Net volume of the product contents for liquid or pourable products.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Net weight of the product contents excluding packaging.

attributes.name: non_gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is verified as non-genetically modified organism (Non-GMO Project Verified or equivalent).

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified organic by USDA or equivalent organic certification body.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Consumer-facing pack size description (e.g., Single Serve, Family Pack, 6-Pack, 12-Pack, Case).

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Primary packaging format and material (e.g., Bottle, Can, Pouch, Box, Bag, Jar, Tray, Carton).

attributes.name: ph_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable pH level (acidity measure) for the product. Critical for food safety and quality control.

attributes.name: ph_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable pH level (acidity measure) for the product. Critical for food safety and quality control.

attributes.name: plm_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the Product Lifecycle Management process (Concept, Development, Validation, Commercialization, Growth, Maturity, Decline). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|development|validation|commercialization|growth|maturity|decline — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the product including key features, ingredients, and usage occasions.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Product line or sub-brand classification within the brand portfolio (e.g., Premium, Organic, Kids, Family Size).

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Full marketing name of the finished good product as it appears on packaging and in consumer-facing materials.

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU (Active, Discontinued, On Hold, Seasonal, Pending Launch, Phase Out).

attributes.name: recyclable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary packaging is recyclable through standard municipal recycling programs.

attributes.name: serving_size
attributes.description: Standard serving size as declared on the nutritional panel with unit of measure (e.g., 1 cup (240ml), 28g, 1 bottle).

attributes.name: servings_per_container
attributes.description: Number of servings contained in the package as declared on the nutritional panel.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product maintains quality and safety from production date under proper storage conditions.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the SKU used across systems and operations. Alphanumeric code typically 6-20 characters.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in Celsius required to maintain product quality and safety.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in Celsius required to maintain product quality and safety.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for net weight or volume (grams, kilograms, ounces, pounds, milliliters, liters, fluid ounces, gallons, each, count). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: g|kg|mg|oz|lb|ml|l|fl oz|gal|ea|count — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code barcode identifier used primarily in North America for retail scanning.

attributes.name: vegan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains no animal-derived ingredients or by-products.

attributes.name: vegetarian_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is suitable for vegetarian diets (no meat, poultry, fish, or slaughter by-products).

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Defines the multi-level product classification hierarchy from corporate portfolio down to individual SKU variant: Division → Category → Sub-Category → Brand → Sub-Brand → Product Line → Variant → Pack Size. Each node carries a hierarchy level code, parent node reference, hierarchy path string, and effective date range. Used for reporting roll-ups, trade promotion planning, category management, and planogram slotting. Aligns with Nielsen/IRI category taxonomy for syndicated data integration.
products.reference: Nielsen/IRI Category Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each node in the product hierarchy structure. Primary key for the product hierarchy entity.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Product hierarchy nodes are organized by brand architecture in F&B portfolio management. Brand managers use hierarchy-to-brand mapping for brand P&L reporting, portfolio governance, and brand architec

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.category. Business justification: Product hierarchy nodes (especially at the category and subcategory levels) should reference the canonical category master to ensure consistent category classification across the product hierarchy and

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budgeting process allocates cost‑center budgets to product categories; hierarchy node links to cost_center for expense planning.

attributes.name: parent_node_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent node in the hierarchy structure. Null for top-level Division nodes. Enables recursive hierarchy traversal and roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Product hierarchy nodes (brand, category, sub-category) map to profit centers for brand P&L and segment reporting in F&B. Hierarchy already has cost_center but lacks profit_center, which is essential

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: F&B portfolio strategy and NPD explicitly map product hierarchy nodes to consumer segments for innovation platform targeting and channel strategy. 'target_consumer_segment' is a denormalized text fiel

attributes.name: allergen_category
attributes.description: High-level allergen classification for products in this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Contains Dairy', 'Gluten-Free', 'Nut-Free Facility'). Used for allergen matrix management and regulatory labeling compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: contains_milk|contains_eggs|contains_fish|contains_shellfish|contains_tree_nuts|contains_peanuts|contains_wheat|contains_soybeans|allergen_free — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA), EU Food Information Regulation

attributes.name: brand_owner
attributes.description: Legal entity or business unit that owns the brand or product line represented by this hierarchy node. Used for financial reporting, royalty tracking, and portfolio management.

attributes.name: category_captain_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this brand or product line holds category captain status with key retail partners. Category captains lead category management initiatives and planogram optimization.

attributes.name: channel_strategy
attributes.description: Primary distribution channel strategy for products in this hierarchy node. Retail includes grocery and mass merchandisers; DSD is Direct Store Delivery; foodservice includes restaurants and institutions; ecommerce includes online retail; convenience includes c-stores and gas stations; club includes warehouse clubs; natural includes natural/organic specialty stores. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|foodservice|dsd|ecommerce|convenience|club|natural|specialty — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: clean_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products under this hierarchy node meet clean label criteria (minimal processing, recognizable ingredients, no artificial additives). Used for marketing positioning and consumer segmentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Source system of record for this hierarchy node (e.g., 'SAP S/4HANA MM', 'Oracle PLM', 'Internal MDM'). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: depth
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this node in the hierarchy tree, with Division=1, Category=2, etc. Used for hierarchy navigation and reporting level filtering.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node ceases to be effective. Null for currently active nodes. Enables historical reporting and supports product portfolio restructuring over time.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node becomes effective for product classification and reporting. Supports time-variant hierarchy structures for historical analysis.

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this hierarchy node. Active nodes are in use for classification and reporting; inactive nodes are historical; pending nodes are planned but not yet launched; discontinued nodes represent retired product lines.

attributes.name: innovation_platform_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node represents an innovation platform for New Product Development (NPD). Innovation platforms receive priority for R&D investment and accelerated commercialization.

attributes.name: iri_category_code
attributes.description: IRI syndicated data category code mapping for this hierarchy node. Enables integration with IRI panel data and assortment analytics. Aligns with IRI category taxonomy.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: level_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the level of this node within the product hierarchy structure. Defines whether this node represents a Division, Category, Sub-Category, Brand, Sub-Brand, Product Line, Variant, or Pack Size. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DIVISION|CATEGORY|SUBCATEGORY|BRAND|SUBBRAND|PRODUCTLINE|VARIANT|PACKSIZE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this hierarchy node record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: nielsen_category_code
attributes.description: Nielsen syndicated data category code mapping for this hierarchy node. Enables integration with Nielsen market tracking data and competitive benchmarking. Aligns with Nielsen category taxonomy.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for this hierarchy node. Used for reporting, integration with Nielsen/IRI syndicated data, and cross-system references.

attributes.name: node_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of this hierarchy node, including its scope, purpose, and business context within the product portfolio.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this hierarchy node. Examples: 'Beverages', 'Ready to Drink (RTD)', 'Premium Cola Brand', 'Diet Variant', '12oz Can'.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products under this hierarchy node carry organic certification (USDA Organic, EU Organic, etc.). Used for regulatory compliance and marketing claims.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP), EU Organic Regulation

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Full hierarchical path from root to this node, typically formatted as slash-delimited string (e.g., '/Beverages/RTD/Premium Cola/Diet/12oz'). Enables efficient ancestor queries and reporting roll-ups.

attributes.name: portfolio_tier
attributes.description: Strategic portfolio classification for this hierarchy node. Core brands receive sustained investment; growth brands receive accelerated investment; emerging brands are in test-and-learn phase; harvest brands are managed for cash flow; divest brands are planned for exit.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node represents private label products manufactured for retail partners under their brand names.

attributes.name: regulatory_category
attributes.description: FDA or USDA regulatory category for products in this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Conventional Food', 'Dietary Supplement', 'Meat Product', 'Beverage - Non-Alcoholic'). Determines applicable regulatory requirements and labeling standards.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS)

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort sequence for displaying this node among its siblings at the same hierarchy level. Used for consistent ordering in reports, planograms, and user interfaces.

attributes.name: sustainability_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products under this hierarchy node carry third-party sustainability certifications (Rainforest Alliance, Fair Trade, B Corp, etc.). Used for ESG reporting and marketing claims.
attributes.references: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI), Third-Party Certification Bodies

products.name: bill_of_materials
products.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) header record defining the formulation structure for each finished good or semi-finished SKU. Captures BOM number, BOM type (production, co-pack, toll manufacturing), base quantity, unit of measure, effective date range, revision number, PLM approval status, and the owning plant or manufacturing site. Links to BOM line items for individual ingredient quantities. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA PP module and TraceGains specification management.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA BOM (PP-BD-BOM)

attributes.name: bill_of_materials_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bill_of_materials

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: In multi-entity F&B companies, BOMs are scoped to legal entities (company codes) for intercompany manufacturing, transfer pricing, and legal entity cost reporting. SAP-standard BOM management always a

attributes.name: food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.food_safety_plan. Business justification: FSMA and HACCP compliance require each BOM to be governed by a facility food safety plan. The BOM carries `haccp_critical_flag` and `regulatory_approval_required_flag`, signaling direct food safety pl

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing site or plant that owns and uses this BOM. BOMs may be plant-specific due to equipment capabilities, ingredient sourcing, or regional formulation requirements.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.routing. Business justification: In F&B ERP/MES (SAP, Oracle), BOM and Routing are the two master data objects that together define how to manufacture a product. BOM defines WHAT materials are needed; Routing defines HOW and WHERE to

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good or semi-finished product that this BOM defines. Links to the product master data.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the detailed product specification document in the document management system (e.g., TraceGains, Veeva Vault). Contains full formulation details, processing instructions, quality parameters, and packaging specifications.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line or manufacturing cell where this BOM is executed. Nullable if the BOM is not line-specific. Used for line-specific formulations or equipment constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Work Center Configuration

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of major food allergens present in this formulation. Derived from ingredient specifications and used for labeling compliance. Examples: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who granted final approval for this BOM. Used for accountability and audit trails.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The standard batch size or production quantity for which this BOM is defined. All ingredient quantities in the BOM line items are expressed relative to this base quantity. Typically represents one production batch or one unit of finished good.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the base quantity. Defines whether the BOM is expressed per kilogram, liter, each (unit), case, or other standard measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|lb|g|oz|l|ml|gal|ea|case|pallet — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: batch_size_maximum
attributes.description: The largest production batch size that can be manufactured using this BOM. Driven by equipment capacity, mixing vessel size, or quality control limits.

attributes.name: batch_size_minimum
attributes.description: The smallest production batch size that can be manufactured using this BOM. Driven by equipment constraints, minimum order quantities (MOQ) for ingredients, or quality requirements.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the BOM, externally known and used across manufacturing, procurement, and quality systems. Unique within the manufacturing site or globally depending on business rules.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM. Draft BOMs are under development, pending approval BOMs are awaiting PLM or quality sign-off, approved BOMs have passed review, active BOMs are in production use, inactive BOMs are temporarily suspended, and obsolete BOMs are retired.

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM based on its manufacturing context. Production BOMs are for standard in-house manufacturing, co-pack BOMs are for third-party co-packing arrangements, toll manufacturing BOMs are for contract manufacturing, rework BOMs are for reprocessing, sample BOMs are for R&D samples, and trial BOMs are for new product development trials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - BOM Type Configuration

attributes.name: clean_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation meets clean label criteria, typically defined as containing only recognizable, simple ingredients without artificial additives, preservatives, or highly processed components. Used for marketing and consumer positioning.
attributes.references: Industry Best Practice - Clean Label Definition

attributes.name: contains_gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation contains genetically modified ingredients. Used for labeling compliance and consumer transparency.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Estimated cost of goods sold (COGS) for producing one base quantity of this BOM. Calculated from ingredient costs, packaging costs, and manufacturing overhead. Used for pricing, margin analysis, and product profitability.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost estimate amount. Typically the local currency of the manufacturing plant.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems - Record Control

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM version is no longer valid for production. Nullable for currently active BOMs with no planned end date. Used for phasing out old formulations and managing product transitions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM version becomes valid and can be used for production planning and manufacturing execution. Supports BOM versioning and change management.

attributes.name: haccp_critical_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Critical Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM contains HACCP critical control points that require monitoring and documentation during production. Used for food safety management and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA HACCP Principles and Application Guidelines

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation is certified halal by a recognized halal certification body. Requires ingredient compliance with Islamic dietary laws and manufacturing process oversight.
attributes.references: Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America (IFANCA) Standards

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation is certified kosher by a recognized kosher certification agency. Requires ingredient compliance and manufacturing process oversight.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems - Record Control

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special instructions, formulation rationale, or change history notes. Used by R&D, quality, and operations teams for context and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation meets organic certification standards (e.g., USDA Organic, EU Organic). Requires all ingredients to be certified organic and manufacturing processes to comply with organic handling requirements.

attributes.name: plm_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the BOM received final PLM approval. Nullable for BOMs that have not yet been approved.

attributes.name: plm_approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status from the PLM system indicating whether this BOM has passed cross-functional review by R&D, quality, regulatory, and operations teams. Required before a BOM can be activated for production.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation requires pre-market regulatory approval or notification before production and sale. Applicable for novel ingredients, health claims, or regulated product categories.

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: The date when this BOM revision was created or last modified. Used for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the BOM. Incremented each time the formulation is changed. Supports traceability and change history for regulatory compliance and quality management.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Expected shelf life of the finished product produced from this BOM, measured in days from production date. Used for inventory management, distribution planning, and expiration date calculation.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the finished product to maintain quality and safety throughout its shelf life. Examples: ambient, refrigerated 2-8C, frozen below -18C, protect from light, keep dry.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Expected production yield as a percentage of input materials. Accounts for normal manufacturing losses, evaporation, spillage, and waste. Used for material planning and cost calculations. A yield of 95.00 means 95% of input materials result in finished product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Order Yield

products.name: bom_line
products.description: Individual component line within a Bill of Materials (BOM), specifying each raw material, ingredient, flavoring, preservative, or packaging component required to produce one batch of the parent SKU. Captures component item number, quantity per base UOM, scrap/yield factor, component category (raw material, packaging, label, co-product), lead-offset, and whether the component is a critical allergen. Enables COGS calculation, procurement planning, and allergen matrix derivation.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA BOM Component (PP-BD-BOM)

attributes.name: bom_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the BOM line entity.

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.approved_vendor_list. Business justification: During BOM validation and MRP planning, procurement teams verify each BOM line component against the AVL to ensure only approved suppliers are used. This link enforces approved-source compliance per c

attributes.name: bill_of_materials_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent BOM header that this line belongs to. Links the component to the finished good SKU.

attributes.name: primary_bom_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the primary or preferred supplier for this component, used for procurement planning and vendor management.

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_contract. Business justification: Each BOM line component is sourced under a specific purchase contract governing price, quality, and availability. Buyers use this link during MRP and procurement planning to verify contract coverage f

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ingredient.raw_material. Business justification: BOM line items in F&B directly reference raw material ingredients. This link drives allergen management, cost rollup, and regulatory compliance reporting. Every F&B domain expert expects bom_line comp

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Each BOM line item (ingredient/component) has an incoming quality specification — moisture content, particle size, microbial limits for raw materials. F&B procurement and quality teams use this link f

attributes.name: allergen_type
attributes.description: Specific allergen classification if critical_allergen_flag is true (e.g., milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, wheat, fish, shellfish, sesame). Multiple allergens separated by semicolon.

attributes.name: base_uom
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for the component quantity (e.g., KG, LB, L, GAL, EA, M, FT).

attributes.name: bom_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line (active, inactive, pending approval, obsolete).

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: The engineering change order or product lifecycle management (PLM) change number that authorized this BOM line modification, used for traceability and compliance.

attributes.name: component_category
attributes.description: Classification of the component type within the BOM structure (e.g., raw material, ingredient, packaging, label, co-product). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|ingredient|flavoring|preservative|packaging|label|co_product|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the component cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard cost per base unit of measure for this component, used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where this component is sourced or manufactured, used for regulatory compliance and supply chain transparency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_allergen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component contains or is derived from a major food allergen (milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame) requiring allergen matrix tracking and labeling compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM line is no longer effective, used for component phase-out and reformulation management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line becomes effective and should be used in production planning and execution.

attributes.name: gluten_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is certified gluten-free (less than 20 ppm gluten), used for gluten-free product formulation and FDA labeling compliance.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is certified halal per Islamic dietary law, used for halal product manufacturing and labeling.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and disposal procedures.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is certified kosher by a recognized kosher certification agency, used for kosher product manufacturing and labeling.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: The number of days before production start that this component must be available, used for procurement planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent BOM, used for ordering and referencing specific components in the bill of materials.

attributes.name: lot_size_multiple
attributes.description: The lot size increment in which this component must be ordered (e.g., multiples of 100 units), used for procurement planning.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity required by the supplier for this component, used for procurement planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: non_gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is verified as non-GMO, used for clean label claims and consumer transparency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions related to this component, such as handling requirements, substitution rules, or quality specifications.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is certified organic per USDA National Organic Program standards, used for organic product certification and labeling.

attributes.name: quantity_per_base_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quantity Per Base Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: The quantity of this component required to produce one unit of the parent finished good, expressed in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percent
attributes.description: The expected scrap or waste percentage for this component during production, used to adjust procurement quantities.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The shelf life of this component in days from receipt, used for First Expired First Out (FEFO) inventory management and quality control.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this component (e.g., ambient, refrigerated, frozen, controlled temperature, dry) to maintain quality and safety.

attributes.name: vegan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is free from all animal-derived ingredients, used for vegan product formulation and labeling.

attributes.name: yield_factor_percent
attributes.description: The expected yield percentage for this component, representing the usable output relative to input quantity.

products.name: formulation
products.description: Approved product formulation and recipe specification managed through PLM and TraceGains. Captures formulation code, version, formulation type (bench, pilot, commercial), target Brix, target pH, target viscosity, moisture content, water activity (Aw), processing parameters (pasteurization temperature/time, homogenization pressure), yield percentage, batch size, and regulatory approval status. Distinct from BOM in that it captures the scientific/R&D specification rather than the manufacturing component list.
products.reference: TraceGains Specification Management

attributes.name: formulation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product formulation record. Primary key for the formulation entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: F&B R&D formulation costs (ingredients, lab trials, regulatory testing) are tracked to R&D cost centers for budget vs. actual reporting and capitalization decisions. Finance controllers require formul

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Formulations are validated and approved for specific manufacturing plants based on equipment capabilities (UHT, retort, homogenization). Regulatory submissions (FDA, USDA) are plant-specific. F&B qual

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Formulation approval is tied to regulatory product registration; linking enables traceability of approved formulations to their registration.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good SKU that this formulation produces. Links formulation to the product master.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of major allergens present in this formulation per FDA/FALCPA requirements: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame. Used for labeling and compliance.
attributes.references: Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the R&D scientist, quality manager, or regulatory specialist who approved this formulation for production use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this formulation was formally approved for production. Critical for compliance and traceability.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Standard production batch size for this formulation in kilograms or liters. Used for scaling ingredient quantities and production planning.

attributes.name: batch_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for batch size: kg (kilogram), L (liter), gal (gallon), lb (pound).

attributes.name: clean_label_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation meets clean label criteria (no artificial ingredients, preservatives, or additives). True if compliant, False otherwise.

attributes.name: cooling_temperature
attributes.description: Target cooling temperature in degrees Celsius after thermal processing. Critical for product safety and quality preservation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this formulation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this formulation version becomes effective for production use. Used for version control and transition planning.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this formulation version is no longer valid for production. Null for active formulations without planned obsolescence.

attributes.name: formulation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to this formulation specification. Used across R&D, PLM, and manufacturing systems.

attributes.name: formulation_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the formulation specification. Typically includes product name and variant descriptor.

attributes.name: formulation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the formulation: draft (in development), under_review (pending approval), approved (ready for use), active (in production), obsolete (no longer used), superseded (replaced by newer version).

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formulation stage: bench (lab-scale R&D), pilot (pilot plant trial), commercial (approved for production), experimental (early research), prototype (concept validation), scale_up (transitioning to commercial scale).

attributes.name: gluten_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation meets gluten-free standards (less than 20 ppm gluten per FDA). True if gluten-free, False otherwise.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation is halal certified per recognized halal certification authority. True if certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: holding_time
attributes.description: Required holding time in minutes at specified temperature or condition before next processing step. Critical for chemical reactions, flavor development, or safety.

attributes.name: homogenization_pressure
attributes.description: Target homogenization pressure in pounds per square inch (PSI) for emulsion stability and particle size reduction. Critical for dairy and beverage products.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation is kosher certified per recognized kosher certification authority. True if certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: mixing_speed
attributes.description: Target mixing speed in revolutions per minute (RPM) for blending operations. Critical for achieving proper dispersion and emulsification.

attributes.name: mixing_time
attributes.description: Required mixing or blending time in minutes to achieve homogeneous formulation. Critical process parameter for quality consistency.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this formulation record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: moisture_content_target
attributes.description: Target moisture content as percentage of total weight. Critical for shelf life, texture, and microbial stability in dry and semi-moist products.

attributes.name: non_gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation is verified non-GMO per Non-GMO Project or equivalent standards. True if non-GMO, False otherwise.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation is certified organic per USDA NOP or equivalent standards. True if certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: pasteurization_temperature
attributes.description: Target pasteurization temperature in degrees Celsius for thermal processing. Critical control point (CCP) under HACCP for pathogen elimination.
attributes.references: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) - Thermal Processing

attributes.name: pasteurization_time
attributes.description: Target pasteurization hold time in seconds at specified temperature. Critical control point (CCP) under HACCP for achieving required lethality.
attributes.references: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) - Thermal Processing

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval was granted for this formulation. Required for compliance tracking and audit trails.
attributes.references: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) - Approval Documentation

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status for this formulation: pending (under review), approved (cleared for production), rejected (not approved), conditional (approved with restrictions), not_required (no regulatory review needed).
attributes.references: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) - Food Facility Registration

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority that approved this formulation: FDA (US Food and Drug Administration), USDA (US Department of Agriculture), EFSA (European Food Safety Authority), FSANZ (Food Standards Australia New Zealand), Health_Canada, ANVISA (Brazil).
attributes.references: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) - Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: target_brix
attributes.description: Target sugar content measurement in degrees Brix for this formulation. Critical quality parameter for beverages and sweet products. Measured as percentage of dissolved solids.

attributes.name: target_ph_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable pH (acidity/alkalinity) level for this formulation. Critical for food safety, shelf life, and organoleptic properties. Scale 0-14.
attributes.references: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - pH Control

attributes.name: target_ph_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable pH (acidity/alkalinity) level for this formulation. Critical for food safety, shelf life, and organoleptic properties. Scale 0-14.
attributes.references: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - pH Control

attributes.name: target_viscosity
attributes.description: Target viscosity measurement for this formulation in centipoise (cP). Critical for product texture, mouthfeel, and processing characteristics.

attributes.name: vegan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulation contains no animal-derived ingredients or by-products. True if vegan, False otherwise.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this formulation specification. Incremented with each revision or reformulation. Format: major.minor (e.g., 1.0, 2.3).

attributes.name: viscosity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for viscosity specification: cP (centipoise), mPa·s (millipascal-second), Pa·s (pascal-second).

attributes.name: water_activity_aw
attributes.description: Target water activity (Aw) level for this formulation. Scale 0.0-1.0. Critical food safety parameter controlling microbial growth. Values below 0.85 inhibit most pathogens.
attributes.references: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - Water Activity Control

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Expected yield percentage from raw materials to finished product. Accounts for processing losses, evaporation, and waste. Used for cost calculation and material planning.

products.name: nutritional_panel
products.description: Regulatory nutritional facts panel data for each SKU per applicable jurisdiction (FDA Nutrition Facts, EU Nutrition Declaration, Health Canada). Captures serving size, servings per container, calories, total fat, saturated fat, trans fat, cholesterol, sodium, total carbohydrate, dietary fiber, total sugars, added sugars, protein, and all required vitamins/minerals with % Daily Value. Tracks panel version, effective date, regulatory jurisdiction, and FDA/USDA submission reference. Critical for FSMA compliance and retailer item setup.
products.reference: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Nutrition Labeling

attributes.name: nutritional_panel_id
attributes.description: Primary key for nutritional_panel

attributes.name: formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.formulation. Business justification: In F&B PLM, nutritional facts panels are derived from and must be traceable to the specific approved formulation version they were calculated from. When a formulation changes (e.g., ingredient substit

attributes.name: nutrition_label_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.nutrition_label. Business justification: The internal nutritional panel (product spec) drives the regulatory nutrition label submission. Regulatory affairs teams reconcile internal panel data against the submitted regulatory nutrition label

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Nutritional panels must align with regulatory product registration data for compliance reporting and label generation.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU for which this nutritional panel applies. Links to the product SKU master data.

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Nutritional panel values (fat%, protein%, sodium) must be validated against quality specifications through laboratory analysis. FDA 21 CFR Part 101 requires nutritional label accuracy within analytica

attributes.name: added_sugars_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for added sugars per serving.

attributes.name: added_sugars_grams
attributes.description: Added sugar content per serving, expressed in grams. Required under updated FDA regulations (2016+).

attributes.name: allergen_statement
attributes.description: Full allergen declaration statement as it appears on the nutritional panel or label (e.g., Contains: Milk, Soy, Wheat). Critical for food safety and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this nutritional panel was formally approved for use on product packaging and labeling.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the regulatory affairs or quality assurance personnel who approved this nutritional panel for use.

attributes.name: calcium_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for calcium per serving.

attributes.name: calcium_milligrams
attributes.description: Calcium content per serving, expressed in milligrams. Mandatory nutrient under updated FDA regulations.

attributes.name: calories_from_fat
attributes.description: Calories derived from fat per serving. Required in some jurisdictions (e.g., older FDA format), optional in others.

attributes.name: calories_per_serving
attributes.description: Total caloric energy per serving, expressed in kilocalories (kcal).

attributes.name: cholesterol_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for cholesterol per serving.

attributes.name: cholesterol_milligrams
attributes.description: Cholesterol content per serving, expressed in milligrams.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this nutritional panel record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dietary_fiber_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for dietary fiber per serving.

attributes.name: dietary_fiber_grams
attributes.description: Dietary fiber content per serving, expressed in grams.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this nutritional panel version becomes effective and must be used on product packaging and labeling.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this nutritional panel version is no longer valid and must be replaced. Nullable for current active panels.

attributes.name: fda_submission_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) Submission Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the FDA submission or notification associated with this nutritional panel. Critical for FSMA compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: ingredient_statement
attributes.description: Full ingredient list as it appears on the nutritional panel or label, in descending order of predominance by weight.

attributes.name: iron_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for iron per serving.

attributes.name: iron_milligrams
attributes.description: Iron content per serving, expressed in milligrams. Mandatory nutrient under updated FDA regulations.

attributes.name: lab_analysis_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the third-party laboratory analysis report that substantiates the nutritional values declared on this panel.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this nutritional panel record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: monounsaturated_fat_grams
attributes.description: Monounsaturated fat content per serving, expressed in grams. Voluntary declaration in most jurisdictions.

attributes.name: panel_format_standard
attributes.description: The regulatory format standard that this nutritional panel follows (e.g., FDA Nutrition Facts, EU Nutrition Declaration, Health Canada Nutrition Facts).
attributes.value_regex: FDA Nutrition Facts|EU Nutrition Declaration|Health Canada Nutrition Facts|Codex|LATAM|APAC Custom
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 101.9, EU Regulation 1169/2011, Health Canada Food and Drug Regulations

attributes.name: panel_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the nutritional panel record (draft, pending approval, approved, active, superseded, retired).

attributes.name: panel_version
attributes.description: Version number of the nutritional panel to track changes over time due to formulation updates or regulatory changes. Format: major.minor (e.g., 1.0, 1.1, 2.0).

attributes.name: polyunsaturated_fat_grams
attributes.description: Polyunsaturated fat content per serving, expressed in grams. Voluntary declaration in most jurisdictions.

attributes.name: potassium_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for potassium per serving.

attributes.name: potassium_milligrams
attributes.description: Potassium content per serving, expressed in milligrams. Mandatory nutrient under updated FDA regulations.

attributes.name: protein_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for protein per serving. Optional unless a protein claim is made.

attributes.name: protein_grams
attributes.description: Protein content per serving, expressed in grams.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Country or regulatory jurisdiction for which this nutritional panel is formatted and compliant. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|BRA|GBR|DEU|FRA|ITA|ESP|AUS|JPN|CHN|IND — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rounding_method
attributes.description: The rounding methodology applied to nutritional values per regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA Standard, EU Standard, Custom).

attributes.name: saturated_fat_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for saturated fat per serving.

attributes.name: saturated_fat_grams
attributes.description: Saturated fat content per serving, expressed in grams.

attributes.name: serving_size
attributes.description: The standardized serving size for this product as displayed on the nutritional panel, including unit of measure (e.g., 1 cup (240 mL), 2 cookies (30g)).

attributes.name: serving_size_grams
attributes.description: Numeric serving size expressed in grams for standardized analysis and comparison across products.

attributes.name: servings_per_container
attributes.description: Number of servings contained in the package. May be a decimal for products with variable servings (e.g., about 2.5).

attributes.name: sodium_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for sodium per serving.

attributes.name: sodium_milligrams
attributes.description: Sodium content per serving, expressed in milligrams.

attributes.name: sugar_alcohols_grams
attributes.description: Sugar alcohol content per serving, expressed in grams. Voluntary declaration unless a sugar-related claim is made.

attributes.name: total_carbohydrate_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for total carbohydrate per serving.

attributes.name: total_carbohydrate_grams
attributes.description: Total carbohydrate content per serving, expressed in grams.

attributes.name: total_fat_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for total fat per serving, based on a 2,000 calorie diet (FDA) or reference intake (EU).

attributes.name: total_fat_grams
attributes.description: Total fat content per serving, expressed in grams.

attributes.name: total_sugars_grams
attributes.description: Total sugar content per serving, expressed in grams. Includes naturally occurring and added sugars.

attributes.name: trans_fat_grams
attributes.description: Trans fat content per serving, expressed in grams. Must be declared even if no daily value is established.

attributes.name: usda_submission_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: USDA (United States Department of Agriculture) Submission Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the USDA submission or approval associated with this nutritional panel, applicable for meat, poultry, and egg products.

attributes.name: vitamin_a_iu
attributes.description: Vitamin A content per serving, expressed in international units. Voluntary under updated FDA regulations but may be required in other jurisdictions.

attributes.name: vitamin_c_milligrams
attributes.description: Vitamin C content per serving, expressed in milligrams. Voluntary under updated FDA regulations but may be required in other jurisdictions.

attributes.name: vitamin_d_dv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the daily value for Vitamin D per serving.

attributes.name: vitamin_d_micrograms
attributes.description: Vitamin D content per serving, expressed in micrograms. Mandatory nutrient under updated FDA regulations.

products.name: packaging_spec
products.description: Packaging specification for each SKU covering primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging. Captures packaging material type (PET, HDPE, glass, aluminum, paperboard, flexible film), container dimensions (height, width, depth, diameter), net weight, gross weight, fill volume, closure type, label panel count, recyclability code, PCR (post-consumer recycled) content percentage, shelf-ready packaging (SRP) configuration, and pallet pattern. Used for sustainability reporting, logistics cube optimization, and retailer compliance.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Packaging Data

attributes.name: packaging_spec_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the packaging specification record.

attributes.name: packaging_compliance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.packaging_compliance. Business justification: Packaging compliance verification requires each packaging spec to reference the compliance record for material and recycling regulations.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_line. Business justification: Packaging specs define container dimensions, fill volumes, and closure types that constrain which production lines are qualified to run them. F&B production planners and packaging engineers explicitly

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the SKU this packaging specification applies to.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supplier providing the packaging materials or components.

attributes.name: barrier_properties
attributes.description: Description of the packaging barrier characteristics (oxygen barrier, moisture barrier, light barrier, gas barrier) critical for shelf life preservation.
attributes.references: ASTM F1927 - Oxygen Transmission Rate Testing

attributes.name: bio_based_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of bio-based or renewable material content in the packaging, supporting clean label and sustainability initiatives.

attributes.name: bpa_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging is free from Bisphenol A (BPA), supporting clean label and consumer health claims.
attributes.references: FDA - BPA in Food Packaging Guidance

attributes.name: cases_per_layer
attributes.description: Number of cases in one horizontal layer on a pallet, used for pallet pattern optimization and warehouse slotting.
attributes.references: ISO 6780 - Flat Pallets for Intercontinental Materials Handling

attributes.name: child_resistant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging meets child-resistant packaging standards per CPSC regulations (applicable for certain products).

attributes.name: closure_type
attributes.description: Type of closure or sealing mechanism (e.g., screw cap, snap lid, pull tab, peel seal, twist-off, cork, pump dispenser).

attributes.name: compostable_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging is certified compostable per ASTM D6400 or EN 13432 standards.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Specific form of the packaging container (e.g., bottle, can, pouch, jar, tray, carton, bag, tube).

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard cost of one packaging unit in the company's base currency, used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging specification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per unit (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: depth_mm
attributes.description: Depth of the packaging container in millimeters, used for logistics cube optimization and planogram design.

attributes.name: diameter_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of cylindrical packaging containers in millimeters (applicable for bottles, cans, jars).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this packaging specification became or will become active for production use.

attributes.name: fill_volume_ml
attributes.description: Nominal fill volume of liquid or semi-liquid products in milliliters, as declared on the label.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 101.105 - Net Quantity of Contents

attributes.name: food_contact_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging material is approved for direct food contact per FDA and EU regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 170-189 - Food Additives, EU Regulation 1935/2004

attributes.name: freezer_safe_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging is suitable for freezer storage without material degradation or product quality loss.
attributes.references: ASTM D1790 - Brittleness Temperature of Plastic Film

attributes.name: gross_weight_g
attributes.description: Total weight including product and packaging in grams, used for freight cost calculation and logistics planning.

attributes.name: height_mm
attributes.description: Height of the packaging container in millimeters, used for logistics cube optimization and planogram design.

attributes.name: label_panel_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct label panels on the packaging (front, back, side panels) used for regulatory compliance and marketing content.

attributes.name: layers_per_pallet
attributes.description: Number of vertical layers stacked on a standard pallet, used for pallet pattern optimization and transportation planning.
attributes.references: ISO 6780 - Flat Pallets for Intercontinental Materials Handling

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Primary material composition of the packaging component (e.g., PET, HDPE, glass, aluminum, paperboard, flexible film). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PET|HDPE|LDPE|PP|PS|PVC|glass|aluminum|steel|paperboard|corrugated|flexible_film|multi_layer_laminate|biodegradable — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 11469 - Plastics Generic Identification and Marking

attributes.name: microwave_safe_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging is certified safe for microwave heating, relevant for Ready-to-Eat (RTE) products.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging specification record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_weight_g
attributes.description: Net weight of the product content excluding packaging in grams, as declared on the nutritional panel.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 101.105 - Net Quantity of Contents

attributes.name: obsolete_date
attributes.description: Date when this packaging specification was or will be retired from active use.

attributes.name: packaging_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of packaging: primary (consumer unit), secondary (case/carton), tertiary (pallet), or display (shelf-ready packaging).

attributes.name: packaging_spec_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the packaging specification in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.

attributes.name: pallet_pattern
attributes.description: Description of the case arrangement pattern on the pallet (e.g., column stack, interlocked, pinwheel) for load stability and cube optimization.
