attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: FSMA requires traceability to the specific supplier manufacturing site for each replenishment order. Site-level data (lead time, food safety cert, capacity) affects order planning. replenishment_order

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods were physically received at the destination location (goods receipt posting date). Used to calculate On Time In Full (OTIF) performance, lead time actuals, and delivery variance against requested and confirmed dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt Date (MIGO); OTIF KPI

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: The Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) number transmitted by the supplier or source location confirming shipment of this replenishment order. Enables proactive receiving dock scheduling, WMS pre-receipt processing, and shipment tracking. Transmitted via EDI 856.
attributes.references: EDI 856 ASN Standard; GS1 Supply Chain Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM — Inbound Delivery

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier or supplying location. May differ from requested_delivery_date. Used to calculate delivery date variance, assess OTIF risk, and trigger escalation workflows when confirmation is later than requested.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Confirmed Delivery Date; EDI 855

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity confirmed by the supplier or supplying location as available and committed for fulfillment. May differ from ordered_quantity due to partial availability, capacity constraints, or MOQ adjustments. Used for supply-demand gap analysis and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Confirmed Quantity; EDI 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgment

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this replenishment order record was first captured in the data platform. Distinct from order_date (business event time). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of data freshness. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA MM — Change Document

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the unit_cost and total_order_value are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency procurement and financial consolidation across global operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the batch being replenished. Used to enforce FEFO rotation policy, calculate shelf_life_days_remaining, and ensure compliance with customer minimum remaining shelf life requirements. Critical for food safety and waste reduction.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117; Codex Alimentarius — Food Labeling; ISO 22000

attributes.name: ibp_plan_version
attributes.description: The SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) plan version or S&OP cycle version under which this replenishment order was generated (e.g., 'BASELINE_2024Q3', 'CONSENSUS_V2'). Enables comparison of supply proposals across planning scenarios and IBP consensus cycles.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Integrated Business Planning; S&OP Process

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The planned lead time in calendar days from order release to expected goods receipt at the destination location. Derived from the purchasing info record or supply planning parameters. Used for replenishment timing calculations, safety stock parameter setting, and supply planning optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record Lead Time; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: moq_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ordered_quantity meets or exceeds the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) requirement for this material-supplier combination. True = compliant; False = below MOQ threshold, requiring buyer review or rounding up before release.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — MOQ Check; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: The Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) applicable to this replenishment order as defined in the purchasing info record or supply planning parameters. Ensures ordered_quantity meets supplier or logistics minimum thresholds. Critical for procurement compliance and cost optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record (EINA/EINE); MOQ Policy

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: The MRP controller code or planner identifier responsible for managing the replenishment of this material at the source plant. Used for workload assignment, exception management, and accountability tracking in supply planning operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — MRP Controller (DISPO); MD04 MRP List

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, buyer comments, exception explanations, or special handling instructions associated with this replenishment order. Used by supply planners and procurement teams to document non-standard situations, escalations, or supplier communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Text

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the replenishment order was created or generated by the MRP/supply planning system. Represents the principal real-world event time for this transaction. Used for aging analysis, lead time calculation, and OTIF measurement baseline. Maps to BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — ME21N Order Date; SAP IBP Demand Sensing

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the replenishment order as assigned by the ERP or supply planning system (e.g., SAP purchase order number, stock transport order number, or MRP planned order number). Used for cross-system traceability and communication with suppliers and logistics partners. Maps to BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — ME21N / MD04; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the replenishment order. Tracks progression from MRP-generated planned order through firming, release to warehouse/supplier, in-transit movement, and final goods receipt. Cancelled indicates the order was voided before fulfillment. Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Stock Transport Order Status; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment order by its procurement mechanism. Stock Transfer Order (STO) moves inventory between internal plants or DCs. Purchase Requisition is a request to procure from an external supplier. Planned Order is an MRP-generated supply proposal. Purchase Order is a confirmed external procurement. Intercompany Transfer moves goods between legal entities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock_transfer_order|purchase_requisition|planned_order|purchase_order|intercompany_transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Order Type Configuration; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material requested in the replenishment order, expressed in the base unit of measure (e.g., cases, pallets, kg). This is the gross supply proposal quantity generated by MRP or supply planning before any MOQ rounding or adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Order Quantity (MENGE); SAP IBP Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: planned_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which goods are to be issued from the source location (outbound shipment departure). Used for outbound logistics scheduling, warehouse pick/pack planning, and lead time calculation between goods issue and goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Planned Goods Issue Date (STO); JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: planning_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the MRP or supply planning run that generated this replenishment order. Enables traceability of supply proposals back to the specific planning cycle, demand signal, and parameter set used. Supports audit of planning decisions and scenario comparison.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — MRP Run (MD01/MD02); SAP IBP Planning Run

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the replenishment order to govern fulfillment sequencing when supply is constrained. Critical = immediate action required (e.g., stockout risk); High = elevated urgency; Medium = standard planning cycle; Low = opportunistic or forward-buy.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning — Priority; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: quality_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order or the associated batch is subject to a quality hold that prevents goods receipt or putaway at the destination. True = quality hold active; False = no hold. Integrates with QM module and HACCP/GMP compliance processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Quality Hold; HACCP; GMP; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of material received at the destination location upon goods receipt. Used to calculate fill rate, identify short shipments, and trigger OTIF performance measurement against the confirmed quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt (MIGO); OTIF Measurement

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the replenishment order is required to arrive at the destination location to meet demand or safety stock targets. Drives supplier scheduling, transportation booking, and OTIF measurement. Set by supply planning based on demand signals and inventory parameters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Delivery Date; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: rotation_policy
attributes.description: The inventory rotation policy applicable to this replenishment order. FIFO (First In First Out) = oldest stock consumed first; FEFO (First Expired First Out) = stock with earliest expiry date consumed first (critical for perishable food and beverage products); LIFO (Last In First Out) = rarely used in food industry.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117 — FSMA; GFSI; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: safety_stock_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order was triggered by a safety stock breach (projected inventory falling below safety stock level) rather than a standard demand-driven replenishment signal. True = safety stock replenishment; False = demand-driven or scheduled replenishment.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization — Safety Stock; SAP S/4HANA MM — MRP Safety Stock

attributes.name: shelf_life_days_remaining
attributes.description: The number of days of remaining shelf life on the material at the time of order creation, based on the production date and expiry date of the batch being replenished. Critical for FEFO compliance, quality assurance, and ensuring product arrives at destination with sufficient remaining shelf life to meet customer requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117; ISO 22000; GFSI — Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: total_order_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the replenishment order calculated as ordered_quantity multiplied by unit_cost. Used for procurement spend analysis, inventory investment tracking, and financial planning. Expressed in the order currency. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Value; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transportation used to move the replenishment order from source to destination location. Drives freight cost estimation, lead time calculation, and carbon footprint reporting for sustainability compliance.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The standard or purchase cost per unit of measure for the material in this replenishment order. Used to calculate total order value, Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) impact, and inventory valuation. Classified as confidential as it reflects procurement pricing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Standard Cost; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which ordered, confirmed, and received quantities are expressed (e.g., CS=Cases, EA=Each, KG=Kilograms, LB=Pounds, PAL=Pallets, L=Liters, GAL=Gallons). Aligns with the material master UOM configuration in SAP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CS|EA|KG|LB|PAL|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure (MEINS)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this replenishment order record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks changes to order quantity, status, dates, or routing. Used for incremental data processing and audit compliance. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA MM — Change Document

products.name: safety_stock_policy
products.description: Inventory buffer policy defining safety stock levels and reorder parameters per SKU per location across the DC network. Captures safety stock quantity, safety days of supply, reorder point, maximum stock level, min/max replenishment bands, and calculation method (statistical, manual, days-of-supply). Governs when replenishment is triggered and how much buffer inventory is maintained to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty.
products.reference: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization / Safety Stock

attributes.name: safety_stock_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the safety stock policy record. Primary key for the safety_stock_policy data product in the supply domain.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Safety‑stock policies are often set per brand to mitigate demand spikes generated by brand‑specific marketing promotions.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: In F&B, safety stock policies are elevated for specific marketing campaigns (is_promotional=true). Linking to the specific campaign that triggered the policy change enables campaign ROI analysis (incr

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Sales contracts with minimum service level commitments (e.g., 98.5% fill rate) directly govern safety stock policy parameters. Contract-driven inventory policy management is a named F&B process — plan

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Track safety‑stock holding costs against the cost center responsible for inventory.

attributes.name: finance_standard_cost_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_standard_cost. Business justification: Safety stock valuation: finance values safety stock inventory using standard costs; the policy defines the quantity, the standard cost record provides the unit value for balance sheet working capital

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Safety stock policies are reviewed and approved within fiscal periods; finance uses safety stock levels to calculate working capital requirements per period for balance sheet planning. effective_date

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.market. Business justification: Safety stock policies in global F&B are market-specific — service_level_target_pct, lead_time_days, and demand_variability_factor differ by market. A domain expert expects safety_stock_policy to be ma

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DC (Distribution Center) or warehouse location where this safety stock policy applies. Supports multi-node DC network and 3PL partner locations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning Network

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Safety‑stock calculations must respect product‑specific regulatory limits (e.g., maximum allowable stock for allergen‑controlled items).

attributes.name: promotion_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_plan. Business justification: F&B supply planners create promotion-specific safety stock policies (is_promotional=true) tied to a specific promotion plan, setting elevated safety stock targets for SKUs during promotional windows.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: In F&B, safety stock policies are differentiated by customer segment — higher service level targets for key grocery accounts vs. foodservice or DTC. Linking segment_id enables segment-driven policy co

attributes.name: shelf_life_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.shelf_life_spec. Business justification: Safety stock policy configuration in F&B directly depends on shelf life specs: remaining_shelf_life_min_pct, rotation_policy (FEFO), and safety_days_of_supply are all governed by the shelf_life_spec.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) governed by this safety stock policy. Links to the product master to identify the specific finished good or semi-finished item.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 GTIN Standard

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.sop_cycle. Business justification: Safety stock policies are reviewed, approved, and updated during S&OP cycles. The sop_cycle governs the IBP/S&OP process including safety_stock_review_flag. Adding sop_cycle_id to safety_stock_policy

attributes.name: spec_quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Safety‑stock calculations depend on product specs (shelf‑life, storage) defined in SPECIFICATION; required for inventory planning reports.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Safety stock policies in F&B are defined at the storage location level because ambient, chilled, and frozen locations have fundamentally different lead times, variability factors, and shelf-life const

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC classification of the SKU based on demand volume or revenue contribution. 'A' items are high-value/high-velocity requiring tighter safety stock management; 'C' items are low-velocity with broader buffers. Used to prioritize inventory management effort.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this safety stock policy was formally approved by the designated supply chain authority. Part of the S&OP governance and change management audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 9001

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to derive the safety stock quantity. 'statistical' uses demand variability and service level targets; 'days_of_supply' uses a fixed days-of-supply multiplier; 'manual' is planner-set; 'min_max' uses min/max replenishment bands; 'demand_driven' uses demand sensing signals from SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for the most recent change to this safety stock policy (e.g., 'Seasonal uplift for Q4 holiday demand', 'Supplier lead time increase', 'Post-launch NPD recalibration'). Required for audit and S&OP governance.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 9001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety stock policy record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning

attributes.name: demand_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of forward-looking days of demand used in the safety stock calculation. Defines the planning horizon over which demand variability is measured for statistical safety stock methods.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: demand_variability_factor
attributes.description: Standard deviation or coefficient of variation of demand used in statistical safety stock calculations. Derived from historical demand sensing data in SAP IBP. Higher values result in larger safety stock buffers.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this safety stock policy becomes binding and governs replenishment decisions for the SKU-location combination. Aligns with IBP/S&OP planning cycle activation.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 22000 Supply Chain Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this safety stock policy ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended policy with no planned expiration. Used to manage seasonal or promotional policy windows.

attributes.name: ibp_policy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Policy ID
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this safety stock policy record in SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning). Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the SAP IBP operational system.

attributes.name: is_new_product
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety stock policy applies to a new product introduction (NPD/NPI). New products typically use manual or days-of-supply methods due to absence of historical demand data. Triggers enhanced monitoring during launch phase.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; NPD; PLM

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy includes a promotional uplift buffer to support planned trade promotions (TPM/TPO events). When True, additional safety stock is pre-positioned at the DC ahead of promotional periods.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning; TPM

attributes.name: is_seasonal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety stock policy incorporates seasonal demand adjustments. When True, the safety stock quantity and days of supply parameters are adjusted based on seasonal demand patterns from the demand planning system.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: jda_policy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning Policy ID
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this safety stock policy record in JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning. Populated when JDA is the system of record for replenishment planning at the DC network level.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this safety stock policy was last reviewed by the supply planning team. Supports periodic review cadence governance within the IBP/S&OP cycle. Policies not reviewed within the review cycle may be flagged for recalibration.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average replenishment lead time in days from order placement to receipt at the DC location. Used in reorder point and statistical safety stock calculations. Sourced from supplier SLA agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SLA

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days
attributes.description: Standard deviation of replenishment lead time in days. Used in statistical safety stock calculations to account for supply uncertainty. Higher variability increases the required safety stock buffer.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: max_stock_qty
attributes.description: Maximum allowable on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the location. Defines the upper bound of the min/max replenishment band. Replenishment orders are sized to bring inventory up to this level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: min_stock_qty
attributes.description: Minimum allowable on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the location. Defines the lower bound of the min/max replenishment band. Replenishment is triggered when inventory falls to or below this level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity constraint applied to replenishment orders for this SKU-location policy. Sourced from supplier agreements or manufacturing run minimums. Replenishment orders cannot be placed below this quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this safety stock policy. Drives the supply planning review calendar and ensures policies remain calibrated to current demand and supply conditions.

attributes.name: planning_segment
attributes.description: Supply chain planning segment classification for the SKU-location combination. Determines the applicable replenishment and safety stock strategy. 'make_to_stock' is most common for CPG/food and beverage finished goods.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this safety stock policy record across systems (e.g., SAP IBP, JDA/Blue Yonder). Used for cross-system reconciliation and EDI references.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the safety stock policy, typically referencing the SKU, location, or planning segment it governs (e.g., 'RTD Beverage - DC East - Statistical SS').

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety stock policy. 'active' means the policy is live and governing replenishment; 'draft' means under configuration; 'pending_review' means awaiting S&OP approval; 'suspended' means temporarily disabled.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the safety stock policy record, incremented each time the policy parameters are updated. Supports policy change history tracking and audit trail requirements within the supply planning governance framework.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: remaining_shelf_life_min_pct
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable remaining shelf life percentage at time of receipt or shipment from the DC. Ensures safety stock inventory meets customer and retailer freshness requirements. Expressed as a percentage of total shelf life (e.g., 66.67 means at least 2/3 of shelf life must remain).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; GFSI; ISO 22000; Codex Alimentarius; GMP

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment order is triggered for the SKU at the specified location. Calculated as safety stock plus expected demand during replenishment lead time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: replenishment_qty
attributes.description: Standard replenishment order quantity triggered when the reorder point is reached. May be constrained by MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) or pallet/layer rounding rules from the supplier or DC network.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: Frequency in days at which inventory position is reviewed and replenishment decisions are made. Relevant for periodic review systems. Impacts the safety stock calculation for periodic review models.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: rotation_policy
attributes.description: Inventory rotation rule applied at the DC location for this SKU. FIFO (First In First Out) is standard for ambient products; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is mandatory for perishable, chilled, and frozen food and beverage products to minimize waste and ensure food safety compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; GFSI; ISO 22000; HACCP; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: safety_days_of_supply
attributes.description: Safety stock expressed as number of days of forward demand coverage. Used when calculation_method is 'days_of_supply'. Provides a demand-relative buffer measure aligned with FIFO/FEFO rotation policies.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: safety_factor
attributes.description: Statistical safety factor (z-score) corresponding to the target service level. Applied to demand and lead time variability to compute the safety stock quantity in statistical calculation methods. Derived from the normal distribution at the specified service level target.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: The calculated or manually set safety stock quantity (in base unit of measure) that must be maintained as a buffer to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Principal quantitative fact of this policy record.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
attributes.description: Target service level (cycle service level or fill rate) expressed as a percentage (e.g., 98.5) used in statistical safety stock calculations. Drives the safety factor (z-score) applied to demand variability. Directly impacts OTIF performance.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM; ISO 22000

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the SKU in days from manufacture date. Used in FEFO rotation policy enforcement and safety stock sizing to ensure buffer inventory does not expire before consumption. Critical for perishable food and beverage products.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA; ISO 22000; GFSI; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: uom_code
attributes.description: Base unit of measure in which safety stock quantities, reorder points, and replenishment quantities are expressed (e.g., CS for case, EA for each, KG for kilogram). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA material master UOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 Unit of Measure Standard; ISO 80000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety stock policy record was most recently modified. Used to detect changes during incremental Silver layer processing and to support S&OP change management audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: XYZ classification of the SKU based on demand variability. 'X' items have stable, predictable demand; 'Y' items have moderate variability; 'Z' items have highly erratic demand. Combined with ABC classification to set differentiated safety stock policies.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning; APICS CPIM

products.name: inbound_shipment
products.description: Inbound logistics record capturing the full lifecycle of materials moving from suppliers, co-packers, or inter-company transfers to plants and DCs — from advance ship notice (ASN) through physical goods receipt and putaway. Captures carrier, expected and actual arrival dates, quantity shipped, quantity received, receipt posting date, batch/lot assignment (FIFO/FEFO), purchase order reference, delivery note, storage location, valuation details, and receipt variances. Triggers inventory updates upon confirmed receipt. Supports inbound visibility, carrier performance tracking, receipt-vs-order reconciliation, and accounts payable posting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Inbound Delivery / ASN

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the inbound shipment record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete inbound logistics event with a full lifecycle from ASN through goods receipt and putaway.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Goods Receipt (MIGO/MIGO_GR)

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Three-way match: inbound shipment (goods receipt) is matched against the AP invoice for payment processing. F&B procurement finance teams link GR documents to AP invoices for invoice verification; inv

attributes.name: approved_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ingredient.approved_supplier. Business justification: Goods receipt verification requires confirming each inbound shipment originates from an approved supplier-ingredient combination. F&B quality and FSMA compliance mandate this check at receiving. A QA

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation carrier or 3PL partner responsible for the inbound shipment leg. Used for carrier performance tracking, OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement, and freight cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Transportation (LT01); JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: compliance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.compliance_document. Business justification: FSMA and GFSI require linking each inbound shipment to its governing compliance document (COA, food safety cert). certificate_of_analysis_ref is a denormalized text reference. A proper FK enables docu

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allocate inbound logistics expenses to the responsible cost center for expense tracking.

attributes.name: destination_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Inbound shipments arrive at a specific network node (DC, manufacturing plant, co-packer). inbound_shipment.storage_location_code is a more granular bin/rack-level reference and is kept. Adding destina

attributes.name: destination_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Inbound shipments are directed to a specific storage location for putaway (WMS directed putaway process). inbound_shipment carries a denormalized storage_location_code; replacing it with a proper FK e

attributes.name: distribution_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.shipment. Business justification: Inbound supplier shipments (supply domain) must be reconciled with distribution.shipment records for the same physical movement. F&B DCs use this link for OTIF reconciliation, goods receipt matching,

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Inbound shipments must be tied to the registered facility of the supplier for FDA/USDA import compliance tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Inbound shipments are posted to fiscal periods for goods receipt accounting and COGS recognition. Finance requires shipment-to-period linkage for inventory valuation and period-close; goods_receipt_ti

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Post freight and handling charges of inbound shipments to the designated GL account.

attributes.name: import_export_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.import_export_permit. Business justification: Cross-border inbound shipments require a valid import permit for customs clearance and FDA prior notice compliance. Linking each shipment to its governing import/export permit is a standard customs an

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: INBOUND_SHIPMENT quality inspection results must be linked to INSPECTION_LOT for compliance release and traceability reports.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.lane. Business justification: Inbound shipments travel from suppliers/co-packers to DCs/plants along defined transportation lanes. Linking inbound_shipment to lane enables lane-level inbound performance tracking (transit time actu

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving plant or Distribution Center (DC) in the supply network where the inbound shipment is destined. Used for network design analytics and inventory update triggering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Plant/Storage Location (OX10); Supply Chain Network Design

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Inbound shipments must be matched to specific PO lines for line-level OTIF measurement, delivery performance tracking, and ASN-to-PO-line reconciliation — standard F&B inbound logistics process. inbou

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Inbound shipments are allocated to profit centers for product-line COGS reporting. F&B finance teams attribute inbound freight and material costs to the correct profit center for brand/product-line P&

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) must be tied to the originating purchase order for traceability and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ingredient.raw_material. Business justification: Inbound shipments of raw materials must reference the raw material master for receiving, quality inspection scheduling, allergen verification, and FSMA traceability. inbound_shipment has sku_id for fi

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being received. Links to the product/material master for ingredient, packaging, or finished goods identification. Supports RESOURCE_REFERENCE for downstream line-level analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master (MM01); GS1 GTIN Standard

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier, co-packer, or inter-company transfer source party in the master data. Supports PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for carrier performance tracking and supplier compliance reporting via TraceGains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (XK01); TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: FSMA traceability requires knowing the exact supplier site of origin for each inbound shipment. Site-level food safety certifications, HACCP status, and audit scores are needed for receiving decisions

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the carrier physically arrived at the receiving dock or gate. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) calculation, carrier performance KPIs, and dock turnaround time analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt (MIGO); JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: asn_date
attributes.description: Date the Advance Ship Notice (ASN) was transmitted by the supplier. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category (day-level precision for planning). Used for lead time analysis and supplier compliance measurement against EDI 856 transmission SLAs.
attributes.references: EDI 856 ASN Standard (ANSI X12); SAP S/4HANA MM — Inbound Delivery

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the Advance Ship Notice (ASN) transmitted by the supplier or co-packer prior to physical shipment. Maps to SAP MM inbound delivery document number (VL31N/DESADV). Serves as the primary cross-reference between supplier systems and internal logistics. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Inbound Delivery; EDI 856 ASN Standard (ANSI X12); GS1 DESADV

attributes.name: batch_lot_number
attributes.description: Supplier-assigned or internally-generated batch or lot number assigned to the received material at goods receipt. Critical for FIFO/FEFO rotation policy enforcement, allergen matrix traceability, HACCP compliance, and FSMA lot-level traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch Management (MSC1N); FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1); HACCP; ISO 22000

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: ISO 6346 shipping container identification number for ocean or intermodal freight. Used for port customs clearance, container tracking, and import compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 6346 Freight Container Identification; US Customs and Border Protection (CBP); FDA Prior Notice

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the material was manufactured or processed. Required for customs declarations, USDA country-of-origin labeling (COOL) compliance, and import duty calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL); FDA Import Regulations; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inbound shipment record was first created in the source system (SAP MM or EDI inbound processing). RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Document Creation; ISO 22000 Traceability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the invoice_value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency AP processing and financial reporting. MONETARY_TRIPLET component.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Supplier-issued delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the physical shipment. Used for goods receipt posting in SAP MM (MIGO) and for dispute resolution with suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt (MIGO); GS1 DESADV

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date of the received batch/lot. Drives FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory rotation, shelf life compliance, and quality hold decisions. Mandatory for food safety regulatory compliance under FDA and FSMA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch Shelf Life (MSC1N); FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FSMA Traceability Rule; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight payment terms indicating who bears the transportation cost for the inbound shipment. Prepaid means supplier pays; collect means Food Beverage pays at destination. Used for freight cost allocation and AP processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Freight Terms; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: goods_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the goods receipt was formally posted in SAP MM (MIGO transaction), triggering inventory update and accounts payable (AP) posting. Critical for FIFO/FEFO lot assignment and financial period close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt Posting (MIGO); FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the inbound shipment in kilograms, including packaging and pallets. Used for freight cost calculation, dock capacity planning, and customs documentation. QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Delivery Weight; GS1 DESADV; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the transfer of risk and responsibility between supplier and Food Beverage for the shipment. Determines freight cost ownership and insurance liability. Used in AP invoice validation and landed cost calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Incoterms; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inbound shipment contains hazardous materials (e.g., cleaning chemicals, food-grade solvents) requiring special handling, labeling, and regulatory compliance under DOT/IATA regulations.
attributes.references: US DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; EPA

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inbound shipment requires temperature-controlled (cold chain) transportation and storage conditions (e.g., refrigerated or frozen). Triggers cold chain compliance checks and specialized putaway routing in WMS.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110 GMP; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1); ISO 22000

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the material was manufactured by the supplier or co-packer. Used in conjunction with expiry_date for FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation policy enforcement and shelf life management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch Classification (MSC1N); FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Labeling; FSMA

attributes.name: otif_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the inbound shipment was delivered On Time and In Full (OTIF) against the scheduled_arrival_date and quantity_shipped. True = OTIF achieved; False = OTIF missed. Used for supplier and carrier performance scorecards.
attributes.references: Food and Beverage Industry OTIF KPI Standard; SAP IBP Supply Chain Performance

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets included in the inbound shipment. Used for dock scheduling, labor resource planning, and warehouse space allocation at the receiving DC or plant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM — Handling Unit Management; GS1 SSCC (Serial Shipping Container Code)

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number or Bill of Lading (BOL) number used to track the shipment in transit. Enables real-time inbound visibility and carrier performance tracking. Used for freight claims and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: putaway_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the received goods were physically placed into the designated storage location within the plant or DC. Marks completion of the inbound logistics lifecycle. Used for dock-to-stock cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM — Transfer Order (LT01); WMS Integration

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of the quality inspection lot associated with the goods receipt in SAP QM. Indicates whether the received batch has passed, failed, or is pending quality inspection before release to unrestricted stock. Supports HACCP, SQF, and GFSI compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot (QA01); HACCP; SQF; GFSI; ISO 22000; Veeva Vault QMS

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the material physically received and posted in SAP MM goods receipt (MIGO). May differ from quantity_shipped due to transit damage, short shipment, or over-delivery. Triggers inventory update upon posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt Quantity (MIGO); FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: quantity_shipped
attributes.description: Total quantity of the material dispatched by the supplier as declared in the ASN. Expressed in the base unit of measure (UoM) of the material master. Used as the baseline for receipt variance calculation and supplier compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Inbound Delivery Quantity; GS1 DESADV

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure (UoM) for quantity_shipped and quantity_received fields (e.g., KG, LB, CS, EA, L, GAL). Aligns with SAP MM material master base unit of measure. Required for accurate inventory valuation and supply planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Unit of Measure (T006); ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: Difference between quantity_shipped and quantity_received (shipped minus received). Positive value indicates short delivery; negative value indicates over-delivery. Used for receipt-vs-order reconciliation, supplier dispute management, and AP invoice matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt Variance; Oracle Cloud Procurement — Three-Way Match

attributes.name: receipt_variance_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining the cause of any quantity variance between quantity_shipped and quantity_received. Used for supplier dispute management, root cause analysis, and AP invoice reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: short_shipment|over_delivery|transit_damage|quality_rejection|counting_error|no_variance — promote to reference product if additional codes required]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt Variance; Oracle Cloud Procurement — Three-Way Match

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_date
attributes.description: Expected date of physical arrival at the receiving plant or DC as communicated in the ASN or purchase order. Used for inbound dock scheduling, labor planning, and OTIF (On Time In Full) baseline measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Inbound Delivery Scheduling; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inbound shipment. Tracks progression from in-transit through physical receipt and putaway. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. Values: in_transit (ASN issued, goods en route), arrived (carrier confirmed delivery at gate), receiving (goods receipt in progress), received (goods receipt posted in SAP MM), putaway (goods stored in final storage location), cancelled (shipment cancelled prior to receipt).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Inbound Delivery Status; GS1 Supply Chain Visibility

attributes.name: shipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inbound shipment origin type. Distinguishes between direct supplier deliveries, co-packing receipts, inter-company stock transfers, 3PL-managed transfers, and toll manufacturing returns. Supports supply chain segmentation and cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Movement Type (OMJJ); Food and Beverage Supply Chain Classification

attributes.name: temperature_range
attributes.description: Required temperature range classification for the inbound shipment during transport and storage. Ambient (15-25°C), Chilled (0-8°C), Frozen (-18°C or below), Ultra-Frozen (-40°C or below). Used for cold chain compliance and carrier selection.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used for the inbound shipment leg. Used for freight cost benchmarking, carbon footprint/sustainability reporting, and carrier performance segmentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Transportation Mode; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; EPA Scope 3 Emissions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the inbound shipment record in the source system. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the lakehouse Silver layer and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Document Change Log; ISO 9001 Record Control

products.name: sop_cycle
products.description: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) / Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycle record governing the cadence of cross-functional supply-demand alignment. Captures planning period, cycle type (monthly S&OP, weekly demand review, executive IBP), cycle status, key milestone dates (demand review, supply review, pre-S&OP, executive review), consensus decisions, attendees, action items, and financial reconciliation outcomes. Drives the rhythm of planning activities, scenario approvals, and cross-functional accountability across demand, supply, finance, and commercial teams in the F&B organization.
products.reference: SAP IBP S&OP Cycle

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the S&OP/Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycle record. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete, recurring cross-functional planning event with a defined lifecycle (draft → in-progress → closed).

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: S&OP financial reconciliation step compares consensus plan to the financial budget; the sop_cycle references the budget version being reconciled. F&B S&OP explicitly includes a financial reconciliatio

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: S&OP cycles are aligned to fiscal periods; the financial reconciliation step of S&OP requires linking the cycle to the fiscal period being planned. F&B S&OP practitioners always run cycles within a fi

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.market. Business justification: In global F&B, S&OP cycles are market-scoped — consensus_demand_volume, revenue_gap_amount, and service_level_target_pct are market-specific outputs. A domain expert expects sop_cycle to reference its

attributes.name: attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of cross-functional participants who attended the S&OP/IBP cycle meetings (demand review, supply review, pre-S&OP, and executive review combined). Used as a process maturity indicator and governance compliance metric.
attributes.references: Oliver Wight Class A IBP — Meeting Governance

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Aggregate manufacturing capacity utilization percentage (0–100) for the planning period as assessed during the supply review of this S&OP cycle. Derived from the constrained supply plan vs. available production capacity. Values above 85% typically trigger capacity escalation discussions.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Capacity Planning; Aveva/Wonderware MES — OEE Analytics

attributes.name: consensus_decision_summary
attributes.description: Free-text narrative summarizing the key cross-functional decisions, trade-offs, and commitments agreed upon during this S&OP/IBP cycle. Captures the rationale for scenario selection, supply gap resolutions, and any deviations from the financial operating plan.
attributes.references: Oliver Wight Class A IBP — Decision Documentation; SAP IBP

attributes.name: consensus_demand_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the consensus demand volume approved in this S&OP cycle (e.g., CS = cases, EA = each, KG = kilograms). Ensures consistent interpretation of volume figures across demand, supply, and finance teams. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CS|EA|KG|LB|L|GAL|MT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IBP — UOM; GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards

attributes.name: consensus_demand_volume
attributes.description: Total consensus demand volume (in standard cases or agreed unit of measure) approved by cross-functional teams during this S&OP cycle. Represents the agreed-upon demand signal used to drive supply planning, procurement, and manufacturing scheduling for the planning period.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Consensus Demand; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: consensus_revenue_target
attributes.description: Financial revenue target (in reporting currency) aligned and approved during this S&OP/IBP cycle. Represents the commercial commitment reconciled between the demand plan and the financial operating plan. Used for EBITDA tracking and financial close alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Profitability Analysis; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this S&OP cycle record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting data lineage, compliance reporting, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 22000 — Record Keeping; FSMA — Traceability Records

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this S&OP cycle record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency global operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: cycle_close_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this S&OP/IBP cycle was formally closed and the approved consensus plan was locked for execution. Marks the end of the active planning window. Used for cycle duration KPI measurement and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Planning Cycle Closure; Oliver Wight IBP

attributes.name: cycle_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, risk flags, assumptions, or contextual notes recorded by the S&OP cycle owner or cross-functional team. May include references to external market events, supply disruptions, regulatory changes, or strategic initiatives impacting the planning cycle.
attributes.references: Oliver Wight Class A IBP — Assumptions Documentation

attributes.name: cycle_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the S&OP/IBP cycle, formatted as SOP-YYYY-MM-NNN (e.g., SOP-2024-10-001). Used in cross-functional communications, meeting agendas, and audit trails to uniquely reference a planning cycle. Maps to SAP IBP Planning Cycle ID.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Planning Cycle; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: cycle_open_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this S&OP/IBP cycle was formally opened and made active in the planning system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp marking the start of the cycle's active planning window. Used for SLA tracking and cycle duration analytics.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the S&OP/IBP cycle. Drives workflow routing, access controls, and downstream planning system locks. Draft: cycle initiated but not yet active. In Progress: milestone reviews underway. Pending Approval: awaiting executive sign-off. Approved: consensus plan ratified. Closed: cycle archived. Cancelled: cycle voided.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Planning Cycle Status; Oliver Wight IBP Maturity Model

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planning cycle cadence and scope. Determines which cross-functional teams participate and which decisions are in scope. Monthly S&OP covers full supply-demand balancing; weekly demand review focuses on near-term demand sensing; executive IBP covers strategic financial reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monthly_sop|weekly_demand_review|executive_ibp|supply_review|pre_sop|demand_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IBP — IBP for S&OP; Oliver Wight Class A S&OP Framework

attributes.name: demand_plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the demand plan (from SAP IBP or JDA/Blue Yonder) that was reviewed and approved during this S&OP cycle. Enables traceability between the S&OP cycle record and the specific demand plan version used as input to supply planning and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Plan Version Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: demand_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the Demand Review milestone within this S&OP cycle. During the demand review, commercial and demand planning teams align on the unconstrained consensus demand forecast, incorporating statistical forecasts, market intelligence, and promotional uplifts.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — S&OP Demand Review; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: executive_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the Executive S&OP or IBP review meeting where senior leadership approves the consensus plan, resolves escalated supply-demand gaps, and aligns on financial commitments and strategic trade-offs.
attributes.references: Oliver Wight Class A IBP; SAP IBP — Executive IBP Review

attributes.name: financial_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the financial reconciliation between the consensus volume plan and the financial operating plan (budget/latest estimate) at the close of this S&OP cycle. Aligned: volume plan supports financial targets. Gap Identified: volume shortfall vs. financial plan. Escalated: gap referred to CFO/leadership. Resolved: gap closed via scenario or plan adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Profitability Analysis; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; Oliver Wight IBP Financial Integration

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number 1–13 depending on calendar) within the fiscal year to which this S&OP cycle belongs. Enables alignment of planning cycle outcomes with period-close financial reporting and EBITDA reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Fiscal Period; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this S&OP cycle belongs, as defined in the corporate financial calendar (e.g., 2024). Used for financial reconciliation, budget alignment, and year-over-year planning comparisons.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Fiscal Year Variant; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: inventory_target_days
attributes.description: Target days of supply (DOS) for finished goods inventory approved during this S&OP cycle. Reflects the inventory optimization policy balancing service level targets, working capital constraints, and shelf life (FEFO) requirements for the planning period.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Inventory Planning

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this S&OP cycle's consensus plan has been locked for execution (True), preventing further modifications to the approved demand and supply plan. Locking triggers downstream replenishment signals, procurement purchase orders, and manufacturing schedules.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Plan Lock; JDA/Blue Yonder Planning Freeze

attributes.name: new_product_items_count
attributes.description: Number of new product development (NPD) SKUs included in the demand and supply plans reviewed during this S&OP cycle. Tracks the volume of innovation pipeline items requiring dedicated supply chain readiness assessment and launch planning.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — New Product Introduction; PLM Integration

attributes.name: open_action_item_count
attributes.description: Number of open action items carried forward from this S&OP cycle at the time of cycle closure. Tracks cross-functional accountability and process discipline. A high count may indicate unresolved supply-demand gaps or escalation items requiring follow-up in the next cycle.
attributes.references: Oliver Wight Class A S&OP — Action Item Tracking

attributes.name: planning_horizon_months
attributes.description: Number of months covered by the planning horizon reviewed in this S&OP cycle. Typically 18–24 months for strategic IBP cycles and 3–6 months for operational S&OP cycles in the Food and Beverage industry. Drives the time fence for supply-demand balancing decisions.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Planning Horizon; Oliver Wight Class A IBP

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the planning horizon governed by this S&OP cycle. Together with planning_period_start_date, defines the full time fence for supply-demand balancing decisions made in this cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Planning Horizon; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the planning horizon governed by this S&OP cycle. Defines the start boundary for demand, supply, inventory, and financial plans reviewed and approved within this cycle. Typically the first day of the planning month or week.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Planning Horizon; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: pre_sop_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the Pre-S&OP (reconciliation) meeting where supply, demand, and finance teams resolve gaps between the demand plan and constrained supply plan before escalating unresolved issues to the executive S&OP review.
attributes.references: Oliver Wight Class A S&OP; SAP IBP — Pre-S&OP Step

attributes.name: promotional_volume_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total consensus demand volume attributable to trade promotions and promotional uplifts in the planning period reviewed during this S&OP cycle. High promotional volume percentages increase demand variability and require additional safety stock and supply flexibility.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder TPM Integration

attributes.name: revenue_gap_amount
attributes.description: Monetary gap (in reporting currency) between the consensus revenue plan approved in this S&OP cycle and the financial operating plan (budget or latest estimate). Positive values indicate revenue shortfall vs. financial plan. Key input for executive escalation and corrective action planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Variance Analysis; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: safety_stock_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether safety stock parameters were formally reviewed and updated during this S&OP cycle (True) or carried forward unchanged from the prior cycle (False). Safety stock reviews are triggered by significant changes in demand variability, lead times, or service level targets.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Inventory Planning

attributes.name: scenario_name
attributes.description: Name or label of the supply-demand scenario approved by the executive team during this S&OP cycle (e.g., 'Base Case', 'Upside Demand', 'Supply Constrained'). Identifies which planning scenario was selected as the consensus plan for execution.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Scenario Planning; Oliver Wight IBP Scenario Management

attributes.name: scenario_type
attributes.description: Classification of the approved planning scenario for this S&OP cycle. Base Case: most likely outcome. Upside: optimistic demand/supply scenario. Downside: pessimistic scenario. Supply Constrained: demand exceeds available supply. Risk Adjusted: incorporates identified supply chain risk mitigations.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Scenario Planning; Oliver Wight Class A IBP

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
attributes.description: Target customer service level (fill rate or OTIF percentage) approved for the planning period during this S&OP cycle. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 98.50 = 98.5%). Drives safety stock parameters and replenishment signal calibration across the DC network.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Service Level Optimization; SLA Framework

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this S&OP cycle record was sourced or initiated. SAP_IBP: SAP Integrated Business Planning. JDA_BLUE_YONDER: JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning. ORACLE_ERP: Oracle Cloud ERP. MANUAL: manually entered outside a planning system.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; JDA/Blue Yonder; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: supply_gap_volume
attributes.description: Volumetric gap (in consensus demand UOM) between the unconstrained consensus demand plan and the constrained supply plan identified during this S&OP cycle. Positive values indicate supply shortfall; negative values indicate supply surplus. Key input for executive escalation and scenario planning.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Supply-Demand Balancing; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: supply_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the Supply Review milestone within this S&OP cycle. Supply planning teams assess capacity constraints, raw material availability, MOQ compliance, and FIFO/FEFO inventory rotation to produce a constrained supply plan.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — S&OP Supply Review; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this S&OP cycle record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer and audit trail requirements for planning governance.
attributes.references: ISO 22000 — Record Keeping; SAP IBP — Change Log

products.name: network_node
products.description: Master record for each physical node in the supply chain network — manufacturing plants, distribution centers, 3PL warehouses, co-packer facilities, and cross-dock points. Captures node type, geographic coordinates, capacity (pallet positions, throughput rate), operating model (owned, leased, 3PL-operated), service level parameters, and network tier (national DC, regional DC, forward DC). Foundation entity for network design, lane definition, capacity planning, and safety stock policy assignment.
products.reference: Supply Chain Network Node / DC Master

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each physical node in the supply chain network. Primary key for the network_node master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; SAP IBP Network Design

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_center. Business justification: Logistics network mapping ties nodes that are physical DCs to the DC master for routing, capacity planning, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Network nodes belong to legal entities (company codes) for statutory reporting, intercompany transfers, and tax compliance. F&B multinationals must know which legal entity owns each node for transfer

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each network node (DC, plant, 3PL) maps to a cost center for overhead allocation and facility cost reporting. F&B finance teams assign cost centers to distribution nodes for P&L reporting and facility

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Every food-handling network node (DC, warehouse, co-packer) must hold an FDA establishment registration. The denormalized fda_facility_registration_number on network_node should be replaced with a pro

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.market. Business justification: In global F&B, each DC, plant, or co-packer node is assigned to a market for supply network design, market allocation, and regulatory reporting. Market assignment drives service_level_target_pct and o

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Network nodes are assigned to profit centers for product-line and geographic P&L reporting. F&B companies map DCs and plants to profit centers for contribution margin analysis; cost_center alone does

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: DC-to-territory alignment is a fundamental F&B supply network design decision — each distribution center serves defined sales territories. Network design and territory coverage analysis require this l

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the supply chain node facility. Used for carrier routing, ASN generation, and regulatory compliance reporting (FDA FSMA facility registration).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Facility Registration; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail (suite, building, dock number) for the supply chain node. Supports precise carrier delivery instructions and ASN routing.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Facility Registration; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the supply chain node is located. Used in network design, lane definition, and geographic reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: co_packing_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node has co-packing or toll manufacturing capability — performing secondary packaging, kitting, or assembly operations on behalf of the brand. Relevant for NPD and promotional pack configurations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Aveva/Wonderware MES; Co-Packing; Toll Manufacturing

attributes.name: cold_storage_capacity_pallets
attributes.description: Number of pallet positions dedicated to temperature-controlled (chilled or frozen) storage. Used for dairy, beverage, and perishable product inventory planning and FEFO compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supply chain node became operationally active. Used in asset lifecycle management, network design history, and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Asset Management; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the node is located (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'). Drives regulatory compliance framework selection (FDA, EFSA, USDA) and customs/trade documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FDA; EFSA; USDA; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: cross_dock_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node supports cross-docking operations — transferring inbound shipments directly to outbound without storage. Reduces handling costs and lead times for high-velocity SKUs.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: customs_bonded_warehouse
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node is a licensed customs bonded warehouse, allowing storage of imported goods before customs duties are paid. Relevant for international supply chain nodes and import/export operations.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP); Oracle Cloud Supply Chain

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supply chain node was or is planned to be decommissioned. Nullable for active nodes. Used in network design planning, lease management, and IBP scenario modeling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Asset Management; SAP IBP Network Design

attributes.name: dock_door_count
attributes.description: Number of loading/unloading dock doors at the facility. Constrains inbound and outbound throughput scheduling and carrier appointment management.

attributes.name: dsd_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node supports Direct Store Delivery (DSD) operations — direct shipment from the node to retail store locations bypassing intermediate DCs. Drives route planning and trade promotion execution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; DSD

attributes.name: erp_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP plant/organization code corresponding to this network node. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the supply chain network model and ERP master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant; Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Organization

attributes.name: floor_area_sqft
attributes.description: Total usable floor area of the node facility in square feet. Supports capacity planning, lease management, and facility benchmarking.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Financials; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX

attributes.name: gmp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node holds a current Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certification. Required for manufacturing and co-packing nodes under FDA, USDA, and GFSI compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: FDA GMP 21 CFR Part 110/117; GFSI; ISO 22000; FSSC 22000

attributes.name: ibp_location_code
