attributes.description: SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) location identifier for this node. Enables direct linkage between the network node master and IBP demand sensing, inventory optimization, and S&OP planning models.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; SAP IBP Demand Sensing

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Decimal latitude coordinate of the node facility. Used in network optimization models, transportation lane distance calculations, and geographic visualization in IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Network Design; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facility lease expires for leased or 3PL-operated nodes. Drives network design risk assessment, contract renewal planning, and financial forecasting in Oracle Cloud Financials.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Financials; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX; IFRS 16

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Decimal longitude coordinate of the node facility. Used in network optimization models, transportation lane distance calculations, and geographic visualization in IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Network Design; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: moq_pallets
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) in pallet units for inbound replenishment orders to this node. Enforced during replenishment signal generation in SAP IBP and JDA to avoid sub-optimal shipments.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; MOQ

attributes.name: n3pl_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the Third-Party Logistics (3PL) provider operating this node, if applicable. Used in SLA governance, contract management, and performance scorecarding.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement; SAP S/4HANA MM; 3PL

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier of the node within the distribution network (e.g., national DC feeds regional DCs, which feed forward DCs). Determines replenishment flow, safety stock echelon, and FIFO/FEFO rotation policy assignment.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the supply chain node across systems (e.g., SAP plant code, DC code, 3PL site code). Used in EDI transactions, ASN documents, and IBP network models.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Code; JDA/Blue Yonder Network Node; EDI X12

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the supply chain node (e.g., 'Chicago Regional DC', 'Atlanta Co-Pack Facility'). Used in reporting, planograms, and network design documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply chain node. Controls whether the node is eligible for demand planning, replenishment signal generation, and network design optimization in SAP IBP and JDA.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Network Design; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply chain node by its primary operational function. Drives network design rules, safety stock policy assignment, and lane definitions in IBP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing_plant|distribution_center|3pl_warehouse|co_packer|cross_dock|forward_dc — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IBP Network Design; JDA/Blue Yonder Network Modeling

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Standard daily operating end time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) for the node. Used in carrier appointment scheduling, outbound dispatch windows, and transportation management.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Standard daily operating start time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) for the node. Used in carrier appointment scheduling, inbound receiving windows, and transportation management.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: operating_model
attributes.description: Describes the ownership and operational arrangement for the node — whether the facility is company-owned, leased, operated by a 3PL partner, or used for toll manufacturing or co-packing. Drives cost allocation (COGS), SLA governance, and contract management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: otif_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: On Time In Full (OTIF) delivery performance target percentage for shipments originating from this node. Used in SLA governance, carrier scorecards, and supply chain KPI reporting.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; OTIF; SLA

attributes.name: pallet_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of pallet positions available at the node for storage. Principal capacity metric used in inventory optimization, safety stock policy assignment, and network design in SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; WMS

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the supply chain node. Used for carrier zone determination, freight cost calculation, and geographic clustering in network design.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days required to replenish inventory at this node from its upstream supply source. Used in safety stock calculations, demand sensing, and IBP supply-demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: rotation_policy
attributes.description: Inventory rotation method enforced at this node — First In First Out (FIFO), First Expired First Out (FEFO), or Last In First Out (LIFO). Drives WMS pick sequencing and shelf life compliance for food safety.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP; GMP; SAP S/4HANA WM; ISO 22000

attributes.name: safety_stock_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the safety stock calculation policy assigned to this node (e.g., days-of-supply, statistical, min-max). Drives inventory optimization parameters in SAP IBP and JDA demand/supply planning.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
attributes.description: Target fill rate or case fill rate percentage (e.g., 98.5) for outbound order fulfillment from this node. Drives safety stock policy and OTIF performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; OTIF; SLA

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 state or province code where the node is located (e.g., 'IL', 'CA', 'ON'). Used for tax jurisdiction, regulatory compliance, and transportation lane modeling.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; FDA FSMA; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature-controlled storage capability of the node (ambient, chilled, frozen, or multi-temp). Critical for food safety compliance (HACCP, FSMA), shelf life management, and FEFO rotation policy assignment.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP; GFSI; ISO 22000; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: throughput_rate_pallets_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of pallets the node can receive, process, and ship per day. Used in capacity planning, OTIF modeling, and supply-demand balancing in JDA and SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; OEE

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the node location (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'Europe/London'). Used for scheduling inbound/outbound appointments, production shifts, and EDI transaction timestamps.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; SAP S/4HANA; JDA/Blue Yonder TMS

products.name: lane
products.description: Defined transportation lane between two network nodes (origin-destination pair) used for supply chain routing, freight cost estimation, and replenishment lead time calculation. Captures origin node, destination node, transit time, freight mode (TL, LTL, intermodal, parcel), carrier assignments, lane distance, standard freight cost per unit, and active/inactive status. Supports network optimization, carrier bid management, and transportation cost modeling.
products.reference: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Lane

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the transportation lane record. Primary key for the lane entity.

attributes.name: destination_node_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination network node (e.g., Distribution Center (DC), customer distribution center, retail store, or 3PL facility) to which shipments are delivered on this lane.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: import_export_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.import_export_permit. Business justification: Cross-border transport lanes require a valid import/export permit to operate legally. Lane activation, freight tendering, and trade compliance reviews depend on permit validity. The lane already carri

attributes.name: lane_backup_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the secondary or backup carrier assigned to this lane, activated when the primary carrier is unavailable or capacity-constrained. Supports supply chain resilience and continuity planning.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: lane_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary carrier assigned to this transportation lane for standard replenishment and distribution movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: lane_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin network node (e.g., manufacturing plant, Distribution Center (DC), supplier facility, or 3PL warehouse) from which shipments depart on this lane.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: co2_emission_factor
attributes.description: Estimated CO2 equivalent emissions per unit distance (kg CO2e per mile) for this lane based on freight mode and carrier fleet profile. Supports sustainability reporting and EPA environmental compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Compliance; ISO 14064; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the carrier contract and associated freight rates for this lane become effective. Used for rate validity checks during shipment planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier contract and associated freight rates for this lane expire. Triggers carrier bid management and contract renewal workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the freight contract or carrier rate agreement governing this lane. Links to the carrier contract management system for rate validation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: cross_border_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane crosses an international border, triggering customs documentation, import/export compliance, and regulatory reporting requirements (e.g., FDA Prior Notice for food imports).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; Codex Alimentarius Commission; EFSA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all freight cost fields on this lane (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency network operations.

attributes.name: delivery_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days of the week on which deliveries are accepted at the destination node for this lane (e.g., 'Tue,Thu,Sat'). Used for appointment scheduling and receiving window management.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination node's country (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Required for cross-border compliance, import duties, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: distance_miles
attributes.description: Calculated or contracted road/rail distance between origin and destination nodes in miles. Used for freight cost estimation, carrier rate negotiation, and carbon emissions modeling.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is used for Direct Store Delivery (DSD), where product is shipped directly from a manufacturing plant or DC to a retail store, bypassing the customer's distribution center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this transportation lane becomes operationally active and available for replenishment routing and shipment planning.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP IBP

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this transportation lane is scheduled to become inactive or is retired from the network. Nullable for open-ended lanes.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP IBP

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_load
attributes.description: Contracted flat-rate freight cost per full truckload (TL) or equivalent load unit on this lane. Applicable primarily for TL and dedicated lanes where per-load pricing is negotiated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_mile
attributes.description: Contracted or benchmark freight cost per mile for this lane, used in carrier bid management, rate benchmarking, and transportation cost modeling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard contracted freight cost per unit (case or pallet) shipped on this lane, expressed in the operating currency. Used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) allocation, transportation cost modeling, and network optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: freight_mode
attributes.description: Transportation mode used on this lane. TL = Truckload, LTL = Less-Than-Truckload, intermodal = combined rail/truck, parcel = small package carrier, rail = dedicated rail, ocean = sea freight. Drives freight cost modeling and carrier selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TL|LTL|intermodal|parcel|rail|ocean|air — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: freight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure used for freight cost and capacity calculations on this lane (e.g., pallet, case, lb, kg, cwt). Aligns with carrier contract terms and SAP S/4HANA MM configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_pct
attributes.description: Current fuel surcharge percentage applied on top of the base freight rate for this lane, expressed as a percentage. Updated periodically per carrier contract terms and fuel index benchmarks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is certified and approved for the transport of hazardous materials (e.g., cleaning chemicals, CO2 cartridges). Drives carrier certification requirements and regulatory compliance checks.

attributes.name: lane_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the lane, used in carrier bid management, freight contracts, and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) communications. Unique across the network.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; EDI X12 Standard

attributes.name: lane_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the lane, typically combining origin and destination node names (e.g., 'Chicago DC to Atlanta DC'). Used in reporting and network design tools.

attributes.name: lane_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the lane. 'active' lanes are available for replenishment routing; 'inactive' lanes are retired; 'pending' lanes are under carrier negotiation; 'suspended' lanes are temporarily halted.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP IBP

attributes.name: lane_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lane's operational role. 'primary' is the standard routing; 'backup' is an alternate route activated when primary is unavailable; 'spot' is used for ad-hoc shipments; 'dedicated' is a contracted exclusive lane.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this lane record was last reviewed and validated by the transportation or supply chain planning team. Supports lane master data governance and periodic network design reviews.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP IBP

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total replenishment lead time in days for this lane, including order processing, pick/pack, and transit time. Distinct from transit_time_days as it captures the full end-to-end cycle used in demand planning and inventory optimization.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: max_load_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum shipment capacity per load on this lane, expressed in the freight unit of measure (e.g., pallets, cases, or weight). Used for load planning and carrier capacity management.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: min_order_qty
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required to activate a shipment on this lane, expressed in the freight unit of measure. Enforced during replenishment signal generation in SAP IBP.

attributes.name: network_region
attributes.description: Geographic or operational region classification for this lane (e.g., 'Northeast', 'Southeast', 'Midwest', 'West Coast', 'International'). Used for network design segmentation and regional distribution analytics.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP IBP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or exceptions relevant to this lane (e.g., seasonal restrictions, bridge weight limits, port congestion advisories).

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin node's country (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Required for cross-border compliance, customs documentation, and trade lane analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FDA FSMA; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: otif_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted On Time In Full (OTIF) performance target percentage for this lane, used to measure carrier compliance and supply chain reliability. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 98.50).
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP IBP

attributes.name: pickup_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days of the week on which carrier pickups are available at the origin node for this lane (e.g., 'Mon,Wed,Fri'). Used for replenishment scheduling and order cut-off management.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Contracted service level for this lane defining delivery speed and reliability commitment (e.g., standard, expedited, overnight, economy). Linked to On Time In Full (OTIF) and Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance targets.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP IBP

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this lane record originates (e.g., SAP Transportation Management, JDA/Blue Yonder TMS, Oracle SCM, or manually maintained). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature-controlled handling requirement for this lane, critical for food safety compliance. 'ambient' = dry goods; 'chilled' = refrigerated (2-8°C); 'frozen' = frozen (-18°C or below); 'controlled' = specific temperature range per product specification. Aligns with FSMA and HACCP requirements.

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is operated by a Third-Party Logistics (3PL) provider rather than a company-owned or dedicated carrier. Drives 3PL performance management and cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: transit_time_days
attributes.description: Standard transit time in calendar days from origin departure to destination receipt for this lane. Used in replenishment lead time calculation, safety stock parameterization, and SAP IBP supply planning.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: transit_variability_days
attributes.description: Standard deviation or average variability in transit time in days for this lane, derived from historical shipment performance. Used in safety stock calculation and inventory optimization in SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

products.name: capacity_constraint
products.description: Production and logistics capacity constraint record used in constrained supply planning and DC capacity management. Captures resource type (production line, DC throughput, transportation lane, dock doors), capacity bucket (daily, weekly, monthly), available vs. utilized capacity, constraint type (hard/soft), and DC-specific metrics (pallet positions, labor hours, dock door utilization). Enables finite capacity planning, bottleneck identification, and network rebalancing decisions.
products.reference: SAP IBP Resource / Capacity Constraint

attributes.name: capacity_constraint_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each capacity constraint record in the supply planning system. Primary key for the capacity_constraint data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a managed planning resource (capacity bucket) with its own identity and lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Capacity investment and operating costs are budgeted; finance links capacity constraints to budget lines for capex/opex planning and variance reporting. F&B finance teams track capacity utilization ag

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Marketing campaigns in F&B (e.g., seasonal promotions, new product launches) are a primary driver of capacity constraints. Linking capacity_constraint to the triggering campaign enables campaign capac

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Distribution Center (DC) or warehouse node to which this capacity constraint applies. Null when the constraint is associated with a manufacturing plant rather than a DC. Links to the DC master in the supply network.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Large retailer sales contracts with committed volumes drive dedicated capacity planning in F&B manufacturing. Contract-driven capacity constraint management is a named process — planners must link cap

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allocate capacity constraint impacts (e.g., overtime) to the relevant cost center for cost control.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Capacity constraints are planned within fiscal periods; finance uses capacity utilization data for fixed overhead absorption and variance analysis in period-close reporting. F&B finance teams track ca

attributes.name: food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.food_safety_plan. Business justification: Capacity constraints triggered by regulatory holds or food safety plan corrective actions (CCP monitoring downtime, CAPA shutdowns) must reference the governing food safety plan. The existing regulato

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Capacity-related costs (overtime, planned downtime, changeover) are posted to specific GL accounts; finance links capacity constraints to GL accounts for overhead variance analysis and cost element re

attributes.name: haccp_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.haccp_plan. Business justification: S&OP capacity planning: HACCP-mandated allergen changeovers, CCP monitoring windows, and cleaning validation requirements impose scheduled downtime that creates capacity constraints. Supply planners m

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Capacity constraints apply to physical network nodes (DCs, manufacturing plants). capacity_constraint already has center_id (cross-domain to distribution.center) and plant_id (cross-domain to manufact

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility to which this capacity constraint applies. Null when the constraint is associated with a DC or logistics node rather than a production plant. Links to the plant master in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line or work center within a plant to which this capacity constraint applies. Populated only when resource_type is 'production_line'. Links to the work center or production line master in SAP S/4HANA PP or Aveva MES.

attributes.name: promotion_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_plan. Business justification: During S&OP, capacity constraints are evaluated against promotion plans — large promotional volume commitments create documented capacity bottlenecks. Supply planners must reference the promotion plan

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID
attributes.description: Reference to the S&OP/IBP planning cycle during which this capacity constraint was defined or last reviewed. Links to the S&OP cycle master to enable traceability of capacity decisions across monthly planning cycles.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; S&OP Best Practices

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Capacity constraints in F&B DCs are defined at the storage location level (e.g., cold room pallet positions, allergen-segregated zones). capacity_constraint has center_id and plant_id but lacks storag

attributes.name: transportation_lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation lane (origin-destination pair) to which this capacity constraint applies. Populated only when resource_type is 'transportation_lane'. Links to the lane master in JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.work_center. Business justification: Capacity constraints in IBP/S&OP must be modeled at work center granularity for detailed scheduling in F&B (e.g., allergen changeover constraints, CIP cycle limits). capacity_constraint already links

attributes.name: available_capacity
attributes.description: Total available capacity for the resource within the defined capacity bucket period, expressed in the unit of measure specified by capacity_uom (e.g., cases per day, pallet positions, labor hours, truck loads). Represents the theoretical maximum throughput or storage before any utilization. Serves as the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; SAP S/4HANA PP-CRP

attributes.name: bottleneck_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this resource is identified as a bottleneck in the current planning cycle (True = bottleneck, False = not a bottleneck). Set by the planning engine (SAP IBP or JDA) when utilization_pct exceeds utilization_ceiling_pct. Triggers network rebalancing, co-packing evaluation, or 3PL overflow decisions.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: bucket_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the capacity bucket period to which this constraint record applies. Combined with bucket_start_date, defines the exact planning window for available and utilized capacity values.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 8601

attributes.name: bucket_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the capacity bucket period to which this constraint record applies. Combined with bucket_end_date, defines the exact planning window for available and utilized capacity values.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 8601

attributes.name: capacity_bucket
attributes.description: Time granularity of the capacity constraint record. Defines the planning horizon bucket over which available and utilized capacity are measured. 'daily' is used for short-term finite scheduling; 'weekly' for S&OP/IBP mid-term planning; 'monthly' and 'quarterly' for strategic network design.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: capacity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which available_capacity and utilized_capacity are expressed. Varies by resource_type: production lines typically use cases or kg per day; DC storage uses pallet positions; labor uses hours; transportation uses truck loads or pallets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cases|pallets|labor_hours|truck_loads|kg|liters|units — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM UOM; ISO 80000; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: changeover_hours
attributes.description: Hours allocated within the capacity bucket for product changeovers (SKU switches) on the production line, including allergen cleaning, flavor changeovers, and packaging format changes. Reduces effective throughput capacity. Tracked separately from planned_downtime_hours for root cause analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Aveva/Wonderware MES; HACCP Allergen Management

attributes.name: constraint_category
attributes.description: Business category classifying the root cause or nature of the capacity constraint. 'throughput' relates to production or logistics flow rate; 'storage' to physical space; 'labor' to workforce availability; 'equipment' to machinery or vehicle availability; 'regulatory' to compliance-driven limits (e.g., FDA GMP, FSMA); 'seasonal' to demand-driven temporary constraints.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; JDA/Blue Yonder; FDA FSMA; GMP

attributes.name: constraint_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the capacity constraint record, used in SAP IBP and JDA/Blue Yonder planning runs to reference this constraint. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: constraint_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the capacity constraint (e.g., 'Line 3 Daily Throughput Cap', 'DC Chicago Pallet Positions'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: constraint_source
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this capacity constraint record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and reconciliation across planning systems. 'sap_ibp' = SAP Integrated Business Planning; 'jda_blue_yonder' = JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; 'aveva_mes' = Aveva/Wonderware MES; 'manual' = planner-entered; 'erp' = SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Cloud ERP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; JDA/Blue Yonder; Aveva/Wonderware MES; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: constraint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capacity constraint record. 'active' means the constraint is live and enforced in planning runs; 'inactive' means it has been retired or superseded; 'pending' means it is defined but not yet effective; 'suspended' means temporarily bypassed. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capacity constraint is a hard or soft limit in supply planning. 'hard' constraints cannot be violated by the planning engine (e.g., physical line speed, dock door count); 'soft' constraints can be overridden with a penalty cost or planner approval (e.g., preferred utilization ceiling, labor overtime threshold).
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity constraint record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Governance

attributes.name: dock_doors_available
attributes.description: Number of dock doors available at the DC for inbound and/or outbound operations within the capacity bucket. DC-specific metric used to plan ASN (Advanced Shipping Notice) scheduling, carrier appointments, and DSD (Direct Store Delivery) operations. Null when resource_type is not 'dock_door' or 'dc_throughput'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; ASN Standards

attributes.name: dock_doors_utilized
attributes.description: Number of dock doors actually scheduled or utilized within the capacity bucket period. Used alongside dock_doors_available to compute dock door utilization rate and identify scheduling bottlenecks at the DC.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: effective_capacity
attributes.description: Net usable capacity after applying OEE, planned downtime, changeover time, and other efficiency factors to the theoretical available_capacity. Represents the realistic throughput ceiling used in constrained supply planning runs. Expressed in capacity_uom.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; SAP S/4HANA PP-CRP; Aveva/Wonderware MES

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this capacity constraint record is no longer active and is excluded from planning runs. Null for open-ended constraints. Used to manage time-bound constraints such as seasonal capacity limits or temporary equipment outages.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; ISO 8601

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this capacity constraint record becomes effective and is enforced in planning runs. Enables forward-looking constraint management and scenario planning for known future capacity changes (e.g., planned line shutdowns, DC expansions).
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; ISO 8601

attributes.name: labor_hours_available
attributes.description: Total labor hours available for production or DC operations within the capacity bucket, accounting for scheduled shifts, headcount, and planned absences. Used in labor capacity planning and S&OP cycles. Null when resource_type is not 'labor'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Workday HCM; SAP IBP

attributes.name: labor_hours_utilized
attributes.description: Actual or planned labor hours consumed within the capacity bucket period. Used to assess workforce loading against available labor hours and identify overtime or underutilization scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Workday HCM; SAP IBP

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this capacity constraint record was last reviewed and validated by a supply planner or capacity manager. Used to ensure constraint parameters remain current and aligned with operational reality across S&OP cycles.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; S&OP Best Practices

attributes.name: oee_target_pct
attributes.description: Target OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) percentage for the production line or equipment resource within this capacity bucket. OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality. Used to set realistic effective capacity expectations in finite scheduling and SAP IBP planning runs. Applicable only when resource_type is 'production_line'.
attributes.references: Aveva/Wonderware MES Performance Analytics; OEE Industry Standard; SAP IBP

attributes.name: otif_risk_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Risk Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capacity constraint poses a risk to OTIF (On Time In Full) delivery performance (True = OTIF risk present). Set when the constraint is projected to cause order fulfillment shortfalls within the bucket period. Used to prioritize constraint resolution and escalation.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; OTIF Industry Standard

attributes.name: overflow_action
attributes.description: Recommended or approved action to resolve a capacity overload when bottleneck_flag is True. 'co_pack' triggers co-packing or toll manufacturing evaluation; '3pl_overflow' routes excess volume to a 3PL partner; 'demand_defer' defers lower-priority demand; 'interplant_transfer' reallocates production to another plant; 'none' means no action required.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: pallet_positions
attributes.description: Total number of pallet storage positions available at the DC or warehouse for this capacity bucket. DC-specific metric used in warehouse capacity management and network design. Null when resource_type is not 'storage' or 'dc_throughput'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; JDA/Blue Yonder Warehouse Management; WMS Standards

attributes.name: planned_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Hours of scheduled downtime within the capacity bucket for maintenance, sanitation (GMP/HACCP compliance), changeovers, or regulatory inspections. Reduces effective_capacity from available_capacity. Critical for food and beverage manufacturing where sanitation windows are mandated by GMP and FSMA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Aveva/Wonderware MES; FDA FSMA; GMP; HACCP

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for supply planners to document context, assumptions, or exceptions related to this capacity constraint (e.g., 'Line 3 down for allergen deep clean week of 2024-03-11', 'DC Chicago dock expansion in progress'). Supports S&OP cycle documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; JDA/Blue Yonder; S&OP Best Practices

attributes.name: planning_version
attributes.description: Identifier for the SAP IBP or JDA planning version or scenario to which this capacity constraint record belongs (e.g., 'BASELINE', 'SCENARIO_A', 'CONSENSUS'). Enables multi-scenario capacity analysis and S&OP cycle management.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capacity constraint is driven by a regulatory hold or compliance requirement (True = regulatory-driven constraint). Examples include FDA FSMA inspection holds, USDA audit shutdowns, or GMP sanitation mandates that reduce available production capacity.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA; GMP; HACCP; GFSI

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the type of supply chain resource to which this capacity constraint applies. Drives how the constraint is interpreted in finite capacity planning: production_line (manufacturing throughput), dc_throughput (Distribution Center inbound/outbound volume), transportation_lane (carrier/lane capacity), dock_door (DC dock door availability), labor (workforce hours), storage (pallet positions or cubic volume). Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: safety_stock_impact
attributes.description: Quantity of safety stock that cannot be replenished due to this capacity constraint within the bucket period, expressed in capacity_uom. Used in inventory optimization to quantify the risk exposure created by constrained capacity and inform safety stock parameter adjustments in SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity constraint record was last modified. Used to detect changes between planning cycles and support incremental Silver layer processing and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Governance

attributes.name: utilization_ceiling_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable utilization percentage for this resource before the constraint is flagged as a bottleneck or overload. Typically set below 100% to preserve buffer capacity (e.g., 85% for production lines to allow for changeovers and maintenance, 90% for DC throughput). Used in SAP IBP and JDA planning to trigger alerts and rebalancing.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; OEE Standards

attributes.name: utilization_pct
attributes.description: Ratio of utilized_capacity to available_capacity expressed as a percentage (0–100). Calculated field stored for planning visibility: utilization_pct = (utilized_capacity / available_capacity) * 100. Used to identify bottleneck resources and trigger network rebalancing decisions. Values above the utilization_ceiling_pct indicate an overload condition.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) Standards

attributes.name: utilized_capacity
attributes.description: Actual or planned capacity consumed within the bucket period, expressed in the same unit of measure as available_capacity (capacity_uom). Used to compute utilization rate and identify bottlenecks. In constrained planning runs, this reflects the sum of all planned orders or shipments assigned to this resource.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Capacity Management; SAP S/4HANA PP-CRP; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

products.name: inbound_receipt
products.description: Goods receipt transaction recorded in SAP S/4HANA MM when inbound materials or finished goods are physically received at a plant or DC. Captures purchase order reference, delivery note, material, batch/lot number, quantity received, unit of measure, storage location, valuation price, and posting date. Triggers inventory update and accounts payable posting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt (MIGO)

attributes.name: goods_receipt_note

attributes.name: incoterms

attributes.name: is_return_delivery

attributes.name: manufacture_date

attributes.name: movement_type

attributes.name: po_ordered_qty

attributes.name: case_fill_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of cases shipped to cases ordered, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9750 = 97.50%). Measures the degree to which the order was fulfilled at the case level. Key metric for supply chain customer service performance.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OTIF performance record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking per lakehouse governance standards.

attributes.name: delivered_qty
attributes.description: Total quantity of the SKU confirmed as received by the customer or retailer, which may differ from shipped quantity due to transit damage, short receipt, or carrier discrepancies.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Externally-known outbound delivery document number from the ERP or WMS system (e.g., SAP delivery number). Serves as the primary business identifier for this OTIF performance record and is used in retailer dispute resolution and carrier communications.

attributes.name: is_in_full
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shipment met the in-full delivery threshold as defined by the retailer or customer OTIF policy (typically 100% or a defined fill rate threshold). True = in-full; False = short shipment.

attributes.name: is_on_time
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shipment was delivered on or before the required delivery date per the retailer or customer OTIF policy. True = on-time delivery; False = late delivery.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Policy; Target OTIF Policy; SAP IBP

attributes.name: is_otif
attributes.description: Boolean composite flag indicating whether the shipment satisfied BOTH the on-time AND in-full criteria simultaneously. True = OTIF compliant; False = OTIF non-compliant. Primary KPI for retailer scorecard reporting.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Policy; Target OTIF Policy; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: is_penalty_assessed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a retailer OTIF fine or chargeback has been formally assessed and invoiced against this shipment. True = penalty assessed; False = no penalty assessed or still under review.

attributes.name: is_substitution
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an alternative SKU was substituted for the originally ordered SKU due to supply shortage or product unavailability. True = substitution occurred; False = original SKU shipped.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: line_fill_rate

attributes.references: GS1 Supply Chain Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: penalty_currency

attributes.name: penalty_exposure_amt
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of retailer OTIF fines or chargebacks associated with this non-compliant shipment, expressed in the transaction currency. Used for financial exposure tracking and trade compliance management.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Fine Policy; Target OTIF Compliance Policy; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Retailer or customer-issued purchase order number associated with this shipment. Used for retailer scorecard reconciliation and OTIF fine dispute resolution.

attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Walmart OTIF Policy; Target OTIF Policy

attributes.name: retailer_scorecard_window

attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Policy; Target OTIF Compliance Policy

attributes.name: root_cause_detail
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional detail on the root cause of an OTIF failure beyond the root cause category. Captures specific circumstances such as ingredient shortage, carrier equipment failure, or DC picking error for corrective action documentation.

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: The date the shipment physically departed the Distribution Center (DC) or manufacturing facility. Used to assess carrier transit time and identify DC-side delays contributing to OTIF failures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM/SD Module; EDI 856 ASN Standard

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shipment associated with this OTIF performance record. Tracks the workflow state from order release through final delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Oracle Cloud Supply Chain

attributes.name: shipped_qty
attributes.description: Total quantity of the SKU actually shipped to the customer, expressed in the order unit of measure. Used as the numerator for in-full and case fill rate compliance calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/WM Module; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this OTIF performance record was sourced (e.g., SAP S/4HANA SD, Oracle Cloud Supply Chain, JDA/Blue Yonder TMS). Supports data lineage and audit traceability in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Oracle Cloud Supply Chain; JDA/Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used for this shipment (e.g., TL=Truckload, LTL=Less-than-Truckload, parcel, rail, intermodal, ocean). Influences OTIF transit time expectations and carrier accountability.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OTIF performance record was last modified in the data platform, such as when root cause classification was updated or penalty status was revised. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Governance

domains.name: distribution
domains.description: Owns physical distribution and outbound logistics execution — DC operations, WMS transactions, order fulfillment, carrier management, route optimization, OTIF/fill rate KPIs, cold chain compliance, ASN processing, 3PL performance, cross-docking, DSD route management, proof of delivery, and last-mile logistics for retail, foodservice, and DTC fulfillment.
domains.references: GS1 ASN Standards, FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule, GS1 Logistics Standards, ISO 28000

attributes.name: company_code_id

attributes.name: address_line_2

attributes.name: center_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the distribution center facility.

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: contact_email_address

attributes.name: contact_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the distribution center facility for operational coordination and emergency contact.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the distribution center location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: cross_dock_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center has cross-docking capabilities to transfer products directly from inbound to outbound without storage.

attributes.name: cubic_capacity
attributes.description: Total cubic footage storage capacity of the distribution center for volumetric capacity planning.

attributes.name: dc_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the distribution center used across operational systems and external communications. Typically alphanumeric facility code.

attributes.name: direct_store_delivery_hub_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center serves as a hub for Direct Store Delivery operations to retail locations.

attributes.name: dock_door_count
attributes.description: Total number of loading dock doors available for inbound and outbound shipments. Critical for throughput capacity analysis.

attributes.name: ecommerce_fulfillment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center handles direct-to-consumer e-commerce order fulfillment and last-mile delivery.

attributes.name: erp_plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or location code in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA) representing this distribution center for financial and supply chain transactions.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution center based on primary storage and handling capability. Ambient for dry goods, refrigerated for chilled products, frozen for sub-zero storage, multi-temperature for mixed zones, cross-dock for flow-through operations, consolidation for order aggregation.

attributes.name: frozen_zone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center has frozen storage zones for products requiring sub-zero temperature storage.

attributes.name: haccp_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center has HACCP certification for food safety management. Required for facilities handling high-risk food products.

attributes.name: inbound_dock_door_count

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center has ISO 9001 quality management system certification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the distribution center record was last updated in the system. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the distribution center in decimal degrees for geospatial analysis and route optimization.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the facility lease agreement for leased distribution centers. Nullable for owned facilities. Used for real estate planning and renewal management.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the distribution center in decimal degrees for geospatial analysis and route optimization.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekdays (Monday-Friday) in format HH:MM-HH:MM (e.g., 06:00-22:00). Used for scheduling and service level planning.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekend
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekends (Saturday-Sunday) in format HH:MM-HH:MM. Nullable if facility does not operate on weekends.

attributes.name: operational_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution center began operational activities and started processing inventory and shipments.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the distribution center in its lifecycle. Active indicates full operations, inactive for non-operational but maintained, under construction for facilities being built, decommissioned for permanently closed, seasonal for periodic operations, temporarily closed for short-term shutdowns.

attributes.name: outbound_dock_door_count
attributes.description: Number of dock doors dedicated to shipping outbound orders to customers, retail stores, and distribution points.

attributes.name: ownership_model
attributes.description: Ownership and operational control model for the distribution center. Company-owned for internal facilities, third-party logistics (3PL) for outsourced operations, leased for rented facilities with internal operations, co-managed for hybrid arrangements.

attributes.name: pallet_position_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of pallet positions available for storage in the distribution center. Key metric for inventory capacity planning.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the distribution center location used for shipping and logistics routing.

attributes.name: refrigerated_zone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center has refrigerated storage zones for chilled products requiring cold chain management.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or primary administrative division where the distribution center is located.

attributes.name: storage_square_footage
attributes.description: Square footage dedicated to product storage areas excluding staging, dock, and administrative space.

attributes.name: temperature_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct temperature-controlled zones within the distribution center for managing products with different storage requirements.

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party logistics provider managing the facility if ownership model is 3PL or co-managed. Null for company-owned facilities.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the distribution center location used for scheduling and operational time calculations (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago).

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Total building square footage of the distribution center facility including all storage, staging, and administrative areas.

attributes.name: twenty_four_seven_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for continuous fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: wms_system_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier for the Warehouse Management System instance managing this distribution center. Used for system integration and data reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP WM / Blue Yonder WMS Integration Standard

products.name: carrier
products.description: Master record for all transportation carriers (TL, LTL, parcel, refrigerated, DSD fleet) used in outbound distribution. Captures SCAC code, DOT/MC number, carrier type, service modes, insurance certificates, FSMA Sanitary Transportation compliance status, cold chain capability flags, EDI capability, contracted rate tier, and performance tier classification. SSOT for carrier identity in the distribution domain.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transportation carrier. Primary key for the carrier master record.

attributes.name: fsma_record_id

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_contract. Business justification: Freight carriers in F&B are contracted through procurement via freight/3PL purchase contracts. Linking carrier to its governing purchase contract enables contract compliance monitoring, rate validatio

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the transportation carrier organization as registered with regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: carrier_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the carrier in the approved carrier network. Controls eligibility for load assignment.

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Classification of carrier business model: asset-based (owns equipment), non-asset-based (brokerage), third-party logistics provider, private fleet (company-owned), or Direct Store Delivery fleet.

attributes.name: claims_ratio_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments resulting in damage, loss, or shortage claims over the past 12 months. Used for carrier risk assessment.

attributes.name: cold_chain_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has temperature-controlled equipment and processes certified for transporting refrigerated and frozen food products.

attributes.name: contracted_rate_tier
attributes.description: Rate tier classification based on contracted pricing agreement. Tier 1 represents preferred pricing, spot market represents non-contracted rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: dispatch_phone

attributes.name: dot_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier issued by the US Department of Transportation Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration for interstate commercial carriers.

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports EDI transaction sets for load tendering, status updates, and Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) processing.

attributes.name: edi_protocol
attributes.description: Technical protocol used for electronic data interchange with the carrier: ANSI X12, EDIFACT, API integration, or none.

attributes.name: fleet_size
attributes.description: Total number of power units (tractors, trucks) operated by the carrier. Used for capacity planning and carrier capability assessment.

attributes.name: fsma_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the carrier received FSMA Sanitary Transportation compliance certification. Used to track recertification cycles.

attributes.name: fsma_compliant_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier meets FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food requirements including temperature control, equipment sanitation, and training documentation.

attributes.name: fsma_expiration_date

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the carriers corporate headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the carriers headquarters location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the carriers corporate headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code where the carriers corporate headquarters is located.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the carriers liability and cargo insurance certificate on file. Required for carrier qualification.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Total liability coverage amount in USD provided by the carriers insurance policy. Must meet minimum threshold for carrier approval.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the carriers current insurance policy. Carrier status automatically suspended if insurance lapses.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent carrier compliance audit covering safety, food safety, insurance, and operational standards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier master record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: mc_number
attributes.description: Operating authority number issued by FMCSA for for-hire interstate carriers. Required for carriers transporting regulated commodities.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next carrier compliance audit. Used to trigger audit planning and carrier notification.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the carrier was approved and onboarded into the approved carrier network. Marks the start of the business relationship.

attributes.name: otif_percentage
attributes.description: Rolling 12-month percentage of shipments delivered on-time and in-full without damage or shortage. Key performance indicator for carrier evaluation.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard payment terms in days from invoice date for carrier freight charges (e.g., Net 30, Net 45).

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Performance classification based on On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery, claims ratio, and service quality metrics. Determines load allocation priority.

attributes.name: preferred_carrier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is designated as a preferred partner with priority load allocation and strategic relationship status.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary carrier contact for operational communications and load coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the carrier organization for operational coordination and issue escalation.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary carrier contact for urgent operational issues and load coordination.

attributes.name: safety_rating
attributes.description: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration safety rating based on compliance review. Satisfactory rating required for carrier approval.

attributes.name: scac_code
attributes.description: Four-letter unique identifier assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) for transportation companies. Used in EDI transactions and shipping documentation.

attributes.name: service_coverage_region
attributes.description: Geographic regions where the carrier provides transportation services. Free-text description of coverage area (e.g., US Midwest, Eastern Seaboard, National).

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation service offered by the carrier. Defines equipment type and service level capability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|less_than_truckload|parcel|intermodal|refrigerated|dry_van|flatbed|tanker — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in Celsius that the carriers refrigerated equipment can maintain. Critical for chilled food distribution.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in Celsius that the carriers refrigerated equipment can maintain. Critical for frozen food distribution.

products.name: delivery_route
products.description: Master definition and execution record for recurring outbound delivery routes used in DSD (Direct Store Delivery) and DC-to-customer distribution. Master attributes (relatively static, updated infrequently): route code, route type (DSD, DC-to-retail, foodservice, DTC), assigned territory, stop sequence template, estimated mileage, frequency, vehicle type requirement, cold chain requirement, and active status. Execution attributes (one record per route-day execution instance): execution date, driver, vehicle, start/end times, stops planned vs completed, cases loaded/delivered/returned/refused, cash/check collections, handheld device ID, and route completion status. The master portion defines the route template; execution instances capture daily operational performance against that template. SSOT for all route definition and route execution data in the distribution domain, including DSD operational performance. Supports route optimization, driver assignment, territory management, and DSD operational reporting.
products.reference: Route Master (JDA TMS, DSD Route Management)

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery route. Primary key for the delivery route entity.

attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center or warehouse that serves as the origin point for this route. All deliveries on this route originate from this DC.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: In F&B DSD operations, each delivery route is assigned a cost center for route profitability analysis — driver wages, fuel, and vehicle costs are allocated by route. Finance uses this for cost-per-sto

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.market. Business justification: Route planning aligns to geographic markets for ACV distribution tracking and market penetration reporting. F&B distribution planners and brand teams jointly review route coverage by market during new

attributes.name: rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: In F&B pre-sell DSD operations, delivery routes are coordinated with assigned sales reps who pre-sell the route stops. Linking route to rep enables rep-level route performance reporting, commission ca

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales or distribution territory to which this route is assigned. Used for territory management and sales alignment.

attributes.name: actual_mileage
attributes.description: Actual total mileage driven during route execution, captured from vehicle telematics or odometer readings. Used for cost analysis and route optimization.

attributes.name: cases_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of product cases successfully delivered to customers during route execution. Used for fill rate calculation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: cases_loaded
attributes.description: Total number of product cases loaded onto the vehicle at route start. Used for inventory reconciliation and load planning analysis.

attributes.name: cases_refused
attributes.description: Total number of product cases refused by customers during delivery due to quality issues, order discrepancies, or receiving problems. Subset of cases_returned.

attributes.name: cases_returned
attributes.description: Total number of product cases returned to the distribution center undelivered. Includes unsold inventory from DSD routes and refused deliveries.

attributes.name: cash_collected
attributes.description: Total cash payments collected from customers during route execution. Applicable primarily to DSD routes with cash-on-delivery transactions. Used for cash reconciliation.

attributes.name: check_collected
attributes.description: Total check payments collected from customers during route execution. Applicable primarily to DSD routes. Used for accounts receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route requires temperature-controlled (refrigerated or frozen) transportation to maintain product quality and food safety compliance. True if any stop requires cold chain.
attributes.references: Food Safety Standard - Cold Chain Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this route master definition became active and available for scheduling. Used for route lifecycle management and historical analysis.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the driver returned to the distribution center and completed route execution. Used for route duration analysis and driver shift management.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned total duration for route completion in minutes, including drive time, stop time, and loading/unloading. Used for driver scheduling and shift planning.

attributes.name: estimated_mileage
attributes.description: Planned total mileage for the route in miles, based on stop sequence and routing optimization. Used for cost estimation and vehicle assignment.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which this route instance was executed. For route execution records, this is the primary business event date. For route master records, this field may be null.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this route master definition is scheduled to be retired or replaced. Null for routes with no planned end date. Used for route lifecycle management.

attributes.name: fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered cases that were successfully delivered on this route. Calculated as (cases_delivered / cases_loaded) * 100. Key metric for order fulfillment performance.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this route is executed. DAILY for every business day, WEEKLY for once per week, BIWEEKLY for every two weeks, MONTHLY for once per month, ON_DEMAND for ad-hoc execution.

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_gallons
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed during route execution in gallons. Captured from vehicle telematics or fuel card transactions. Used for cost allocation and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: handheld_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the mobile handheld device (scanner, tablet, or mobile computer) used by the driver for proof of delivery, order capture, and route tracking.

attributes.name: hazmat_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route transports hazardous materials requiring special handling, placarding, and driver certification per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: otif_performance_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Performance Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of deliveries on this route that met both on-time and in-full criteria. Key performance indicator for distribution service level. Calculated as (on-time and in-full deliveries / total planned deliveries) * 100.

attributes.name: route_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the route, used for operational reference and scheduling. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by transportation management system.

attributes.name: route_completion_status
attributes.description: Overall completion status of the route execution instance. COMPLETED indicates all planned stops were attempted, PARTIAL indicates some stops were skipped, CANCELLED indicates route was aborted, IN_PROGRESS indicates route is currently being executed, NOT_STARTED indicates route has not yet begun.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the route, often including geographic or customer references (e.g., 'Downtown Chicago Loop', 'Northeast Territory A').

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the route template. ACTIVE routes are in regular operation, INACTIVE are temporarily not in use, SUSPENDED are on hold pending review, PLANNED are designed but not yet operational, RETIRED are permanently discontinued.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route based on delivery model. DSD (Direct Store Delivery) for direct-to-retail routes, DC_TO_RETAIL for distribution center to retail, FOODSERVICE for restaurant/institutional delivery, DTC for direct-to-consumer, CROSS_DOCK for cross-docking operations, BACKHAUL for return logistics.

attributes.name: scheduled_days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days when route is scheduled to run (e.g., 'MON,WED,FRI'). Applicable for WEEKLY and BIWEEKLY frequency routes.

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the driver departed the distribution center to begin route execution. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) performance tracking.

attributes.name: stop_count
attributes.description: Number of planned delivery stops on this route. Used for route complexity assessment and driver workload planning.

attributes.name: stops_completed
attributes.description: Number of delivery stops successfully completed during this route execution. Used to calculate route completion rate and identify service failures.

attributes.name: stops_planned
attributes.description: Number of delivery stops planned for this route execution instance. Used to calculate route completion rate.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_f
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in Fahrenheit for cold chain routes. Used for temperature monitoring and compliance verification. Null for non-cold-chain routes.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_f
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in Fahrenheit for cold chain routes. Used for temperature monitoring and compliance verification. Null for non-cold-chain routes.

attributes.name: vehicle_type_required
attributes.description: Type of vehicle required to execute this route based on cargo volume, weight, and special handling requirements. Determines vehicle assignment from fleet.
