attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this fulfillment order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order is designated for cross-docking operations, where goods move directly from receiving to shipping without intermediate storage. True indicates cross-dock handling; false indicates standard warehouse flow with putaway and storage.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time the order was delivered to the customer. Captured from proof of delivery or carrier tracking. Used for OTIF measurement and service level compliance.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of exception or disruption encountered during fulfillment execution. Examples include inventory shortage, damaged product, carrier delay, address error, or customer request change. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the exception or disruption encountered during fulfillment. Provides context for resolution actions and root cause investigation.

attributes.name: exception_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of exception resolution efforts. Open indicates exception has been identified but not yet addressed; in_progress indicates resolution actions are underway; resolved indicates exception has been successfully resolved; escalated indicates exception requires management intervention.

attributes.name: fill_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the order quantity that was successfully fulfilled and shipped. Calculated as shipped quantity divided by ordered quantity. Used for service level measurement and inventory availability analysis.

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel
attributes.description: The business channel through which this order is being fulfilled. Determines handling requirements, service level expectations, and routing logic. Retail represents traditional grocery and mass merchandiser channels; foodservice represents restaurant and institutional channels; direct-to-consumer (DTC) represents online orders shipped to individual consumers; direct store delivery (DSD) represents orders delivered directly to retail stores bypassing DC consolidation.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the fulfillment order. Used for operational tracking, communication with warehouse staff, and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fulfillment order within the distribution execution process. Released indicates order is available for wave assignment; wave_assigned indicates order is assigned to a picking wave; picking indicates order is actively being picked; picked indicates picking is complete; packing indicates order is being packed; packed indicates packing is complete; staged indicates order is staged for loading; loaded indicates order is loaded on carrier vehicle; shipped indicates order has departed the DC; in_transit indicates order is en route to destination; delivered indicates order has been received by customer; exception indicates order has encountered a problem requiring intervention; cancelled indicates order has been cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: released|wave_assigned|picking|picked|packing|packed|staged|loaded|shipped|in_transit|delivered|exception|cancelled — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and transportation compliance. True indicates hazmat present; false indicates no hazmat.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this fulfillment order record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: order_release_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the fulfillment order was released from the order management system to the warehouse management system for execution. Marks the start of the fulfillment lifecycle.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment order based on handling and processing requirements. Standard represents normal replenishment orders; rush represents expedited orders requiring priority handling; cross-dock represents orders that bypass storage and move directly from receiving to shipping; drop-ship represents orders shipped directly from supplier to customer; sample represents non-commercial product samples; promotional represents orders tied to marketing campaigns or trade promotions.

attributes.name: otif_target_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order is included in On-Time In-Full performance measurement. True indicates order is subject to OTIF service level agreements; false indicates order is excluded from OTIF metrics (e.g., sample orders, internal transfers).

attributes.name: picking_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when all picking operations were completed for this fulfillment order. Used for cycle time analysis and throughput measurement.

attributes.name: picking_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when picking operations began for this fulfillment order. Used for cycle time analysis and warehouse productivity measurement.

attributes.name: planned_ship_date
attributes.description: The date the distribution center plans to ship the order based on capacity, inventory availability, and carrier schedules. May differ from requested ship date due to operational constraints.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the fulfillment order for warehouse resource allocation and sequencing. Critical represents emergency orders requiring immediate processing; high represents time-sensitive orders with tight delivery windows; normal represents standard priority orders; low represents orders that can be delayed if capacity constraints exist.

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date committed to the customer for delivery of the order. Used for On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance measurement and customer service level tracking.

attributes.name: requested_ship_date
attributes.description: The date the customer or sales order requested the order to ship from the distribution center. Used for planning and scheduling warehouse operations.

attributes.name: ship_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time the order departed the distribution center. Used for transit time calculation and carrier performance tracking.

attributes.name: total_order_cases
attributes.description: The total number of cases or cartons in the fulfillment order. Used for warehouse productivity measurement, handling cost allocation, and load planning.

attributes.name: total_order_lines
attributes.description: The total number of distinct line items or SKUs in the fulfillment order. Used for picking complexity assessment and labor planning.

attributes.name: total_order_pallets
attributes.description: The total number of pallets in the fulfillment order, including partial pallets expressed as decimal values. Used for transportation planning, dock scheduling, and freight cost calculation.

attributes.name: total_order_volume_m3
attributes.description: The total cubic volume of the fulfillment order in cubic meters. Used for warehouse space planning, vehicle capacity utilization, and freight cost calculation.

attributes.name: total_order_weight_kg
attributes.description: The total gross weight of the fulfillment order in kilograms, including product and packaging. Used for carrier selection, freight cost calculation, and load planning.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for shipment visibility and proof of delivery. Used for customer service inquiries and delivery status monitoring.

products.name: fulfillment_order_line
products.description: Line-level detail for each SKU within a fulfillment order. Captures line number, SKU/GTIN, ordered quantity (cases/eaches), confirmed quantity, UOM, lot number, expiration date, FEFO pick flag, catch-weight actual, line status, and any short-ship reason code. Enables lot traceability and FEFO compliance at the line level.
products.reference: Delivery Item / Transfer Order Item (SAP S/4HANA WM)

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment order line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: FSMA lot traceability requires knowing which manufacturing batch was picked for each fulfillment order line. Enables recall execution, regulatory reporting, and shelf-life/FEFO compliance at the order

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order header. Links this line to its parent order document.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: In F&B revenue recognition, each fulfillment order line maps to a GL account for product category revenue and COGS posting. Supports ASC 606 line-level revenue recognition and accurate P&L reporting b

attributes.name: ingredient_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ingredient.lot. Business justification: Recall Management Process: order lines need the exact ingredient lot to enable precise product recalls.

attributes.name: packaging_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_spec. Business justification: Warehouse pick/pack/ship process: packaging_spec defines units_per_case, pallet_ti_hi, cases_per_layer, and gross_weight_g used to calculate carton_count, pallet builds, and cube/weight on each fulfil

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Line‑level traceability ties each order line to the specific production order that produced the SKU.

attributes.name: promotion_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_line. Business justification: Each order line may be driven by a specific promotion line; linking enables accurate promotion ROI and claim reconciliation.

attributes.name: recall_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.recall_event. Business justification: During a product recall, fulfillment order lines containing affected SKUs and lot numbers must be identified, quarantined, and reported. FSMA recall traceability requirements mandate linking shipped l

attributes.name: shelf_life_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.shelf_life_spec. Business justification: FEFO picking and retailer MRSL compliance: shelf_life_spec defines mrsl_days, dc_receiving_standard, and rotation_rule that govern which lot is picked for each order line. Retailer chargebacks for sho

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.shipment. Business justification: Partial shipments require linking each line to the shipment it was shipped on; many lines per shipment, each line may appear on multiple shipments, so child side gets FK.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product record. Links this line to the product master data for detailed product attributes.

attributes.name: allocated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when inventory was allocated to this line. Marks the beginning of the fulfillment process.

attributes.name: backorder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unfulfilled quantity from this line was placed on backorder for future fulfillment. Used for backorder management and customer service.

attributes.name: carton_count
attributes.description: Number of cartons or cases used to fulfill this line. Used for packaging and freight calculation.

attributes.name: catch_weight_actual
attributes.description: Actual weight for catch-weight items where weight varies by unit. Used for variable-weight products like fresh produce, meat, or cheese.

attributes.name: catch_weight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for catch weight. Defines whether weight is expressed in pounds, kilograms, ounces, or grams.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU confirmed for fulfillment and actually picked. May differ from ordered quantity due to inventory availability or allocation rules.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fulfillment order line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the line amount. Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-by date for the lot being fulfilled. Used for FEFO picking logic and shelf life management.

attributes.name: fefo_pick_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Pick Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line was picked using FEFO logic to ensure oldest expiration dates are shipped first. Critical for perishable food and beverage products.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global trade item number (UPC/EAN) for the product. Standardized identifier used across the supply chain for product identification.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling and shipping compliance. Relevant for certain cleaning chemicals or alcohol products.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the fulfillment order. Determines the ordering and position of this line item in the order.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of the order line. Tracks the line through the warehouse execution lifecycle from allocation to shipment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|allocated|picked|packed|shipped|cancelled|short_shipped — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value for this line (quantity × unit price). Used for order value calculation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fulfillment order line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU originally ordered by the customer. Represents the requested amount before any adjustments or shortages.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: Original SKU that was ordered if a substitution was made. Null if no substitution occurred.

attributes.name: packed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the line was packed for shipment. Used for packing efficiency and order completion tracking.

attributes.name: pick_zone
attributes.description: Warehouse zone or area where the product was picked. Used for labor planning and zone-based picking strategies.

attributes.name: picked_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the line was physically picked from warehouse inventory. Used for pick productivity and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Date the product was manufactured or packaged. Used for shelf life calculation and quality tracking.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Trade promotion or discount code applied to this line. Used for TPM tracking and promotional effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line underwent quality inspection before shipment. Used for quality assurance and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items. Used for high-value products requiring individual unit tracking.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the SKU shipped to the customer. Final quantity that left the distribution center.

attributes.name: shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the line was shipped from the distribution center. Used for OTIF calculation and ASN generation.

attributes.name: short_ship_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the line was short-shipped or not fully fulfilled. Used for fill rate analysis and root cause investigation.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit code identifying the specific product variant being fulfilled. Used for inventory tracking and warehouse operations.

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a product substitution was made for this line due to stockout or customer approval. Used for substitution rate tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature zone for the product. Critical for cold chain compliance and proper storage of perishable food and beverage items.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit for this line item. Used for invoice generation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the line quantity. Defines whether quantities are expressed in cases, eaches, pallets, or other packaging units.

attributes.name: warehouse_location
attributes.description: Specific warehouse bin or location from which the product was picked. Used for inventory accuracy and slotting optimization.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Physical shipment record consolidating one or more fulfillment orders onto a single carrier move, including load configuration details. Captures shipment number, carrier, service level, trailer/container number, seal number, origin DC, destination, scheduled/actual pickup and delivery datetimes, total weight, total cube, pallet count, utilization percentage, loading sequence, freight cost, temperature requirement (ambient/refrigerated/frozen), temperature zone segregation, and shipment status. Supports outbound logistics execution, carrier performance tracking, freight cost management, and cold chain compliance documentation.
products.reference: Shipment / Freight Order (JDA TMS, SAP S/4HANA SD)

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical shipment record. Primary key for the shipment entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Retailer OTIF compliance programs and chargeback management require linking shipments directly to the customer account (the contractual party), not just the ship-to location. Enables account-level shi

attributes.name: bill_to_location_id

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand KPI report requires each shipment linked to its primary brand for on‑time‑in‑full and cost analysis.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Campaign fulfillment tracking needs to tie shipments generated by a specific marketing campaign to measure lift and ROI.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for moving the shipment.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or warehouse from which the shipment originates.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for freight cost allocation to internal cost centers for accurate expense reporting per shipment.

attributes.name: delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the delivery route or multi-stop tour that this shipment is part of, used for route optimization and DSD operations.

attributes.name: edi_trading_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.edi_trading_partner. Business justification: Each shipment triggers an ASN (EDI 856 transaction) routed to the customer's EDI trading partner. Shipment already tracks asn_sent_flag and asn_sent_datetime; direct FK to edi_trading_partner enables

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: FDA requires food shipments to originate from registered establishments (21 CFR Part 1). Linking shipment to establishment_registration enables FSMA compliance verification and regulatory audit trails

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Needed to post freight expense of each shipment to the appropriate GL account for financial statements.

attributes.name: import_export_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.import_export_permit. Business justification: International shipments require an active import/export permit for customs clearance and FDA prior notice compliance. FSMA and CBP regulations mandate linking each cross-border shipment to its governi

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.market. Business justification: Market-level shipment volume, freight cost, and OTIF reporting is a standard F&B supply chain KPI used jointly by distribution and brand/marketing teams. No existing FK on shipment points to market; s

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Logistics planning requires knowing the originating plant for each shipment.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Inbound supplier shipments arriving at DCs must be matched to purchase orders for FSMA traceability, three-way match (PO/shipment/invoice), and inbound logistics planning. F&B supply chain teams routi

attributes.name: recall_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.recall_event. Business justification: Recall coordinators must identify all shipments containing recalled product for interception or retrieval. Linking shipment to recall_event enables distribution scope analysis, carrier notification, a

attributes.name: retailer_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.retailer_agreement. Business justification: Compliance reporting requires each shipment to be linked to the retailer agreement governing delivery windows, fees, and penalties.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Required for Shipment‑Order reconciliation report used in OTIF compliance; each shipment must be tied to the originating sales order.

attributes.name: ship_from_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.location. Business justification: The domain description for the location product explicitly states it is 'Referenced by ship_from_location_id', confirming this FK is intentionally designed. shipment already has ship_to_location_id →

attributes.name: ship_to_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination location (customer site, retail store, or receiving facility) for the shipment.

attributes.name: store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.store. Business justification: Store-level shipment tracking is fundamental to F&B retail execution and DSD compliance reporting. Retailers require store-level ASN and delivery confirmation. The existing ship_to_location_id (custom

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Inbound receipt of goods from a supplier to a distribution center is tracked in shipments for inventory, quality, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_datetime
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the shipment was delivered to the destination location, used for OTIF and SLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: actual_pickup_datetime
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the carrier picked up the shipment from the origin DC, used for OTIF performance tracking.

attributes.name: asn_sent_datetime
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) Sent Date and Time
attributes.description: Date and time when the ASN was transmitted to the customer, used for EDI compliance and customer notification tracking.

attributes.name: asn_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an EDI 856 Advanced Shipping Notice has been transmitted to the customer or receiving facility.

attributes.name: case_count
attributes.description: Total number of cases or cartons included in the shipment across all pallets.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipment record was first created in the WMS or TMS system.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment was processed through a cross-docking operation without long-term storage at the DC.

attributes.name: delivery_exception_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any delivery exception or issue encountered during shipment (e.g., damaged product, refused delivery, address error, weather delay).

attributes.name: delivery_exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing any delivery exceptions, issues, or special circumstances encountered during shipment execution.

attributes.name: dsd_route_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment is part of a DSD route where products are delivered directly to retail stores, bypassing retailer DCs.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight cost charged by the carrier for this shipment, used for freight spend analysis and accrual.

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the freight cost amount.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and carrier certification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipment record was last updated, used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: loading_sequence
attributes.description: Instructions or sequence identifier for how pallets should be loaded into the trailer to optimize delivery route and unloading efficiency.

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Celsius for the shipment to maintain product quality and safety during transit.

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Celsius for the shipment to maintain product quality and safety during transit.

attributes.name: otif_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment met OTIF performance criteria (delivered on time and with complete order quantity), a key supply chain KPI.

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Total number of pallets or handling units included in the shipment.

attributes.name: pod_signature_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who signed for the delivery at the destination location, captured as part of proof of delivery.

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the proof of delivery was captured, typically matching or closely following the actual delivery datetime.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether proof of delivery documentation (signature, photo, or electronic confirmation) has been received from the carrier or customer.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_datetime
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the shipment is scheduled to arrive at the destination location.

attributes.name: scheduled_pickup_datetime
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the carrier is scheduled to pick up the shipment from the origin DC.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number applied to the trailer or container to ensure tamper-evidence and cargo integrity during transit.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: The transportation service level or speed tier selected for this shipment (e.g., standard ground, expedited, next-day).

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shipment, used for tracking and communication with carriers and customers.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shipment in the outbound logistics workflow.

attributes.name: stop_sequence
attributes.description: The sequence number of this delivery stop within the overall route, used for route planning and driver instructions.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Temperature control requirement for the shipment to maintain cold chain compliance and product quality (ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or controlled).

attributes.name: temperature_zone_segregation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains products requiring segregation into multiple temperature zones within the same trailer.

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment was fulfilled by a third-party logistics provider rather than a company-owned distribution center.

attributes.name: total_cube_m3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Shipment Cube in Cubic Meters
attributes.description: Total volumetric cube of the shipment in cubic meters, used for load planning and carrier billing.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including product, packaging, and pallets.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: The trailer, container, or vehicle identification number assigned to this shipment for physical transport.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of trailer or container capacity utilized by this shipment, calculated based on weight or cube constraints.

products.name: proof_of_delivery
products.description: Electronic or paper Proof of Delivery (POD) record confirming receipt of goods at the customer location. Captures POD number, shipment reference, stop reference, delivery datetime, receiver name, receiver signature (digital), cases received, cases refused, refusal reason, temperature at delivery (cold chain), condition notes, and POD capture method (ePOD, paper scan, EDI 214). Critical for OTIF measurement, dispute resolution, and invoice matching.
products.reference: POD / ePOD (EDI 214, SAP S/4HANA SD)

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the proof of delivery record.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who received the delivery.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: POD is required to clear AR invoices and resolve retailer deductions in F&B O2C. Finance matches PODs to AR invoices to release payment holds, clear open items, and dispute short-payments. Core collec

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or third-party logistics (3PL) provider that executed the delivery.

attributes.name: delivery_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery order fulfilled by this delivery.

attributes.name: delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery route on which this delivery was executed, used for Direct Store Delivery (DSD) route management.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.invoice. Business justification: POD confirmation triggers invoice release for payment in F&B AR processes. The proof_of_delivery has an invoice_matched boolean flag but no FK to the actual invoice record. Accounts receivable teams m

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: POD records are primary supporting documentation for promotional compliance validation and deduction dispute resolution in F&B. Retailers submit deductions based on promotional delivery compliance; PO

attributes.name: retailer_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.retailer_agreement. Business justification: POD records validate delivery compliance against retailer agreement terms (delivery condition requirements, time window commitments, penalty thresholds). Direct FK enables automated agreement complian

attributes.name: ship_to_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific delivery location (store, warehouse, distribution center) where goods were received.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment that this proof of delivery confirms.

attributes.name: store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.store. Business justification: In F&B DSD operations, PODs are captured at the store level for store-level delivery compliance and retail execution reporting. Linking POD to store enables store-level OTIF, refusal rate, and cold-ch

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the delivery was completed and goods were received, critical for OTIF measurement and invoice matching.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Shipping Notice number associated with this delivery, used for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) processing and pre-receipt notification.

attributes.name: cases_delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual number of cases successfully delivered and accepted by the receiver, used for fill rate calculation.

attributes.name: cases_ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of cases that were originally ordered and scheduled for delivery.

attributes.name: cases_refused_quantity
attributes.description: Number of cases refused or rejected by the receiver at the time of delivery.

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery met cold chain temperature requirements throughout transit and at delivery, ensuring food safety and quality for perishable products.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proof of delivery record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_condition_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the overall condition of the delivered goods at the time of receipt.

attributes.name: delivery_condition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the condition of the delivered goods, including any damage, quality concerns, or packaging issues observed at delivery.

attributes.name: delivery_photo_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographic evidence of the delivery was captured via mobile device or ePOD system.

attributes.name: delivery_photo_url
attributes.description: URL or storage path to the delivery photo image file, used for proof of delivery and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current status of the delivery in its lifecycle workflow.

attributes.name: dispute_raised
attributes.description: Indicates whether a delivery dispute has been raised by the customer or carrier regarding this proof of delivery.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate captured at the time of delivery, used for delivery verification and route optimization analytics.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate captured at the time of delivery, used for delivery verification and route optimization analytics.

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the full ordered quantity was delivered without shortages, used for fill rate and in-full delivery KPI measurement.

attributes.name: invoice_matched
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proof of delivery has been successfully matched to the corresponding invoice for three-way matching (PO, receipt, invoice).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proof of delivery record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery was completed within the scheduled time window, used for on-time delivery KPI measurement.

attributes.name: otif_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery met On Time In Full (OTIF) performance criteria: delivered on scheduled date within time window and with full ordered quantity.

attributes.name: pod_capture_method

products.name: contract_store_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between sales_contract and store. It captures the specific stores covered under a master sales contract (chain-wide slotting, EDLP, or distribution agreement) and the per-store financial and operational terms. Each record links one sales_contract to one store with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, such as per-store fees, effective dates, and minimum shelf duration commitments.. Existence Justification: In Food & Beverage retail, master sales contracts (chain-wide slotting agreements, EDLP pricing agreements, distribution agreements) routinely cover multiple stores within a retail chain, and each store participates in multiple contracts simultaneously (e.g., a store may be covered by a slotting agreement for Brand A, an EDLP agreement for Brand B, and a promotional agreement for Brand C). The business actively manages contract-store coverage as a recognized operational entity in trade spend management systems, tracking per-store fees, coverage dates, and shelf duration commitments.

products.name: spend_budget
products.description: Master record for all trade spending funds and budgets — the single source of truth for financial governance of trade investments. Encompasses annual brand/category/channel budgets, retailer account fund allocations, territory-level funds, and promotion-type-specific pools. Captures budget period, scope (brand, category, channel, customer tier), total approved budget, budget by promotion type (TPR, display, feature, slotting, co-op), phasing by period, fund type (lump sum, accrual-based, fixed allowance), committed amount, accrued amount, paid amount, remaining balance, budget owner, approval status, and last revision date. Supports real-time trade spend governance, promotion plan approval guardrails, and budget vs actual variance reporting. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO, TPM fund management modules, and Oracle Cloud Financials.

domains.name: marketing
domains.description: Brand management, consumer engagement, campaigns, advertising spend, marketing claims (FTC compliance), digital and shopper marketing, social media, influencer partnerships, market research, Nielsen/IRI/SPINS syndicated data, consumer insights, private label program data, and brand equity tracking. Supports Salesforce Marketing Cloud execution.
domains.references: FTC Truth in Advertising, FDA Claim Substantiation, GDPR, CCPA

products.name: brand
products.description: Master record for each brand in the F&B portfolio — captures brand identity, positioning, tier (premium, mainstream, value), brand architecture (masterbrand, sub-brand, endorsed), target consumer segment, brand equity score inputs, launch date, and lifecycle status. SSOT for brand identity across the enterprise. Supports brand equity tracking and PLM alignment.
products.reference: Brand Master

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each brand record in the Food Beverage portfolio. Primary key for the brand master data product. Serves as the enterprise-wide SSOT reference for brand identity across PLM, ERP, CRM, and marketing systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Brand Master; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: contract_manufacturer_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Food & beverage brands frequently use contract manufacturers/co-packers to produce products. Tracks primary manufacturing supplier for brand quality audits, FSMA traceability, supplier performance rev

attributes.name: food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.food_safety_plan. Business justification: Each brand operates under a food safety plan governing its manufacturing processes. Critical for FSMA compliance, brand risk management, and linking marketing claims to validated safety controls. Supp

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.market. Business justification: brand.primary_market is a denormalized string representing the brand's primary geographic market. Adding market_id FK to the market reference table normalizes this to the authoritative market master,

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Brand performance is aggregated in profit centers for P&L reporting; FK enables profit‑center level analysis.

attributes.name: target_consumer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Brand strategy defines a target consumer segment; FK replaces the denormalized segment name, enabling segment‑based budgeting and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: allergen_free_claims
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allergen-free claims associated with the brand (e.g., 'gluten-free, nut-free, dairy-free'). Derived from the allergen matrix managed in TraceGains. Must comply with FDA FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act) and FSMA requirements. Used in consumer marketing and retail planogram placement.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA 21 USC 343; FSMA 2011; Codex Alimentarius Allergen Standards; TraceGains Allergen Matrix

attributes.name: annual_marketing_budget
attributes.description: Total approved annual marketing investment budget allocated to the brand, expressed in the functional currency. Includes above-the-line (ATL) advertising, below-the-line (BTL) shopper marketing, digital, and trade promotion spend. Confidential financial data managed in Oracle Cloud ERP Financials and SAP CO cost centers.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; EBITDA Reporting Framework

attributes.name: architecture_type
attributes.description: Classification of the brand within the corporate brand architecture hierarchy. 'masterbrand' = umbrella brand covering multiple product lines; 'sub_brand' = brand operating under a masterbrand; 'endorsed' = independent brand with parent brand endorsement; 'standalone' = fully independent brand; 'private_label' = retailer-owned brand manufactured by Food Beverage under co-packing or toll manufacturing arrangements.
attributes.references: Brand Architecture Framework; Nielsen/IRI Brand Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: awareness_pct
attributes.description: Unaided or total brand awareness percentage among the target consumer segment, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Sourced from Nielsen/IRI consumer panel studies or commissioned brand health tracking research. Key input to brand equity score calculation and marketing investment justification.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Panel Data; Codex Alimentarius Consumer Research Standards

attributes.name: brand_category
attributes.description: Primary consumer product category to which the brand belongs (e.g., 'Snacks', 'Beverages', 'Dairy', 'Packaged Foods', 'RTD Coffee', 'RTE Cereals'). Aligns with Nielsen/IRI/SPINS syndicated data category taxonomy for market tracking and ACV/TDP reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: snacks|beverages|dairy|packaged_foods|rte_cereals|rtd_beverages|condiments|frozen_foods|confectionery|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Category Taxonomy; SPINS Natural Channel Data; GS1 Product Classification

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the brand, used across SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP, and trade systems. Serves as the natural key for cross-system integration and EDI transactions. Example: 'SNKBR-001', 'BEV-RTD-02'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Brand Master; GS1 GTIN Standards

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Official commercial name of the brand as registered and used in consumer-facing marketing, packaging, and trade communications. This is the primary human-readable identifier for the brand (e.g., 'SunCrisp', 'HydraFlow'). Must align with FTC-approved marketing claims and FDA labeling requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Food Labeling

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the annual marketing budget (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Ensures correct financial reporting and multi-currency consolidation in Oracle Cloud ERP and SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: clean_label_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand carries a clean label certification or commitment (no artificial colors, flavors, preservatives, or GMO ingredients). Drives consumer marketing claims, shelf placement in natural/organic sections, and SPINS natural channel data eligibility. Must be substantiated per FTC claim guidelines.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 255; FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Clean Label; GFSI Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand record was first created in the enterprise data platform (Databricks Silver Layer). Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements 21 CFR Part 1.337

attributes.name: crm_brand_code
attributes.description: Brand identifier as recorded in Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud / Marketing Cloud). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse brand master and Salesforce campaign and consumer engagement records. Enables brand-level marketing performance attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: digital_presence_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL for the brand's consumer-facing digital presence (e.g., 'https://www.suncrisp.com'). Used in Salesforce Marketing Cloud digital campaign management, SEO tracking, and consumer engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Digital Marketing; FTC Online Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the brand was officially discontinued or withdrawn from the market. Null if the brand is currently active. Used for portfolio rationalization analysis, regulatory deregistration, and historical reporting in Nielsen/IRI market tracking.
attributes.references: SAP PLM Lifecycle Management; FDA FSMA Product Withdrawal

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary route-to-market channel through which the brand's products are sold. 'retail' = traditional grocery/mass/drug; 'foodservice' = restaurants/institutions; 'dsd' = Direct Store Delivery; 'dtc' = Direct-to-Consumer; 'ecommerce' = online retail; 'club' = club/warehouse channel. Drives trade promotion strategy (TPM/TPO) and supply chain configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel; JDA Blue Yonder Supply Planning; TPM Framework

attributes.name: equity_score
attributes.description: Composite brand equity score derived from consumer research inputs including awareness, consideration, preference, and loyalty metrics. Scored on a 0-100 scale. Sourced from Nielsen/IRI brand health tracking studies and internal NPS panel data. Confidential strategic metric used in portfolio investment decisions and brand valuation.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Brand Health Tracking; ISO 10668 Brand Valuation; Salesforce Marketing Cloud NPS

attributes.name: erp_brand_code
attributes.description: Brand identifier as recorded in the source ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Cloud ERP). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer brand master and operational ERP brand records. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Oracle Cloud ERP Supply Chain

attributes.name: gfsi_certification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Scheme
attributes.description: GFSI-benchmarked food safety certification scheme applicable to the brand's manufacturing operations. 'sqf' = Safe Quality Food (SQF); 'brc' = British Retail Consortium Global Standard; 'fssc_22000' = Food Safety System Certification 22000; 'ifs' = International Featured Standards; 'global_gap' = GlobalG.A.P.; 'none' = no GFSI certification. Tracked in Veeva Vault and TraceGains supplier compliance.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FSSC 22000; SQF Code; BRC Global Standard; ISO 22000

attributes.name: haccp_plan_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Plan Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the HACCP plan document associated with the brand's manufacturing process, stored in Veeva Vault Document Control. HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) is a mandatory food safety management system under FDA FSMA and USDA FSIS regulations. Used for audit traceability and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; USDA FSIS HACCP Regulations 9 CFR Part 417; Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the brand was first commercially launched and made available to consumers in its primary market. Used for brand age calculations, anniversary marketing campaigns, and PLM lifecycle tracking. Aligns with SAP PLM product launch milestones.
attributes.references: SAP PLM NPD Launch Management; FDA FSMA Product Registration

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Legally registered name of the brand as filed with trademark authorities (USPTO, EUIPO, etc.). May differ from the commercial brand name. Used for regulatory filings, contract management, and IP protection tracking.
attributes.references: USPTO Trademark Registration; EUIPO Brand Registry; FDA 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the brand within its commercial lifecycle. 'active' = currently marketed and sold; 'discontinued' = no longer produced or sold; 'pipeline' = in NPD/R&D phase, not yet launched; 'divested' = sold or transferred to another entity; 'archived' = historical record retained for compliance. Drives PLM alignment and portfolio management decisions.
attributes.references: SAP PLM Brand Lifecycle; Veeva Vault Quality Management; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: logo_asset_url
attributes.description: URL pointing to the master brand logo asset stored in the digital asset management (DAM) system. Used by Salesforce Marketing Cloud, packaging design teams, and agency partners for consistent brand identity application across all consumer touchpoints.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder; Brand Identity Standards

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the brand, measuring consumer likelihood to recommend on a -100 to +100 scale. Sourced from consumer panel surveys and Salesforce Marketing Cloud feedback programs. Used as a leading indicator of brand health and consumer loyalty in brand equity tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Service Cloud; Nielsen Panel Data; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand holds USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification or equivalent international organic certification (e.g., EU Organic). Enables organic marketing claims on packaging and in trade communications. Tracked in TraceGains supplier compliance and Veeva Vault document control.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; EU Organic Regulation 2018/848

attributes.name: owner_division
attributes.description: Internal business division or operating unit that owns and manages the brand (e.g., 'North America Snacks', 'Global Beverages', 'International Dairy'). Used for P&L attribution, marketing budget allocation, and organizational reporting in SAP CO and Oracle Financials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: plm_product_line_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Product Line Code
attributes.description: Reference code linking the brand to its associated product line in the PLM system (SAP PLM or equivalent). Enables traceability between brand master data and the SKU/product hierarchy managed in PLM. Used for NPD pipeline tracking and BOM management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM PLM Integration; Oracle Cloud ERP Supply Chain PLM

attributes.name: positioning_statement
attributes.description: Internal strategic statement articulating the brand's unique value proposition, competitive differentiation, and reason-to-believe for the target consumer segment. Confidential business strategy document used in brand planning, NPD briefs, and agency briefings. Not for external distribution.
attributes.references: Brand Management Framework; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_color_hex
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for the brand's primary brand color as defined in the brand identity guidelines (e.g., '#FF6B35'). Used for consistent visual identity application across digital marketing, packaging, and trade materials in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and design systems.
attributes.references: Brand Identity Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder

attributes.name: promise
attributes.description: Consumer-facing articulation of the core benefit or commitment the brand makes to its consumers (e.g., 'Real ingredients, real taste'). Used in marketing communications, packaging copy, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud campaign messaging. Must comply with FTC advertising claim substantiation requirements.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 255 Advertising Claims; FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Labeling

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of regulatory approval for the brand's product claims and labeling across applicable jurisdictions. 'approved' = all required regulatory approvals obtained; 'pending' = applications submitted, awaiting decision; 'under_review' = regulatory authority review in progress; 'rejected' = approval denied, remediation required; 'not_required' = no regulatory approval needed for this brand type. Managed in Veeva Vault Quality Management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; EFSA EU Food Safety Regulation; USDA FSIS; Veeva Vault QMS; FSMA 2011

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Sub-category or segment within the broader product category (e.g., 'Salty Snacks', 'Energy Drinks', 'Greek Yogurt', 'Plant-Based'). Used for granular market share analysis via IRI/SPINS syndicated data and for internal portfolio segmentation reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Segment Taxonomy; SPINS Specialty Product Intelligence

attributes.name: social_media_handle
attributes.description: Primary social media handle or username for the brand's official social media presence (e.g., '@SunCrispSnacks'). Used for social media monitoring, influencer partnership management, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud social engagement tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Social Studio; FTC Influencer Marketing Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: sustainability_claim
attributes.description: Sustainability or environmental claim associated with the brand (e.g., 'Carbon Neutral', 'Rainforest Alliance Certified', 'B Corp Certified', 'Recyclable Packaging'). Must be substantiated per FTC Green Guides (16 CFR Part 260) and EPA environmental compliance standards. Supports ESG reporting and consumer engagement.
attributes.references: FTC Green Guides 16 CFR Part 260; EPA Environmental Compliance; ISO 14001

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Commercial positioning tier of the brand within the portfolio pricing and consumer value ladder. 'super_premium' = ultra-high-end, limited distribution; 'premium' = above-mainstream RSP positioning; 'mainstream' = mass-market EDLP positioning; 'value' = price-entry or economy positioning. Drives RSP strategy, trade promotion investment, and retail planogram placement.
attributes.references: Revenue Management and Pricing Strategy; Nielsen/IRI Price Tier Classification

attributes.name: trademark_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the brand's trademark registration expires and must be renewed to maintain legal protection. Used for IP lifecycle management and legal compliance tracking. Triggers renewal workflows in legal management systems.
attributes.references: USPTO Trademark Renewal Requirements; EUIPO Trademark Renewal; WIPO Madrid Protocol

attributes.name: trademark_registration_number
attributes.description: Official trademark registration number issued by the relevant intellectual property authority (e.g., USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO). Used for IP management, legal protection, and brand licensing agreements. Confidential business identifier managed in legal systems.
attributes.references: USPTO Trademark Act 15 USC 1051; EUIPO EU Trademark Regulation 2017/1001; WIPO Madrid Protocol

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the brand record in the enterprise data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements 21 CFR Part 1.337

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Campaign budgets are charged to cost centers; linking enables budget vs. actual financial analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: primary_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Campaign planning uses a primary SKU for messaging and budgeting; the Primary SKU field drives the Campaign Brief and media allocation.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Campaigns promote products that must be registered in target markets. Ensures marketing launch timing aligns with regulatory clearance, prevents promotion of unregistered products, and supports market

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Campaign planning uses defined customer segments for targeting; linking enables segment‑level ROI reporting and compliance with marketing segmentation policies.

attributes.name: actual_spend_usd
attributes.description: Total actual expenditure incurred for the campaign in US dollars as of the latest financial close. Compared against planned_budget_usd to track budget utilization and variance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: acv_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of All Commodity Volume (ACV) distribution coverage for the campaign's featured products. ACV % is a standard food and beverage industry metric for measuring retail distribution breadth.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state of the campaign record: pending (awaiting review), approved (cleared for execution), rejected (not approved), or under_review (in active review). Supports governance and compliance workflows.

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric business identifier for the campaign used in ERP cost tracking, trade promotion management (TPM), and cross-system reconciliation. Follows internal naming convention (e.g., 'CAMP-2024-BEV-001').

attributes.name: campaign_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the campaign, including creative concept, key messages, promotional mechanics, and strategic rationale. Used for stakeholder briefings and campaign documentation.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the marketing campaign (e.g., 'Summer Refresh 2024 — National TV Burst'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and stakeholder communications.

attributes.name: campaign_status

attributes.name: campaign_type

attributes.name: channel

attributes.name: created_timestamp
