SSOT for both claim definition and claim-to-SKU traceability. Supports FTC/FDA labeling compliance and clean label strategy.

attributes.name: claim_id

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FTC Act Section 5; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the marketing claim is valid and may appear on packaging, advertising, or digital channels. Aligns with EFFECTIVE_FROM category. Used for claim-to-SKU applicability windows and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FTC Act Section 5; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: environmental_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim makes an environmental or sustainability assertion (True = environmental claim subject to FTC Green Guides, e.g., 'Recyclable', 'Carbon Neutral', 'Sustainably Sourced'; False = non-environmental claim). Environmental claims require specific substantiation per FTC 16 CFR Part 260.
attributes.references: FTC Green Guides 16 CFR Part 260; EPA Environmental Marketing Claims; ISO 14021 (Environmental Labels and Declarations)

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent periodic review of this claim's substantiation and regulatory compliance was completed. Used to calculate next_review_date and to demonstrate ongoing due diligence in regulatory audits.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Quality Management; FTC Substantiation Standard; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: legal_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the legal department's review of this marketing claim for FTC compliance, IP considerations, and competitive claim accuracy. Distinct from regulatory approval — legal review focuses on advertising law, substantiation adequacy, and litigation risk.
attributes.references: FTC Act Section 5; FTC Policy Statement Regarding Advertising Substantiation; Internal Legal Review SOP

attributes.name: legal_reviewer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the legal counsel who reviewed and approved or rejected this marketing claim. Provides accountability trail for FTC compliance and internal governance.
attributes.references: FTC Act Section 5; Internal Legal Review SOP

attributes.name: marketing_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the marketing team member responsible for managing this claim's lifecycle, including renewal, substantiation updates, and channel deployment. Primary business owner for claim governance.
attributes.references: Internal Brand Management Framework; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next mandatory periodic review of this claim's substantiation and regulatory compliance is due. Calculated from last review date plus review_frequency_days. Triggers review workflow in Veeva Vault and notifies marketing owner and regulatory reviewer.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Quality Management; FTC Substantiation Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, caveats, or operational notes related to this marketing claim (e.g., 'Claim valid only for products manufactured at Facility X', 'Pending re-certification renewal Q3 2025', 'FTC inquiry resolved 2024-01-15'). Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: organic_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim involves an organic assertion (True = organic claim subject to USDA National Organic Program or equivalent; False = non-organic claim). Organic claims require USDA NOP certification and are subject to strict regulatory oversight.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program 7 CFR Part 205; EFSA Organic Regulation (EU) 2018/848

attributes.name: packaging_version
attributes.description: Specific version or revision of the packaging artwork on which this claim appears (e.g., 'v3.2', 'PV-2024-A'). Critical for traceability when packaging artwork is updated — ensures the claim is only associated with the correct packaging iteration. Aligns with PLM packaging version control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (Material Master); Veeva Vault Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority tier assigned to this claim for packaging real estate and advertising emphasis decisions: tier_1 = hero claim (front-of-pack, primary advertising message); tier_2 = supporting claim (back-of-pack, secondary messaging); tier_3 = supplementary claim (website, digital only). Supports planogram and packaging design decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Brand Management Framework; Nielsen/IRI Assortment Analytics

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory approval, filing, or notification associated with this claim in a specific market (e.g., FDA GRAS notification number, USDA organic certificate number, EFSA health claim authorization reference). Supports regulatory audit and labeling compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.14; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; EFSA Regulation (EC) No 1924/2006

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority or standard that governs the permissibility and substantiation requirements of this claim (e.g., FDA for nutrient content claims, FTC for environmental marketing claims, USDA for organic claims). Drives compliance workflow routing and substantiation documentation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|FTC|USDA|EFSA|Codex|EPA|ISO|GFSI|None — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FTC Act Section 5; USDA National Organic Program 7 CFR Part 205; EFSA Regulation (EC) No 1924/2006; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: regulatory_reviewer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the regulatory affairs professional who reviewed this claim for compliance with FDA, USDA, EFSA, or other applicable regulations. Provides accountability trail for regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; USDA NOP; EFSA Regulation (EC) No 1924/2006; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between mandatory periodic reviews of this claim's substantiation and regulatory compliance. Drives automated review scheduling in Veeva Vault. Typical values: 365 (annual), 730 (biennial). Ensures claims remain substantiated and compliant over time.
attributes.references: FTC Substantiation Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; ISO 22000:2018 Clause 4.1

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this marketing claim record originated or is mastered: TraceGains (specification and supplier compliance management), Veeva_Vault (quality and document control), SAP_S4HANA (material master and labeling), Salesforce_MC (marketing campaign execution), Manual (entered directly into the data platform).
attributes.references: TraceGains Specification Management; Veeva Vault Document Control; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: source_system_claim_code
attributes.description: The native identifier for this claim record in the originating operational system (e.g., TraceGains document ID, Veeva Vault record ID, SAP material specification number). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver Layer data product and the system of record.
attributes.references: TraceGains Document Management; Veeva Vault Document Control; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: substantiation_doc_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the substantiation document stored in Veeva Vault or TraceGains that provides the scientific, regulatory, or third-party evidence supporting the claim (e.g., lab test results, certification body certificate, clinical study reference, supplier attestation). Required for FTC substantiation standard compliance.
attributes.references: FTC Substantiation Standard (FTC Policy Statement Regarding Advertising Substantiation); Veeva Vault Document Control; TraceGains Document Management

attributes.name: substantiation_type
attributes.description: Type of evidence used to substantiate the marketing claim. Determines the rigor and auditability of the claim's support: lab_test = analytical laboratory results; third_party_cert = certification body verification (e.g., Non-GMO Project, NSF); clinical_study = peer-reviewed or commissioned research; supplier_attestation = supplier-provided declaration; regulatory_filing = FDA/USDA submission; internal_audit = internal quality audit.
attributes.references: FTC Policy Statement Regarding Advertising Substantiation; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer granularity within the claim type (e.g., within 'nutritional': 'health claim', 'nutrient content claim', 'structure/function claim'; within 'environmental': 'packaging', 'sourcing', 'carbon'). Supports detailed regulatory mapping and clean label strategy analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health_claim|nutrient_content_claim|structure_function_claim|allergen_free|organic|non_gmo|fair_trade|carbon_neutral|recyclable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.14 (Health Claims); FDA 21 CFR Part 101.54 (Nutrient Content Claims); FTC Green Guides

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this marketing claim record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data pipeline processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: market

products.name: campaign_claim_usage
products.description: This association product represents the deployment of marketing claims within specific campaigns. It captures which regulatory-approved claims (e.g., Non-GMO, Gluten-Free, Heart Healthy) are used in which marketing campaigns, along with channel-specific compliance tracking, effective dates, and creative version references. Each record links one campaign to one claim with attributes that exist only in the context of this claim deployment relationship. Supports FTC/FDA compliance tracking and marketing legal review workflows.. Existence Justification: In F&B marketing operations, campaigns routinely deploy multiple regulatory-approved claims (e.g., a Summer Refresh campaign may feature Non-GMO, Gluten-Free, and Heart Healthy claims across different SKUs and channels), and individual claims are reused across multiple campaigns over time (e.g., the Non-GMO claim appears in brand awareness campaigns, product launch campaigns, and trade promotions). Marketing legal teams actively manage claim deployment as a distinct compliance process, tracking which claims are approved for which campaigns, on which channels, with campaign-specific effective dates and creative version references.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: campaign_claim_usage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each campaign-claim usage record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing campaign in which this claim is deployed

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing claim being used in this campaign

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which marketing legal approved this specific claim for use in this specific campaign. Campaign-specific approval date, distinct from the claims global approval_date.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Marketing channel(s) on which this specific claim is approved for use within this campaign context. Values: packaging, digital, broadcast, print, social, in-store, all_channels. Moved from claim product because applicability varies by campaign deployment.

attributes.name: compliance_status_for_campaign
attributes.description: Legal and regulatory compliance status of this claim specifically within this campaign context. Values: approved (legal cleared for use), pending_review (awaiting marketing legal review), rejected (not approved for this campaign), conditional (approved with restrictions), expired (approval lapsed). Tracks campaign-specific compliance state.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this campaign-claim usage record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: creative_version
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific creative asset version (e.g., TV spot version, digital banner version, package design version) in which this claim appears within this campaign. Supports creative asset management and A/B testing tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this claim is no longer valid for use within this specific campaign. Nullable for ongoing usage. May differ from claims global effective_end_date due to campaign duration or compliance windows.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this claim is valid for use within this specific campaign. May differ from the claims global effective_start_date due to campaign-specific legal review timing or phased rollout strategy.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this campaign-claim usage record. Supports change tracking and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: legal_reviewer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the marketing legal counsel who reviewed and approved this specific claim usage within this campaign. Supports compliance audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: usage_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for campaign-specific usage instructions, restrictions, or context for this claim deployment (e.g., must appear with disclaimer, only for SKU X, regional restrictions). Supports operational guidance for creative teams.

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Sourcing and procurement of raw materials, ingredients, packaging, indirect materials, and services. Includes supplier master data, purchase orders, MOQs, contracts, supplier performance scorecards, supplier audits, TraceGains compliance documents, approved vendor lists, raw material pricing contracts, and spend analytics.
domains.references: ISO 20400, GFSI Supplier Requirements, ISO 9001, TraceGains

products.name: supplier
products.description: Master record for all suppliers, vendors, co-packers, toll manufacturers, and service providers in the F&B procurement network. SSOT for supplier identity, classification, tier, payment terms, lead times, MOQ thresholds, onboarding status, and key contact information. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master and TraceGains supplier compliance records. Covers direct material suppliers (ingredients, packaging), indirect suppliers, 3PL/logistics service providers, and co-manufacturers.
products.reference: SAP MM Vendor Master / TraceGains Supplier Profile

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the supplier record. Primary key for the supplier master data product in the procurement domain. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master (LFA1-LIFNR mapped to BIGINT).

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Compliance team needs to link each supplier to its FDA/USDA establishment registration for audit reporting and traceability.

attributes.name: account_group_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA vendor account group code (LFA1-KTOKK) that controls the field selection, number range, and partner functions applicable to this supplier. Distinguishes between one-time vendors, regular vendors, and intercompany suppliers.

attributes.name: allergen_control_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has a documented and audited allergen control program in place at their manufacturing facility. Critical for managing allergen cross-contact risk in the Food Beverage supply chain per FSMA Preventive Controls requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart C; FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act); Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 80-2020

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is currently on the Approved Vendor List (AVL), meaning they have passed all required quality, food safety, and compliance assessments and are authorized to supply materials or services to Food Beverage.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Supplier Verification

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Categorical outcome of the most recent supplier audit. A 'conditional_pass' requires corrective action within a defined timeframe. A 'fail' triggers supplier suspension pending remediation.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) from the most recent supplier quality or food safety audit. Drives supplier risk tier assignment and determines re-audit frequency. Sourced from TraceGains or Veeva Vault quality management records.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code Edition 9; TraceGains Supplier Compliance; Veeva Vault QMS

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the supplier's primary registered business address. Used for logistics routing, lead time estimation, and geographic risk analysis.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the supplier's primary registered business address. Used for regulatory compliance, import/export controls, country-of-origin labeling, and trade compliance screening.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FDA FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart L

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was first created in the system of record (SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; ISO 22000

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier was deactivated or blocked in the vendor master, preventing new purchase orders from being issued. Null for currently active suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1-SPERR); Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: diversity_classification

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) nine-digit identifier for the supplier legal entity. Used for supplier financial risk screening, credit assessment, and global supplier deduplication.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1-DUNS)

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is capable of exchanging Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions (e.g., EDI 850 Purchase Order, EDI 856 ASN, EDI 810 Invoice) with Food Beverage's procurement systems.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; ANSI X12; SAP S/4HANA EDI Integration

attributes.name: food_safety_cert_expiry_date

attributes.name: food_safety_certification

attributes.name: gln

attributes.name: incoterms_code

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: lead_time_days

attributes.name: portal_registration_flag

attributes.name: primary_contact_email

attributes.name: primary_contact_name

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code

attributes.name: region

attributes.name: risk_rating

attributes.name: single_source_flag

attributes.name: strategic_supplier_flag

attributes.name: supplier_type

attributes.name: tax_identifier

attributes.name: tracegains_supplier_code

attributes.name: trade_name

attributes.name: vendor_code

products.name: supplier_site
