attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent supplier (vendor) record to which this site belongs. A single supplier may operate multiple sites with distinct compliance profiles and capabilities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1); Oracle Cloud Procurement — Supplier Header

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the supplier site. Used for logistics routing, ASN validation, and regulatory country-of-origin documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Address Management (ADRC-STREET); FSMA 204 — Traceability Rule

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the supplier site (suite, building, floor, or unit number). Supplements address_line1 for precise logistics and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: annual_production_capacity
attributes.description: Declared annual production or throughput capacity of the supplier site in the site's primary unit of measure. Used for supply assurance assessments, dual-sourcing decisions, and demand planning stress tests.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Supply Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder — Supply Planning; TraceGains — Supplier Capability

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this supplier site was formally approved and added to the Approved Vendor List (AVL). Marks the start of the site's eligibility for purchase order creation.
attributes.references: TraceGains — Approved Supplier List; SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master; ISO 22000:2018 §8.5.1

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_status
attributes.description: Indicates the site's standing on the Approved Vendor List (AVL). Only sites with 'approved' status are eligible for standard purchase order creation. 'conditional' or 'probationary' may require additional quality oversight.
attributes.references: TraceGains — Approved Supplier List; GFSI — Supplier Approval Requirements; ISO 22000:2018 §8.5.1

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Categorical outcome of the most recent supplier site audit. Drives AVL status updates and corrective action plan (CAP) initiation. 'conditional_pass' requires documented corrective actions within a defined timeframe.
attributes.references: TraceGains — Audit Management; GFSI — Audit Outcome Classification; SQF Institute

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the annual_production_capacity field (e.g., MT for metric tonnes, KG, L, CS). Ensures correct interpretation of capacity data across procurement and supply planning systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Unit of Measure (T006); ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the supplier site is physically located. Used for geographic sourcing analysis, logistics zone assignment, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the supplier site location (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). Drives country-of-origin labeling, import/export compliance, and tariff classification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FDA FSMA — Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP); Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supplier site record was first created in the source system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking per enterprise data governance standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Change Documents; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the default transaction currency used with this supplier site (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used in purchase order creation and spend analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFM1-WAERS)

attributes.name: fda_registration_number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned facility registration number for the supplier site, required under FSMA for domestic and foreign food facilities. Used to verify regulatory standing and support FSVP compliance.
attributes.references: FDA — FSMA Food Facility Registration (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart H); FDA Bioterrorism Act of 2002

attributes.name: food_safety_cert_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the site's primary food safety certification (SQF, FSSC 22000, BRC, etc.). Triggers automated renewal alerts in TraceGains and may suspend sourcing eligibility if expired.
attributes.references: GFSI — Certification Validity Requirements; TraceGains — Document Expiry Management; FSSC 22000

attributes.name: food_safety_certification
attributes.description: Primary food safety certification held by this supplier site (e.g., SQF, FSSC 22000, BRC, IFS). Determines eligibility for sourcing food-contact materials and ingredients. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SQF|FSSC_22000|BRC|IFS|SQF_2000|HACCP|GMP|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI — Global Food Safety Initiative Benchmarking; FSSC 22000; SQF Institute; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme
attributes.description: Specific GFSI-benchmarked certification scheme held by this site. Distinct from the broader food_safety_certification field — captures the exact scheme name for regulatory and customer audit reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SQF|FSSC_22000|BRC_GSFS|IFS_Food|GLOBALG.A.P.|PRIMUS_GFS|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI — Benchmarked Schemes List; Codex Alimentarius; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: haccp_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier site holds a current Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) certification. Required for sites supplying direct food ingredients or food-contact packaging.
attributes.references: FDA — FSMA Preventive Controls Rule (21 CFR Part 117); Codex Alimentarius — HACCP Guidelines; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: halal_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier site holds a current Halal certification from a recognized certifying body. Required for ingredient sourcing for Halal-labeled product lines in applicable markets.
attributes.references: ISWA — Islamic Society of the Washington Area; IFANCA; Codex Alimentarius — General Guidelines for Use of the Term 'Halal'

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code governing the transfer of risk and freight responsibility for shipments from this supplier site (e.g., FOB, DDP, CIF). Drives logistics cost allocation and customs documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC — Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record (EKPO-INCO1); Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: kosher_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier site holds a current Kosher certification from a recognized certifying agency. Relevant for ingredient sourcing for Kosher-labeled product lines.
attributes.references: Orthodox Union (OU); Star-K; FDA — Labeling Requirements (21 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality or food safety audit conducted at this supplier site. Used to determine audit frequency compliance and trigger re-audit scheduling per GFSI and internal procurement policy.
attributes.references: GFSI — Supplier Audit Requirements; TraceGains — Audit Management; ISO 22000:2018 §9.2

attributes.name: last_audit_score
attributes.description: Numeric score achieved by the supplier site in the most recent quality or food safety audit, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Used in supplier performance scorecards and AVL status decisions.
attributes.references: TraceGains — Audit Scoring; SQF — Audit Scoring Methodology; GFSI

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the supplier site record in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change detection in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Change Documents; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the supplier site in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Enables geospatial supply chain risk analysis, logistics optimization, and distance-to-DC calculations.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in calendar days from purchase order placement to goods receipt at the destination DC for this specific supplier site. Site-level lead times override supplier-level defaults in MRP/IBP planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record (EINE-WEBAZ); SAP IBP — Supply Planning Parameters; JDA/Blue Yonder — Supply Planning

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the supplier site in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used alongside latitude for geospatial supply chain risk analysis and logistics routing.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by this supplier site per purchase order line. Used in procurement planning, MRP order proposals, and trade negotiation. Expressed in the site's standard ordering unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record (EINE-MINBM); Oracle Cloud Procurement — Supplier Site Terms

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure applicable to the MOQ field (e.g., KG, LB, CS, PAL, EA). Ensures correct interpretation of the MOQ value in procurement planning and ERP order creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Unit of Measure (T006); ISO 80000-1 — Quantities and Units

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled due date for the next quality or food safety audit at this supplier site. Calculated based on audit frequency policy, risk tier, and last audit date. Managed in TraceGains.
attributes.references: TraceGains — Audit Scheduling; GFSI — Audit Frequency Requirements; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier site holds a current organic certification (e.g., USDA NOP, EU Organic). Required for sites supplying organic-labeled ingredients or finished goods.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; EU Organic Regulation (EC) No 834/2007

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the negotiated payment terms for this supplier site (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow planning in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Terms (T052); Oracle Cloud Financials — Payment Terms

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the supplier site. Used for logistics carrier zone rating, geographic clustering, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the supplier site. Used for purchase order notifications, compliance document requests, and audit scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Contact (KNVK-SMTP_ADDR); TraceGains — Supplier Contact

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the supplier site (e.g., account manager, quality manager). Used for procurement communications, audit coordination, and escalation management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Contact (KNVK); TraceGains — Supplier Contact Management

attributes.name: quality_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the quality or food safety contact at the supplier site. Used for HACCP documentation requests, corrective action plan (CAP) communications, and audit coordination.
attributes.references: TraceGains — Supplier Quality Contact; Veeva Vault QMS — Supplier Quality Management; GFSI

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Procurement risk classification for the supplier site based on factors including food safety criticality, single-source dependency, geographic risk, and spend concentration. Drives audit frequency, safety stock levels, and contingency sourcing plans.
attributes.references: FSMA — Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP); ISO 31000 — Risk Management; GFSI

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this supplier site, used in purchase orders, EDI transactions, and ASN communications. Corresponds to the vendor sub-range or delivery address code in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1-LIFNR/ADRNR); EDI X12 / EDIFACT

attributes.name: site_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the supplier site, used for purchase order transmission, ASN notifications, and compliance document requests via TraceGains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Address Management (ADRC-SMTP_ADDR); TraceGains — Supplier Contact

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the supplier site (e.g., 'Acme Ingredients — Chicago Plant', 'Global Packaging — Rotterdam DC'). Used in procurement documents, scorecards, and audit reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1-NAME1); Oracle Cloud Procurement — Supplier Site Name

attributes.name: site_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the supplier site, used for procurement communications, quality escalations, and logistics coordination.

attributes.name: site_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supplier site record. Controls whether the site is eligible for purchase order creation and sourcing. 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold pending audit or corrective action.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master Blocking Indicator (LFA1-SPERR); Oracle Cloud Procurement — Supplier Site Status

attributes.name: site_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supplier site by its primary operational function. Drives sourcing decisions, compliance requirements, and audit frequency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing_plant|warehouse|distribution_hub|co_packer|toll_manufacturer|service_delivery|laboratory|office — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TraceGains — Site Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the supplier site address. Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping (e.g., FDA district, USDA region) and tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Address Management (ADRC-REGION); FDA — Facility Registration

attributes.name: usda_establishment_number
attributes.description: USDA-assigned establishment number for supplier sites involved in meat, poultry, or egg product processing. Required for USDA FSIS-regulated facilities and used in regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS — Establishment Numbers (9 CFR Part 301); USDA — Meat and Poultry Inspection

products.name: approved_vendor_list
products.description: Approved Vendor List (AVL) — the authoritative register of supplier-material combinations that are approved for use in F&B production. Tracks approval status, approval date, expiry date, approved material categories (ingredients, packaging, indirect), approval tier (primary, secondary, contingency), and the quality/regulatory basis for approval. Directly supports FSMA, HACCP, and GFSI compliance requirements. Managed in TraceGains and synchronized with SAP MM.
products.reference: AVL — Approved Vendor List / TraceGains Approved Supplier

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each supplier-material combination record in the Approved Vendor List. Primary key for the AVL entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master / Info Record; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: primary_approved_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier/vendor master record. Identifies the approved supplier entity in this AVL entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1); TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material, ingredient, or packaging material record that this supplier is approved to supply.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master (MARA); TraceGains Specification Management

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: AVL records in F&B govern which suppliers are approved to supply a specific raw material against a quality specification. Linking AVL to the governing specification enforces that only spec-compliant s

attributes.name: supplier_quality_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.supplier_quality_assessment. Business justification: AVL approval in F&B is directly driven by supplier quality assessment outcomes (SQF/BRC/FSSC scores). The AVL record must reference the qualifying SQA for audit trail, requalification scheduling, and

attributes.name: allergen_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been specifically assessed and approved for allergen management controls relevant to this material. Supports allergen matrix compliance and FSMA preventive controls.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Preventive Controls; FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA); GFSI

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier-material combination was formally approved and added to the AVL. Represents the effective start of the approval period.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Compliance; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; SAP S/4HANA MM — Info Record (EINE-EKDAT)

attributes.name: approval_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing conditions, restrictions, or rationale associated with the approval decision. For example, conditional approvals may specify required corrective actions or usage limitations.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Compliance; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supplier-material approval. 'approved' = fully qualified; 'conditionally_approved' = approved with restrictions; 'suspended' = temporarily halted pending investigation; 'revoked' = permanently removed; 'pending_review' = under qualification assessment; 'expired' = approval period lapsed without renewal.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Compliance; SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Evaluation; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI

attributes.name: approval_tier
attributes.description: Sourcing tier designation for this supplier-material combination. 'primary' = preferred first-source supplier; 'secondary' = qualified backup supplier; 'contingency' = emergency-use only supplier activated during supply disruptions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Source List (EORD); Supply Chain Risk Management best practices

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the quality or procurement professional who formally approved this supplier-material combination for the AVL. Supports audit trail and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; ISO 22000:2018; GMP 21 CFR Part 110

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the most recent audit conducted for this supplier-material combination. 'first_party' = self-assessment; 'second_party' = customer-conducted; 'third_party' = independent certification body; 'remote' = virtual audit; 'desk_audit' = document review only.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; ISO 22000:2018; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: avl_record_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the AVL record, formatted as AVL-XXXXXXXX. Used for cross-system referencing between SAP MM and TraceGains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record; TraceGains Document Management

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the supplier's primary food safety certification (e.g., SQF, FSSC 22000, BRC). Triggers re-certification alerts and may affect approval status if lapsed.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FSSC 22000; SQF Code; BRC Global Standard

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the material is sourced or manufactured by this supplier. Required for FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) compliance.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart L — Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP); ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AVL record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018 — Records and Documentation; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Records

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current approval expires and must be renewed through re-qualification. Null indicates an open-ended approval with no scheduled expiry. Drives automated renewal workflow triggers.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Compliance; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: food_safety_certification
attributes.description: Primary food safety or quality certification held by the supplier for this material. SQF (Safe Quality Food), BRC (British Retail Consortium), FSSC 22000 (Food Safety System Certification), IFS (International Featured Standards). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SQF|BRC|FSSC_22000|IFS|GlobalGAP|Halal|Kosher|Organic|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; FSSC 22000; BRC Global Standard; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: fsvp_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier-material combination is subject to FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program requirements due to the material being imported from outside the United States.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart L — Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP)

attributes.name: haccp_verified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been verified as having an implemented and validated HACCP plan for this material, as required under FSMA preventive controls and GFSI standards.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality or food safety audit conducted at this supplier's facility for this material. Supports HACCP supplier verification and GFSI compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Supplier Verification; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI Benchmarking; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: last_audit_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) from the most recent supplier quality/food safety audit. Used in supplier performance scorecards and AVL renewal decisions.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Supplier Verification; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: last_requalification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier requalification assessment for this material. Used to track compliance with periodic requalification requirements under FSMA and GFSI.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AVL record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization between TraceGains and SAP MM, and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018 — Records and Documentation; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Records

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in calendar days from purchase order placement to material receipt for this supplier-material combination. Used in demand planning and inventory optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record (EINE-WEBAZ); JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by this supplier for this material. Sourced from SAP MM Purchasing Info Record. Used in purchase order creation and demand planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record (EINE-MINBM); Procurement Policy

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ), aligned with SAP MM base unit of measure. Examples: KG (kilogram), LB (pound), L (liter), EA (each), CS (case), PAL (pallet), MT (metric ton). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|EA|CS|PAL|MT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Unit of Measure (T006-MSEHI); ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: next_requalification_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier requalification review. Calculated based on requalification frequency policy and last requalification date. Drives procurement compliance calendar.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: non_gmo_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier's material has been verified as non-GMO (Genetically Modified Organism), supporting clean label and non-GMO product claims.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS); Non-GMO Project Verified Standard

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification for this material. Required for organic product formulations and clean label claims.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; FDA Organic Labeling

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code (WERKS) indicating the manufacturing or distribution facility for which this supplier-material approval is valid. Null indicates approval is valid across all plants in the purchasing organization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Plant (T001W-WERKS); Manufacturing and Production domain

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is designated as the preferred (first-choice) source for this material within its approval tier. Used in automated purchase order source determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Source List (EORD-VORZUG); Procurement Policy

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: SAP MM Purchasing Organization code (EKORG) responsible for managing this supplier-material approval. Determines the organizational scope of the AVL entry.

attributes.name: qualification_basis
attributes.description: The primary quality and regulatory basis on which the supplier approval was granted. Indicates the type of evidence used to qualify the supplier for this material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: audit|certificate|questionnaire|third_party_cert|historical_performance|regulatory_approval — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Supplier Verification; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI Benchmarking; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: sap_info_record_number
attributes.description: SAP MM Purchasing Info Record number (EINE-INFNR) linking this AVL entry to the corresponding purchasing conditions and pricing data in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record (EINE/EINA)

attributes.name: sole_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is the only approved source for this material, representing a single-source supply risk. Triggers supply risk alerts and dual-sourcing initiatives.
attributes.references: Supply Chain Risk Management; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Supply Chain Program

attributes.name: source_list_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier-material combination is included in the SAP MM Source List (EORD), making it eligible for automatic source determination in purchase requisitions and orders.

attributes.name: supplier_risk_tier
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to this supplier-material combination based on food safety hazard severity, supply criticality, and supplier performance history. Drives frequency of verification activities under FSMA.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Hazard Analysis; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the supplier-material approval was suspended or revoked. Populated when approval_status is 'suspended' or 'revoked'. Supports CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: tracegains_document_code
attributes.description: Reference to the primary compliance document (e.g., supplier specification, audit report, certificate of analysis) stored in TraceGains Document Management that supports this AVL approval.
attributes.references: TraceGains Document Management; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Core procurement transaction record representing a formal purchase order (PO) issued to a supplier for raw materials, ingredients, packaging, indirect materials, or services. Captures PO number, PO type (standard, blanket release, subcontracting, service), order date, requested delivery date, plant/DC destination, total PO value, currency, payment terms, Incoterms, and approval workflow status. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing module and Oracle Cloud Procurement.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchase Order (ME21N) / Oracle Cloud PO

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the purchase order record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key. TRANSACTION_HEADER role — canonical minimum categories enforced.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Module; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Direct customer‑specific purchase orders tie spend to the originating account for order‑to‑cash reconciliation and account‑level reporting.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.center. Business justification: Purchase orders for DC replenishment (supplier delivering to a distribution center) must reference the specific DC for inbound dock scheduling, capacity planning, and receiving coordination. delivery_

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for allocating PO expenses to the appropriate cost center in financial reporting and budgeting, as the PO expense is posted to a cost center per standard F&B accounting practice.

attributes.name: delivery_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Purchase orders must specify delivery destination for receiving operations, warehouse capacity planning, and dock scheduling. Critical for coordinating inbound logistics with warehouse operations. No

attributes.name: fsma_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.fsma_record. Business justification: Order processing records the associated FSMA compliance record for the supplier’s facility to support food safety audits.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Needed to map each purchase order to the GL account for expense posting, enabling accurate GL trial balance and compliance with financial statements.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving plant or distribution center (DC) where the ordered goods or services are to be delivered. Maps to SAP EKPO-WERKS plant code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Master; Oracle Cloud Inventory Organization

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying procurement contract or blanket purchase agreement (outline agreement) against which this PO is released. Nullable for spot/one-time purchases. Maps to SAP EKKO-KONNR contract number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement (EKKO); Oracle Cloud Procurement Contracts

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) master record from whom goods or services are being procured. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction header. Maps to SAP EKKO-LIFNR vendor number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1); Oracle Cloud Supplier Master

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods were physically received at the destination plant or DC, as recorded in the goods receipt (GR) posting. Used for OTIF calculation and supplier performance scorecarding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt (MIGO); Oracle Cloud Receiving

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the purchase order received final approval and was authorized for transmission to the supplier. Used for cycle time analysis and procurement governance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Release Strategy; SOX Procurement Controls

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the purchase order within the approval workflow. 'pending' = awaiting approver action; 'approved' = all required approvals obtained; 'rejected' = denied by an approver; 'escalated' = routed to higher authority due to value threshold or timeout. Supports SOX compliance and procurement governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Release Strategy; Oracle Cloud Approval Workflow; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the final approver who authorized the purchase order. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and procurement governance. Maps to SAP workflow approval history.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Workflow; SOX Section 302/404; Oracle Cloud Approval History

attributes.name: blanket_po_value_limit
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative value authorized for release against a blanket purchase order or framework agreement. Applicable only when po_type = 'blanket_release'. Used for spend control and contract compliance monitoring. Maps to SAP EKKO-KTWRT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement EKKO-KTWRT; Oracle Cloud Blanket PO

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP or Oracle company code representing the legal entity issuing the purchase order. Determines the accounting ledger, currency, and fiscal year variant for financial postings. Maps to SAP EKKO-BUKRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI EKKO-BUKRS; Oracle Cloud Financials Legal Entity; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier in their order acknowledgment. May differ from the requested delivery date. Used to calculate delivery variance and OTIF performance. Maps to SAP EKPO-EINDT after supplier confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Order Acknowledgment; EDI X12 855

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase order record was first created in the source ERP system. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category. Maps to SAP EKKO-AEDAT / creation time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO; Oracle Cloud Procurement; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the purchase order is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category. Maps to SAP EKKO-WAERS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-WAERS

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied at the time of PO creation to convert the PO currency to the company code local currency. Used for financial reporting and spend analytics in local currency. Maps to SAP EKKO-WKURS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Valuation; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: food_safety_hold_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this purchase order or its associated materials are currently under a food safety hold pending quality inspection, allergen verification, or HACCP review. When True, goods receipt and production use are blocked until cleared by QA. Supports FSMA and HACCP compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; HACCP; GFSI; SAP S/4HANA QM Quality Hold

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a goods receipt (GR) is required before invoice verification for this purchase order. When True, the three-way match (PO-GR-Invoice) is enforced. When False, two-way match (PO-Invoice) applies. Maps to SAP EKPO-WEPOS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO-WEPOS; Three-Way Match Control; SOX Procurement Controls

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether any item on this purchase order is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, labeling, or transport documentation under DOT, IATA, or IMDG regulations. Relevant for chemical ingredients, cleaning agents, and certain food additives.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; IATA DGR; FDA 21 CFR; EPA

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the transfer of risk, cost responsibility, and delivery obligations between buyer and supplier. Critical for import/export compliance, freight cost allocation, and insurance. Maps to SAP EKKO-INCO1. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-INCO1; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The named place or port associated with the Incoterms code (e.g., 'Port of Los Angeles' for FOB, 'Buyer Warehouse Chicago' for DDP). Required to fully define the delivery obligation under Incoterms 2020. Maps to SAP EKKO-INCO2.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-INCO2

attributes.name: invoice_verification_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice-based verification (LIV - Logistics Invoice Verification) is required for this PO. When False, evaluated receipt settlement (ERS) may apply. Maps to SAP EKPO-REPOS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO-REPOS; Oracle Cloud Payables

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase order record was last modified in the source ERP system. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED canonical category. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-AEDAT; Oracle Cloud Procurement; ISO 8601

attributes.name: material_group_code
attributes.description: Commodity or material group classification code for the primary category of goods or services on this PO (e.g., raw ingredients, packaging materials, indirect MRO, co-packing services). Used for spend analytics by category and supplier segmentation. Maps to SAP EKPO-MATKL.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO-MATKL; UNSPSC Commodity Classification

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) stipulated by the supplier for this purchase order, expressed in the base unit of measure. Used in procurement planning, order optimization, and supplier negotiation. Maps to SAP EKPO-MINBM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO; Food and Beverage Procurement MOQ Standard

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total net value of the purchase order after discounts but before tax, in the PO currency. This is the principal financial commitment amount used in spend analytics, budget tracking, and COGS reporting. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET net total component. Maps to SAP EKKO-NETWR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-NETWR; Oracle Cloud Procurement; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the purchase order was formally issued and transmitted to the supplier. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for the procurement transaction. Maps to SAP EKKO-BEDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-BEDAT; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the agreed payment terms between the buying organization and the supplier (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow planning. Maps to SAP EKKO-ZTERM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/MM EKKO-ZTERM; Oracle Cloud Payables; GAAP

attributes.name: po_gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross value of the purchase order before discounts, taxes, and freight charges, expressed in the PO currency. Represents the sum of all line-level extended prices. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-NETWR; Oracle Cloud Procurement; GAAP/IFRS Procurement Accounting

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric purchase order number assigned by the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Cloud Procurement) and communicated to the supplier on the PO document. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER used in supplier correspondence, EDI transactions, and ASN matching. Maps to SAP EKKO-EBELN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO; Oracle Cloud Procurement; EDI X12 850

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order. 'draft' = created but not submitted; 'pending_approval' = in approval workflow; 'approved' = approved and transmitted to supplier; 'open' = active with outstanding delivery; 'partially_received' = goods receipt posted for some lines; 'closed' = fully received and invoiced; 'cancelled' = voided before fulfillment. LIFECYCLE_STATUS canonical category. Maps to SAP EKKO processing status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|open|partially_received|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; Oracle Cloud Procurement PO Lifecycle

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order by procurement strategy. 'standard' = one-time discrete PO; 'blanket_release' = release against a blanket/framework agreement; 'subcontracting' = toll manufacturing or co-packing arrangement where components are supplied to the vendor; 'service' = service entry sheet-based PO for indirect services; 'consignment' = vendor-managed inventory replenishment. Maps to SAP EKKO-BSART document type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-BSART; Oracle Cloud Procurement PO Type

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the buyer or purchasing group (commodity team) within the purchasing organization responsible for this PO. Used for spend analytics by buyer, workload management, and supplier relationship ownership. Maps to SAP EKKO-EKGRP.

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the SAP purchasing organization responsible for negotiating and issuing this purchase order. Determines the procurement authority, pricing conditions, and vendor master assignments. Maps to SAP EKKO-EKORG.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-EKORG; Oracle Cloud Procurement Business Unit

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the buying organization requests delivery of the ordered goods or services at the destination plant or DC. Used for supply planning, OTIF measurement, and SLA tracking. Maps to SAP EKPO-EINDT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO-EINDT; OTIF Performance Standard

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this purchase order was sourced. 'SAP_S4HANA' = SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing module; 'ORACLE_CLOUD' = Oracle Cloud Procurement; 'MANUAL' = manually entered in the lakehouse. Supports data lineage and multi-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud Procurement; Data Governance Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system_po_key
attributes.description: The native primary key or document number of the purchase order in the originating source system (e.g., SAP EKKO-EBELN or Oracle PO header ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracing, and support ticket resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-EBELN; Oracle Cloud Procurement PO Header ID

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the purchase order (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) in the PO currency. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Maps to SAP EKKO tax conditions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Tax Conditions; IFRS; FDA/USDA Procurement Compliance

attributes.name: total_quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Total quantity of goods or services ordered across all lines of this purchase order, expressed in the base unit of measure (uom_code). Used for inventory planning, receiving, and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO-MENGE; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: total_quantity_received
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of goods received against this purchase order as of the latest goods receipt posting, expressed in the base unit of measure. Used to calculate open PO quantity, OTIF fill rate, and goods receipt variance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt (MIGO); Oracle Cloud Receiving

attributes.name: tracegains_compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance status of the supplier for this purchase order as tracked in TraceGains, the supplier compliance and document management platform. Reflects whether required supplier documents (COA, SQF certificate, allergen declaration, FSMA compliance) are current and approved. 'compliant' = all documents valid; 'non_compliant' = missing or expired documents; 'pending_review' = documents submitted but under review; 'not_required' = compliance check not applicable.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Compliance; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI; SQF; HACCP

attributes.name: uom_code
attributes.description: Base unit of measure code for the purchase order quantity (e.g., KG, LB, L, EA, CS, PAL). Aligns with SAP base UOM and is used for inventory valuation, recipe/BOM costing, and nutritional compliance calculations. Maps to SAP EKPO-MEINS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO-MEINS; GS1 Unit of Measure Standards

products.name: po_line
products.description: Individual line item within a purchase order, representing a specific material or service being procured. Captures line number, material/ingredient code, material description, ordered quantity, unit of measure, agreed unit price, net value, delivery schedule, storage location, batch requirements, and allergen/regulatory flags relevant to F&B ingredient procurement. Supports BOM-driven procurement and raw material cost tracking (COGS).
products.reference: SAP MM PO Line Item / Oracle Cloud PO Line

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each purchase order line item in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the po_line data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_LINE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – Purchase Order Item (EKPO)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each PO line may be charged to a specific cost center, supporting detailed cost allocation and variance analysis per line item in F&B cost management.

attributes.name: delivery_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Line-level delivery locations enable mixed-destination orders (e.g., raw materials to plant A, packaging to plant B). Supports warehouse slotting, receiving prep, and cross-dock operations. Essential

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Links PO line items to GL accounts for precise posting of material costs, essential for financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material pricing contract or framework agreement governing the terms of this purchase order line. Supports contract compliance and price variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Outline Agreement (EKKO/EKPO); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Purchasing Contracts

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent purchase order header. Establishes the header/detail relationship for BOM-driven procurement and spend analytics. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: HEADER_REFERENCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – Purchase Order Header (EKKO)

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or ingredient master record being procured on this line. Links to the material master for BOM-driven procurement, allergen matrix, and raw material cost tracking (COGS). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: RESOURCE_REFERENCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Master (MARA/MARM); TraceGains Specification Management

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this purchase order line to the approved raw material or ingredient specification document in TraceGains. Ensures that the procured material conforms to the approved specification for food safety and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: TraceGains Specification Management; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 – Supplier Verification; GFSI – Supplier Approval

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) fulfilling this purchase order line. Used for supplier performance scorecards, approved vendor list validation, and spend analytics by supplier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Vendor Master (LFA1); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Supplier Master

attributes.name: account_assignment_category
attributes.description: Determines how the procurement cost is assigned in financial accounting (e.g., to a cost center for indirect materials, to a production order for direct ingredients, to a project for capital expenditure). Critical for COGS and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-KNTTP (Account Assignment Category); SAP FI/CO Integration

attributes.name: allergen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material being procured on this line contains or may contain one or more regulated allergens (e.g., peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, wheat, soy, fish, shellfish). Triggers allergen matrix validation and segregated storage requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA); EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers; TraceGains Allergen Matrix

attributes.name: batch_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether batch management is required for this material upon goods receipt, enabling lot traceability for food safety compliance (HACCP, FSMA). When true, a batch number must be assigned at goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Master (MARA-XCHPF Batch Management); FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S – Traceability

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier via order acknowledgment or Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN). Used to calculate delivery variance against the requested date for OTIF performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKET-EINDT (Confirmed Schedule Line); EDI 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgment; ASN Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the raw material or ingredient was produced or sourced. Required for country-of-origin labeling (COOL) compliance, import duty calculation, and supply chain risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA Agricultural Marketing Act – Country of Origin Labeling (COOL); FDA 21 CFR Part 101 – Food Labeling

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this purchase order line record was first created in the source ERP system. Used for audit trail, procurement cycle time analysis, and data lineage tracking in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-AEDAT (Document Date); ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values on this purchase order line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency procurement and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM – EKKO-WAERS (Currency Key)

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order line has been marked for deletion in the source ERP system. Soft-delete flag used to exclude cancelled or obsolete lines from active procurement reporting while retaining audit history.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-LOEKZ (Deletion Indicator); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Line Cancel Status

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which delivery of the material or service is requested at the receiving plant or distribution center. Drives production scheduling, inventory planning, and OTIF (On Time In Full) performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKET-EINDT (Delivery Date); JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a goods receipt is required for this purchase order line before invoice payment can be processed. Mandatory for direct materials (ingredients, packaging) to enforce three-way match; may be waived for certain service lines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-WEPOS (Goods Receipt Indicator); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Receipt Required Flag

attributes.name: goods_receipt_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of the material actually received against this purchase order line, expressed in the order unit of measure. Used to calculate open quantity, delivery completeness, and three-way match for invoice verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-WEMNG (Quantity of Goods Received); FDA FSMA – Receiving Records

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between buyer and supplier for this purchase order line (e.g., FOB, DDP, CIF). Impacts landed cost calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM – EKKO-INCO1 (Incoterms Part 1); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Freight Terms

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an invoice is expected for this purchase order line. When false, the system may use evaluated receipt settlement (ERS/self-billing) for high-volume ingredient suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-REPOS (Invoice Receipt Indicator); Oracle Cloud Financials – ERS (Evaluated Receipt Settlement)

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity invoiced by the supplier against this purchase order line. Used in three-way match (PO quantity vs. GR quantity vs. invoice quantity) for accounts payable processing and accrual management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-REMNG (Quantity Still to Be Invoiced); Oracle Cloud Financials – Invoice Matching

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: SAP item category code defining the procurement type for this line (e.g., standard stock material, subcontracting for toll manufacturing/co-packing, consignment, service). Determines goods receipt and invoice verification behavior.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-PSTYP (Item Category); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Line Type

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this purchase order line in the source ERP system. Supports change detection for incremental data loads and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO Change Documents; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the parent purchase order, as assigned by the ERP system (e.g., 10, 20, 30 in SAP). Used for ordering and referencing individual line items within a PO. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: LINE_SEQUENCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-EBELP (Item Number of Purchasing Document)

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the purchase order line item reflecting its fulfillment lifecycle. Drives procurement workflow, goods receipt matching, and accounts payable processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|partially_delivered|fully_delivered|invoiced|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO Delivery Completion Indicator; Oracle Cloud Procurement – PO Line Status

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: ERP-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the raw material, ingredient, or packaging material being procured. Aligns with the material master and Bill of Materials (BOM) for ingredient traceability and COGS tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-MATNR (Material Number); FDA 21 CFR Part 117 – Ingredient Traceability

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the raw material, ingredient, or packaging item as defined in the material master. Supports procurement reporting, invoice matching, and supplier communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-TXZ01 (Short Text); TraceGains Specification Management

attributes.name: material_group_code
attributes.description: Classification code grouping materials by commodity or category (e.g., sweeteners, dairy ingredients, flexible packaging, corrugated). Used for spend analytics, category management, and sourcing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-MATKL (Material Group); GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC)

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity as agreed with the supplier for this material. Used to validate that ordered_quantity meets supplier requirements and to optimize order quantities in demand planning and procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Master MRP2 View (MARC-MINBE); TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Total net monetary value of this purchase order line, calculated as (ordered_quantity / price_unit) × unit_price. Represents the committed spend for this line item and feeds into COGS and procurement spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-NETWR (Net Order Value); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Line Amount

attributes.name: order_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the ordered quantity is expressed (e.g., KG, LB, L, EA, CS, MT). Must align with the material master order unit for accurate goods receipt and invoice verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-MEINS (Purchase Order Unit of Measure); ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material or service ordered on this purchase order line, expressed in the order unit of measure. Compared against Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) thresholds and used for demand planning reconciliation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: LINE_QUANTITY.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-MENGE (PO Quantity); FDA FSMA – Traceability Lot Quantity

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material procured on this line is certified organic, requiring supplier certification documentation and chain-of-custody compliance. Supports clean label and organic product formulation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; EU Regulation 2018/848 – Organic Production; TraceGains Document Management

attributes.name: overdelivery_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage by which the supplier may over-deliver against the ordered quantity without triggering a purchase order amendment. Common in bulk ingredient procurement where exact quantities are difficult to control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-UEBTO (Over-Delivery Tolerance); Codex Alimentarius – Commodity Trade Tolerances

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility, distribution center, or co-packing location where the material is to be delivered and consumed. Links procurement to production and inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-WERKS (Plant); GMP 21 CFR Part 110 – Manufacturing Facility

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: The quantity base for which the unit price is quoted (e.g., price per 100 KG, price per 1000 units). Required for accurate net value calculation when pricing is expressed per multiple units, as is common in bulk ingredient procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-PEINH (Price Unit); Codex Alimentarius – Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the buyer or purchasing group responsible for managing this purchase order line. Used for workload distribution, buyer performance reporting, and escalation routing.

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing organization responsible for this purchase order line. Determines the negotiating entity, contract scope, and spend reporting hierarchy in the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKKO-EKORG (Purchasing Organization); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Procurement BU

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming quality inspection is required for this material upon goods receipt, per HACCP, GMP, or SQF requirements. When true, the material is placed in quality inspection stock until released by the QM team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – Inspection Lot (QMEL); FDA 21 CFR Part 117 – Preventive Controls; GFSI – SQF Code; ISO 22000

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum remaining shelf life in days required at the time of goods receipt for this raw material or ingredient. Enforces FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management and prevents use of near-expiry ingredients in production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Master MRP5 View (MARA-MHDRZ Minimum Remaining Shelf Life); FDA 21 CFR Part 117 – Shelf Life

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific storage location within the plant where the received material will be placed (e.g., raw material warehouse, cold storage, dry goods). Supports FIFO/FEFO inventory management and WMS integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-LGORT (Storage Location); WMS Integration Standards

attributes.name: underdelivery_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage by which the supplier may under-deliver against the ordered quantity and still have the line considered fully delivered. Prevents unnecessary open PO lines for minor quantity shortfalls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-UNTTO (Under-Delivery Tolerance); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Receiving Tolerance

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed net price per unit of measure for this purchase order line as negotiated with the supplier or derived from a pricing contract. Core input for COGS calculation and raw material cost tracking. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – EKPO-NETPR (Net Price); Oracle Cloud Procurement – Unit Price

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Procurement-side goods receipt (GR) transaction capturing physical receipt of raw materials, ingredients, packaging, or services at a plant or DC against a purchase order. Records GR number, GR date, received quantity, unit of measure, batch/lot number, shelf life/best-before date, storage location, FEFO/FIFO assignment, quality inspection trigger status, and quantity variance vs. PO. This is the procurement-owned PO-closure confirmation event — it triggers three-way match with finance (invoice verification) and signals inventory domain to update stock positions. SSOT boundary: procurement owns the receipt-against-PO confirmation; inventory domain owns resulting stock position changes. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (MIGO). Critical for lot traceability, FSMA compliance, and PO closure.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO) / GR Document

attributes.name: allergen_declaration_received_flag

attributes.name: batch_number

attributes.name: best_before_date
attributes.description: The date until which the received material maintains optimal quality characteristics. Used for inventory prioritization and customer service level management.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier-provided certificate of analysis was received with the goods. Required for raw material release and TraceGains compliance documentation.

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material met cold chain temperature requirements during transportation and receipt. Non-compliance triggers quality hold and supplier corrective action.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: delivery_note_number

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the received material should not be used or sold. Critical for FEFO inventory rotation, quality hold decisions, and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods were physically received at the plant or distribution center. This is the principal business event timestamp for the receipt transaction and triggers inventory valuation and FEFO/FIFO aging calculations.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The externally-known business identifier for this goods receipt transaction. Used for cross-system reconciliation, three-way match with invoice, and audit trails.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the goods receipt transaction. Tracks the receipt through posting, quality inspection, approval, and final disposition workflows.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the goods receipt transaction was posted in the system. Provides granular audit trail for receipt processing and system reconciliation.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the received material was manufactured or produced by the supplier. Used for shelf life calculation and FEFO inventory management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this goods receipt record was last modified in the system. Tracks changes for audit compliance and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: movement_type

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity originally ordered on the purchase order line. Used to calculate receipt variance and trigger exception workflows for over-receipts or under-receipts.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The quality management inspection lot number assigned to this goods receipt for quality testing and approval. Links to quality inspection results and certificate of analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: The difference between received quantity and ordered quantity. Positive values indicate over-receipt; negative values indicate under-receipt. Triggers procurement exception handling and supplier performance scoring.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of material received and accepted at the plant or distribution center. This is the confirmed receipt quantity used for inventory updates and three-way match with purchase order and invoice.

attributes.name: receiving_notes

attributes.name: shelf_life_days

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount associated with this goods receipt. Used for three-way match with invoice and tax compliance reporting.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction code applied to this goods receipt for sales and use tax calculation. Used for tax compliance and invoice verification.

attributes.name: temperature_at_receipt_c
attributes.description: The temperature of the received material at the time of receipt, measured in degrees Celsius. Critical for cold chain compliance and temperature-sensitive ingredient quality verification.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the goods receipt, calculated as received quantity multiplied by unit price. Used for inventory accounting and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the received quantity is expressed. Must align with the purchase order UOM and material master base UOM for accurate inventory accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|EA|CS|PAL|MT|OZ|ML — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The per-unit purchase price of the received material as recorded on the purchase order. Used for inventory valuation and three-way match with invoice.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: The specific dock or unloading bay at the plant or distribution center where the goods were received. Supports warehouse operations and receiving efficiency analytics.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The inventory valuation method applied to this goods receipt for financial accounting. Determines how the received material cost is recorded in inventory and COGS.

Includes pricing validity periods and price adjustment mechanisms. Sourced from SAP MM outline agreements and Oracle Cloud Procurement contracts.

attributes.description: Specific allergen control and handling requirements stipulated in the contract to ensure compliance with allergen labeling and cross-contamination prevention (e.g., dedicated lines, allergen-free facility).

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: purchasing_organization

attributes.name: volume_commitment_quantity

attributes.name: volume_commitment_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume commitment quantity.

products.name: supplier_scorecard
products.description: Periodic supplier performance scorecard capturing quantitative KPIs across quality, delivery, service, cost, and compliance dimensions. Metrics include OTIF (On Time In Full) rate, fill rate, defect/rejection rate (PPM), non-conformance count and severity, certificate of analysis (CoA) compliance rate, invoice accuracy, responsiveness score, and sustainability rating. Scorecards are generated quarterly or annually and drive supplier tiering, preferred supplier status, AVL renewal decisions, and strategic sourcing decisions. Managed in TraceGains and SAP MM supplier evaluation.
products.reference: TraceGains Supplier Scorecard / SAP MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: supplier_scorecard_id
